jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Document Processing (US Remote)
jobs.excerpt: TREND Health Partners is a tech-enabled payment integrity company.
jobs.description:
TREND Health Partners is a tech-enabled payment integrity company. Our mission is to facilitate collaboration between payers and providers for mutual benefit and waste reduction, ultimately improving access to healthcare. We achieve this by aligning the common goals of payers and providers and fostering collaboration through a shared technology platform and seamless workflows.
Joining TREND Health Partners means becoming part of a dynamic, growing organization that promotes a collaborative and innovative work environment. Our comprehensive compensation package includes competitive salaries, highly valued health insurance, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, and more.
The Principal Software Engineer will lead the development of innovative, scalable software solutions that support complex document review workflows for healthcare payers and providers. This role requires a deep understanding of modern web application architecture and cloud-native backend systems. The engineer will collaborate closely with architects, product, QA, and cloud teams to drive system-wide design decisions, optimize platform performance, and deliver new capabilities to our customers.
The ideal candidate will possess strong technical leadership, a hands-on approach to coding, and the ability to mentor other engineers while ensuring alignment with architectural standards and business goals.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Lead the evolution of our document processing pipeline: designing Step Functions state machines, writing the modular Go services that run inside them, and defining contracts that let workflow steps be swapped in and out cleanly.
  • Own the hard problems around processing real-world PDFs reliably at scale — malformed input, structural variance, and performance across documents from a few pages to tens of thousands.
  • Build out operational metrics and observability — starting with the document pipeline, extending to other platform areas as needs surface.
  • Take a concept from "here's roughly the problem" to a shipped, working solution with minimal hand-holding.
  • Mentor and grow the other engineers working in this space, and advocate for the pipeline's forward progress.
  • Contribute to database design and query performance across our Postgres/RDS environment.
  • Work with OpenSearch for indexing and search functionality tied to document data.
  • Support the wider platform ecosystem beyond the core pipeline as needs come up.
  • Review code, weigh in on architecture, and help set technical direction for the team.
  • Partner with product and engineering leads to turn loose requirements into real technical designs.

Qualifications

  • Documented professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems — we're looking at what you've built and owned, not just tenure.
  • A habit of taking ownership of the problem space, driving the solution, and standing behind your decisions. We don't do blame here — when something goes wrong, we own it, learn, and move forward.
  • Strong Go experience, particularly for backend/service work.
  • Hands-on experience with document processing at scale — you understand PDF structure and edge cases well enough to reason about performance, reliability, and failure modes across variable real-world input.
  • Experience designing and implementing metrics and observability for production systems — deciding what should be measured and building it, not just consuming dashboards someone else built.
  • Comfort with AWS serverless patterns: Lambda, Step Functions, ECS, and event-driven architecture generally.
  • Solid database fundamentals — schema design, query optimization, troubleshooting performance issues.
  • A track record of driving something from an ambiguous starting point to a finished product.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound calls without a lot of oversight.
  • Strong communication — you'll need to explain tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers alike.
  • Experience mentoring engineers day to day — not just leaving comments in code review, but actively growing the people around you.
  • Comfort handling sensitive data (PHI) responsibly and in line with HIPAA requirements.

​Preferred Skills​

  • Proficiency in C++ — not required, but a plus given some of our high-performance pipeline segments are written in it.
  • Interest or experience in Rust — not currently in use, but on the table for future performance-critical pipeline work.
  • Hands-on OpenSearch (or Lucene-based search) experience. This space doesn't have a dedicated owner today — if it's a strength of yours, there's a real opportunity to take charge of it.
  • Experience with document-centric pipelines (OCR, classification, extraction, or similar).
  • Healthcare or payment-integrity industry background.
  • Comfort using agentic coding tools as part of a modern dev workflow.

    A Note on Culture

    We're a laid-back team — plenty of memes, self-managed accountability, low ceremony. We care more about whether the work is good and the pipeline is reliable than about how you got there. We're Mac-shop, and we lean on modern tooling (including AI-assisted coding) without letting it replace engineering judgment.

Mental and Physical Demands

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.


Background:

The International Rescue Committee's (IRC) External Relations (ER) department enables the IRC to respond to the world’s worst humanitarian crises and helps people to survive and rebuild their lives. Within ER, the Philanthropy team leads on the organization’s work with High-Net-Worth Individuals and planned giving donors.

Job Overview:

The Officer, Planned Giving, will work with donors and prospects in an assigned geography across the Southern U.S. to support an increased number of legacy gift commitments and a growing and engaged legacy society. They will support the securing and sustaining of planned gifts by working directly with prospects and donors and Philanthropy colleagues to help ensure a healthy financial future for our humanitarian work. This may entail following up on new leads; soliciting donors for planned gifts; building positive relationships to steward legacy donors; carrying out cultivation, solicitation and stewardship strategies, set with the Senior Director, to connect with and inspire planned giving donors and prospects; supporting colleagues on collaborations; and reporting results of efforts.

The Officer will be expected to understand the needs of older donors and prospects, communicate and connect superbly with colleagues and supporters, use knowledge of various gift planning instruments to assist colleagues and donors, continue to learn about IRC programs, and maintain accurate donor records to support the IRC’s donor relationships and prospecting with high wealth individuals and families.

Additionally, the Officer will be expected to work directly with other development officers, ER colleagues, and local area leadership to increase awareness about planned giving, support education opportunities, and support planned giving conversations and asks for appropriate donors across Major and Principal Giving portfolios.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Timely and accurately input opportunity data into Salesforce to drive pipeline activity, report on progress towards goals, and find areas of improvement.

  • Commitment to respect and maintain confidentiality of donor information;

  • Driver’s license and ability to travel up to 25% of the time, including overnight travel, is required.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, technical support plays an important role in helping customers operate their businesses with confidence. We value strong technical judgment, clear communication, thoughtful troubleshooting, and people who take ownership of difficult problems through resolution.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer to investigate and resolve complex technical issues affecting customers using Bask Health's software platform.

This role is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, technical escalations, issue investigation, and helping improve the reliability of the customer support experience.

You'll work with customer success managers, customer success engineers, product managers, software engineers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve technical problems efficiently and accurately.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform supports merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business-critical capabilities.

You'll develop a detailed understanding of how these systems interact and how technical issues can affect customer operations.

You'll serve as an escalation point for complex customer-reported problems that require deeper technical investigation.

You'll troubleshoot application behavior, configuration issues, integrations, and unexpected platform errors.

You'll investigate issues affecting storefront functionality, questionnaire behavior, checkout flows, and supported platform workflows.

You'll use available technical tools, logs, browser debugging capabilities, and internal documentation to gather evidence and identify likely causes.

You'll reproduce reported issues whenever possible and document the conditions under which they occur.

You'll distinguish between user configuration errors, integration problems, product defects, and broader platform incidents.

You'll work closely with software engineers when an issue requires code-level investigation, infrastructure expertise, or a product fix.

You'll provide engineering teams with clear reproduction steps, technical evidence, customer impact details, and relevant troubleshooting history.

You'll coordinate with product managers when reported issues involve product behavior, functionality gaps, or unclear requirements.

You'll communicate technical findings and resolution updates to customer-facing teams and, when appropriate, directly to customers.

You'll help ensure that customers receive accurate information about known issues, workarounds, and next steps.

You'll take ownership of assigned technical escalations and maintain clear accountability until they are resolved or appropriately transferred.

You'll prioritize issues based on severity, customer impact, business disruption, and established internal escalation procedures.

You'll participate in incident investigations involving customer-facing platform functionality.

You'll help document incident timelines, observed symptoms, customer impact, and resolution steps.

You'll support follow-up reviews to identify recurring issues and opportunities to prevent similar problems.

You'll help build and maintain technical troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge base articles, and escalation procedures.

You'll identify gaps in existing support documentation and recommend clearer, more effective troubleshooting workflows.

You'll assist with improving how technical issues are categorized, investigated, and routed to the appropriate teams.

You'll collaborate with customer success engineers on integration-related issues that require deeper investigation.

You'll work with customer success managers to understand the business impact of technical problems affecting important accounts.

You'll help support customers through technical changes, configuration updates, and issue resolution when appropriate.

You'll also help validate that customer-reported problems have been addressed after engineering releases a fix.

You'll monitor patterns in support tickets and technical escalations to identify recurring product problems.

You'll share technical findings with product and engineering teams to help inform reliability and usability improvements.

Because Bask Health operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll need to handle customer information carefully and follow applicable internal security and privacy requirements.

You'll recognize when an issue involves clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or patient-related decisions that must be handled by the appropriate authorized team.

You'll avoid making clinical or pharmacy decisions while providing technical support for the software workflows involved.

As a senior team member, you'll help establish effective troubleshooting practices and may provide technical guidance to less-experienced support engineers.

You'll be expected to work independently on complex investigations while knowing when to involve engineering or other specialists.

This is a senior individual-contributor role focused on technical support execution and problem resolution, not formal people management.

We're looking for someone with substantial experience supporting SaaS applications, strong debugging skills, and the ability to communicate clearly under pressure.

You should be comfortable investigating ambiguous technical issues, organizing evidence, and working across teams to drive resolution.

Experience supporting e-commerce platforms, payment workflows, or other transaction-heavy software environments is particularly valuable.

Success in this role means resolving difficult technical issues, improving escalation quality, reducing recurring support problems, and helping customers operate reliably on Bask Health.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex customer-facing technical issues.
  • Investigate advanced software application and platform problems.
  • Troubleshoot merchant storefronts, questionnaires, checkout flows, and supported workflows.
  • Diagnose configuration errors, integration failures, and unexpected application behavior.
  • Reproduce customer-reported bugs and document technical findings.
  • Use browser developer tools, logs, and available diagnostic systems.
  • Investigate REST API, webhook, and authentication-related problems.
  • Analyze HTTP requests, responses, and relevant error messages.
  • Distinguish product defects from configuration and integration issues.
  • Prioritize technical issues according to customer impact and severity.
  • Own assigned escalations and coordinate them through resolution.
  • Work with engineering teams on issues requiring code-level investigation.
  • Provide detailed reproduction steps and technical evidence to engineers.
  • Collaborate with product managers on product behavior and functionality concerns.
  • Coordinate with customer success teams on high-impact account issues.
  • Communicate technical updates and recommended next steps clearly.
  • Identify and document supported workarounds when appropriate.
  • Help validate customer-facing fixes following engineering releases.
  • Participate in investigations of customer-impacting platform incidents.
  • Document incident symptoms, timelines, and resolution information.
  • Identify recurring technical issues and recommend preventive improvements.
  • Create and maintain internal technical troubleshooting documentation.
  • Improve technical escalation procedures and support workflows.
  • Help develop consistent issue categorization and triage practices.
  • Review technical support trends and recurring customer complaints.
  • Support internal training on troubleshooting tools and procedures.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior support engineers when needed.
  • Maintain accurate support ticket records and investigation notes.
  • Follow security and privacy procedures during technical investigations.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, or compliance concerns to authorized stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with engineering on platform reliability improvements.
  • Take ownership of complex technical problems and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support engineering, application support, production support, or a closely related technical role.
  • Strong experience supporting customer-facing SaaS applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex software issues.
  • Experience troubleshooting web applications and browser-based platforms.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and common integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with JSON, webhooks, and API authentication.
  • Experience using browser developer tools for technical investigation.
  • Ability to analyze logs, error messages, and application behavior.
  • Experience reproducing software defects and documenting reproduction steps.
  • Ability to distinguish configuration problems from application defects.
  • Experience working directly with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with technical ticketing and escalation management systems.
  • Experience prioritizing issues based on severity and customer impact.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
  • Experience coordinating investigations across multiple internal teams.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
  • Ability to manage several technical investigations simultaneously.
  • Understanding of software incident management and escalation procedures.
  • Familiarity with application security and appropriate data-handling practices.
  • Ability to work independently on ambiguous technical problems.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain clear and accurate technical records.
  • Comfortable collaborating with customer success and product teams.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Ability to take ownership of technical escalations through resolution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting e-commerce SaaS or merchant-facing software.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, or other online storefront platforms.
  • Experience troubleshooting payment and checkout workflows.
  • Familiarity with Stripe or similar payment processing integrations.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience using Postman or similar API testing tools.
  • Familiarity with SQL and database query fundamentals.
  • Experience with application monitoring or observability platforms.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, or similar systems.
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure and hosted SaaS environments.
  • Experience supporting webhooks and asynchronous processing systems.
  • Familiarity with OAuth, access tokens, and authentication flows.
  • Experience supporting transaction-heavy applications.
  • Experience participating in incident response and post-incident reviews.
  • Familiarity with software release processes and regression testing.
  • Experience building technical support knowledge bases.
  • Experience improving escalation workflows and support processes.
  • Experience mentoring junior technical support professionals.
  • Familiarity with healthcare technology or telehealth platforms.
  • Understanding of HIPAA-related technical considerations.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, New Grad to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build the software infrastructure behind our telehealth platform.

This role is designed for recent graduates and early-career engineers who have strong programming fundamentals, enjoy building software, and want to gain hands-on experience developing production backend systems.

You'll work on APIs, databases, backend services, and application logic that support patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.

Our engineering stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, receive feedback through code reviews, and gradually take ownership of more complex features as your technical skills develop.

We're looking for someone who is curious, takes initiative, learns quickly, and enjoys understanding how software works beyond the code they're assigned to write.

You don't need years of professional experience or previous healthcare industry experience. We care about your technical foundation, the projects you've built, your ability to solve problems, and your willingness to learn.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend features that support Bask's telehealth platform.
  • Develop APIs, application logic, and backend services using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Work with SQL databases to create, update, and retrieve application data.
  • Help implement backend functionality for patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.
  • Learn how our serverless infrastructure works using AWS, SST, and related technologies.
  • Assist with building and maintaining integrations between internal services and third-party APIs.
  • Write clean, readable, maintainable code that follows established engineering practices.
  • Create automated tests to verify functionality and help prevent regressions.
  • Debug application issues, investigate errors, and work with experienced engineers to resolve problems.
  • Participate in code reviews and learn how to give and receive constructive technical feedback.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to understand how APIs connect to user-facing applications.
  • Work with product managers and engineers to understand requirements and break projects into manageable tasks.
  • Learn how to design database schemas, structure backend services, and organize application logic.
  • Help maintain documentation for APIs, backend features, and development workflows.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, and accelerate development while validating generated code.
  • Learn how to test changes in staging environments before releasing them to production.
  • Assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting backend services.
  • Contribute to improving existing code, reducing technical debt, and simplifying development workflows.
  • Take ownership of smaller features and gradually work toward independently delivering more complex projects.
  • Ask questions, share ideas, and actively participate in technical discussions.
  • Develop an understanding of security, data privacy, and reliability requirements for healthcare applications.
  • Continue building your technical skills through hands-on projects, feedback, and collaboration with the engineering team.

Requirements

  • Recently completed or currently completing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and basic software design principles.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another modern programming language, with an interest in developing backend applications using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Experience building software through coursework, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, or professional work.
  • Basic understanding of how APIs, servers, and web applications communicate.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and basic SQL concepts.
  • Understanding of Git or another version control system.
  • Ability to write readable, organized code and explain your technical decisions.
  • Familiarity with debugging, testing, and solving programming problems.
  • Interest in learning backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, and production software development.
  • Willingness to use AI-assisted development tools while understanding, reviewing, and validating the code they produce.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask thoughtful questions when needed.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with other engineers and incorporate feedback.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and taking responsibility for assigned work.
  • No previous healthcare industry experience required.

Nice to Have

  • Internship, co-op, freelance, or project experience involving backend development.
  • Experience building applications with TypeScript, JavaScript, or Node.js.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, tRPC, or similar API technologies.
  • Experience using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or another SQL database.
  • Familiarity with Prisma, Drizzle, or other database access tools.
  • Exposure to AWS, SST, serverless applications, or cloud deployment.
  • Experience building full-stack applications using React or Next.js.
  • Experience deploying a personal project or application to a live environment.
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks or test-driven development.
  • Experience building projects involving third-party API integrations.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio of completed technical projects.
  • Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, or other AI-assisted coding tools.
  • Interest in healthcare technology, SaaS platforms, or e-commerce systems.
  • Familiarity with application security, authentication, and data privacy fundamentals.
  • Experience working on a team-based software project using Git and code reviews.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

By Light Professional IT Services LLC readies warfighters and federal agencies with technology and systems engineered to connect, protect, and prepare individuals and teams for whatever comes next. Headquartered in McLean, VA, By Light supports defense, civilian, and commercial IT customers worldwide.

Position Overview

By Light is seeking an experienced Senior Solutions Architect to serve as the lead architect for RangeOS, our cyber range and training platform supporting Department of Defense cyberspace operations.

The architect is the strategic and technical bridge between business goals, user needs, and engineering execution. This individual owns the overall structure, components, and integration of RangeOS so the platform remains feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with product and business objectives.

This is a technically grounded leadership role. The architect leads a team of engineers, works directly with product management, DevSecOps, and engineering leads, and guides architectural decisions from initial design through deployment and sustainment. Customer relationship ownership resides with program leadership; the architect supports those engagements as the senior technical authority on the platform.

Responsibilities

Product Architecture & Technical Framework

  • Define and own the RangeOS technical architecture, including system components, interactions, data flows, and core technologies.
  • Ensure the architecture meets both functional and non-functional requirements, including scalability, reliability, performance, and security.
  • Make forward-looking design decisions so the platform can grow, handle increasing load, and remain maintainable over its lifecycle.
  • Design backend services, microservices, RESTful APIs, and distributed application architectures.
  • Provide technical direction across the full stack, including frontend frameworks, backend services, databases, and system integrations.
  • Evaluate existing components and lead modernization of legacy capabilities into containerized, cloud-native architectures.
  • Technology Selection & Roadmap
  • Select and evaluate tools, frameworks, languages, and platforms based on performance, cost, scalability, security, and team expertise.
  • Build and maintain the RangeOS technical roadmap in partnership with product management, aligned with the product roadmap.
  • Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and decision records so the platform is clear and maintainable as it evolves.
  • Translate business and user requirements into technical specifications, and translate technical constraints back into product terms.

Cloud-Native Architecture & DevSecOps

  • Architect containerized applications using Kubernetes, Docker, and related orchestration technologies.
  • Design solutions for cloud, hybrid cloud, and on-premises deployment environments.
  • Partner with DevSecOps engineers on secure, automated build, test, integration, and deployment pipelines.
  • Guide the use of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and automated deployment.
  • Incorporate security, observability, fault tolerance, and performance into the architecture from the start.

Risk & Technical Debt Management

  • Identify architectural risks early and drive mitigation before they affect delivery.
  • Track and prioritize technical debt, balancing new capability against long-term maintainability.
  • Lead design reviews and resolve complex integration challenges across teams.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers, engineers, and DevOps including hiring input, performance feedback, and career growth.
  • Establish architecture standards, design patterns, and development best practices across the engineering organization.
  • Facilitate technical discussions and engineering decisions across product, engineering, and DevSecOps teams.
  • Serve as the senior technical authority on RangeOS to internal leadership and in support of program-led customer engagements.

RangeOS Technology Environment

RangeOS is deployed across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. The architect will design for and integrate with technologies including:

  • Infrastructure: AWS Cloud, including AWS GovCloud, and Dell server and storage hardware for on-premises deployments
  • Virtualization: VMware vSphere, Proxmox VE, LXD, and KVM/QEMU
  • Containers and orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm
  • Network emulation: Open vSwitch and virtual routers and firewalls such as VyOS and pfSense
  • Identity and access: Keycloak, SAML and OpenID Connect single sign-on, LDAP and Active Directory, and CAC/PKI authentication
  • Infrastructure as Code and automation: Terraform, Ansible, and Packer
  • CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD and container registries such as Harbor
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, and the Elastic Stack
  • Security and compliance: DISA STIGs, the Risk Management Framework (RMF), and HashiCorp Vault for secrets management

Required Experience/Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in application, solutions, or product architecture.
  • DoD 8140 compliant certification at IAM Level II, or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire.
  • Strong hands-on background in backend development with a comprehensive understanding of full-stack application architecture.
  • Experience designing and building enterprise applications using Java, Python, C#, .NET, Spring Boot, or comparable technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting microservices, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, and complex integrations.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, and cloud-native deployment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, automated testing, and secure software delivery.
  • Working knowledge of modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular and their integration with backend services.
  • Experience with relational databases, data modeling, application performance, and data integration.
  • Understanding of AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Experience owning a technical roadmap and architecture documentation for a product or platform.
  • Experience leading or supervising engineers.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments alongside product management.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Experience/Qualifications

  • Experience with cyber ranges, cyber training platforms, or distributed training environments.
  • Familiarity with offensive and defensive cyberspace operations and associated mission software.
  • Experience architecting software within DoD or Intelligence Community environments.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, OpenShift, Helm, or Terraform.
  • Understanding of virtualized infrastructure, network emulation, and enterprise systems integration.
  • Hands-on experience with VMware, Proxmox, or LXD virtualization, and with identity platforms such as Keycloak.
  • Prior experience as a Product Architect, Principal Engineer, Chief Engineer, or Technical Director.

Special Requirements/Security Clearance

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance
  • Up to 10% travel

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining Thrive’s Data & Measurement department as Strategic Analytics Manager, you’ll own Strategic Analytics / Marketing Measurement workflows that drive growth across our clients marketing programs. You’ll partner with internal media teams and client marketing teams by providing measurement consultation and delivering technical insights that inform business decisions. You’ll be a core part of our lift experimentation program, leading client lift tests from design through execution to final presentation. You’ll also support clients and media teams with broader data and measurement capabilities, including measurement reporting, customer or event-level analysis, or media mix modelling, and help shape the evolution of Thrive’s strategic marketing measurement service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own marketing measurement outcomes through strategic and technical lenses, from scoping client objectives, to executing analysis and presenting insights. This will involve designing and executing geo lift tests, building analyses and insights reporting, and consulting client and internal teams on the right measurement approaches.
  • Client: Be the measurement lead across client partnerships, working with paid media teams to turn data into insights and decisions that clients can act on.
  • People: Serve as a strategic translator between data and marketing teams, supporting product feedback loops, identifying gaps, and driving integrated project success. Contribute to Thrive’s knowledge across marketing measurement and strategic analytics by educating non-technical stakeholders.
  • Company: Build Thrive's capacity to lead marketing measurement strategy by refining playbooks, sharing knowledge, and strengthening cross-department roadmaps and systems. Support our Data & Measurement department’s broader service and product evolution to drive stronger marketing analytics insights, tools and strategy across our client roster.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll focus on learning Thrive’s systems, building relationships with your team, and understanding our current operating model. You’ll immerse yourself in existing or onboarding client workflows and begin to get acquainted with our in-house measurement solutions across lift experimentation and media mix modelling.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll begin to support Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows across geo lift experimentation, custom reporting and analysis, and measurement consultation.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll begin to own Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows to advance insights and measurement outcomes. You’ll collaborate with the Data & Measurement team on priority initiatives across measurement service evolution and incoming client partnerships.

Qualifications

  • Marketing Measurement Expertise: You’ve directly supported geo lift experimentation programs through both consultation and execution. You’ve explored the nuances of other measurement approaches, including media attribution and/or media mix modelling, and have a strong understanding of the advertising privacy landscape.
  • Growth Marketing Acumen: You're fluent in marketing metrics and unit economics across ecommerce and/or B2B demand generation (e.g., ROAS, CPA, CPM, CAC, LTV, ROI, brand lift, MQL/SQL) and apply them in your analysis and consulting.
  • Technical Data Rigour: You use data to uncover root causes and challenge assumptions, leveraging SQL, Python, and LLMs to troubleshoot discrepancies and build custom analyses and reporting.
  • Consultative Influence: You have a proven track record of influencing marketing executives, gaining buy-in on complex measurement approaches, and translating data into actionable business decisions.
  • Curiosity & Adaptability: You thrive in fast-moving environments, embrace evolving methods and services, and see change as an opportunity to grow.

---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

  • Highly detail-oriented; prioritizes quality and accuracy over speed.

Physical Requirements:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Deployment Engineer, Merchant Solutions to help merchants successfully implement, configure, and launch technical solutions using Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools.

As merchants launch and expand their businesses, they may need technical assistance connecting systems, configuring workflows, resolving implementation challenges, and ensuring their solutions operate correctly in production.

You'll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and merchant operations to help turn merchant requirements into reliable technical implementations.

This is a hands-on engineering role that combines application development, API integrations, technical troubleshooting, and deployment support. You'll work with backend services, frontend applications, configuration tools, and third-party integrations to help merchants launch and maintain their solutions.

Your work may include implementing merchant-specific configurations, developing integration components, troubleshooting API issues, validating application workflows, and creating reusable tools that make future deployments easier.

You'll collaborate with software engineers, product managers, Customer Success Managers, and merchant-facing teams to understand implementation requirements, identify technical constraints, and resolve problems efficiently.

You'll also help improve Bask's deployment processes by identifying recurring implementation challenges and developing automation, documentation, and reusable engineering solutions.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, merchant deployments must respect appropriate data privacy, access controls, and operational safeguards. You'll ensure that technical implementations follow approved platform capabilities and do not introduce unauthorized clinical or pharmacy functionality.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys solving practical technical problems, communicates clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, and takes ownership of getting software solutions working reliably for real customers.

What You'll Do

  • Support technical implementation and deployment of Bask Health solutions for merchants.
  • Work with merchant-facing teams to understand customer requirements and technical implementation needs.
  • Configure and validate merchant storefronts, questionnaires, and supported platform workflows.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between Bask Health and approved external systems.
  • Build backend services, scripts, and tools that support merchant deployments.
  • Troubleshoot API integrations, authentication issues, and application configuration problems.
  • Assist with implementation of merchant-specific technical requirements within supported platform capabilities.
  • Validate end-to-end workflows before merchant launches.
  • Investigate deployment failures and resolve production implementation issues.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to address technical onboarding challenges.
  • Work with product and engineering teams to identify platform limitations affecting merchant implementations.
  • Develop reusable implementation templates and deployment tools.
  • Automate repetitive configuration and deployment tasks.
  • Build internal utilities that improve implementation speed and consistency.
  • Support integration testing across storefront, patient, commerce, and operational workflows.
  • Review technical configurations for correctness, security, and maintainability.
  • Develop technical documentation for integrations, deployment procedures, and common implementation issues.
  • Assist with troubleshooting payment, checkout, and commerce-related integrations.
  • Support data mapping and information exchange between approved application systems.
  • Implement appropriate error handling and monitoring for merchant integrations.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to resolve complex platform issues.
  • Communicate implementation status, technical risks, and blockers to relevant stakeholders.
  • Participate in technical discovery and solution planning for merchant requirements.
  • Help improve deployment reliability through testing and standardized procedures.
  • Identify recurring merchant technical problems and recommend product or engineering improvements.
  • Support controlled rollout of new platform features to merchant environments.
  • Participate in code reviews, engineering discussions, and implementation planning.
  • Own assigned merchant deployment projects from technical discovery through launch and post-deployment stabilization.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, deployment engineering, technical implementation, or a closely related field.
  • Experience implementing, integrating, or supporting production software applications.
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or comparable languages.
  • Experience working with REST APIs or comparable application integration technologies.
  • Understanding of backend application architecture and service integrations.
  • Familiarity with frontend web applications and modern browser-based software.
  • Experience troubleshooting technical issues across multiple systems.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure API communication.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and structured application data.
  • Experience working with cloud-based software platforms.
  • Ability to translate customer or business requirements into technical implementation plans.
  • Experience testing application workflows and validating expected system behavior.
  • Familiarity with deployment procedures and production release processes.
  • Understanding of software configuration management and environment-specific settings.
  • Experience writing scripts or tools to automate technical tasks.
  • Ability to investigate API errors, integration failures, and unexpected application behavior.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and debugging tools.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative software development practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical issues clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating technical work across engineering and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong attention to detail and implementation quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, customer-focused approach.
  • Ability to independently own technical implementation projects from planning through completion.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working as a Deployment Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Implementation Engineer.
  • Experience implementing SaaS platforms for business customers.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, merchant tools, or storefront applications.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer businesses.
  • Understanding of checkout, payment processing, subscriptions, or commerce workflows.
  • Experience with Stripe or comparable payment integrations.
  • Familiarity with healthcare, telehealth, or pharmacy-related software.
  • Experience configuring patient questionnaires or digital onboarding workflows.

  • Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS applications.

Front Row isn't a traditional agency. We're a connected growth engine, combining strategy, creative, media, and Amazon performance to scale beauty, wellness, and consumer brands. Our difference is in what we connect, and the results it drives: faster growth, stronger conversion, and full-funnel efficiency across every platform.

Born from the unification of five commerce-first agencies, Front Row's Amazon Marketplace Growth division operates at the intersection of brand and performance to help emerging and established brands scale strategically on Amazon.

About Front Row Amazon Marketplace Growth

Front Row's Amazon Marketplace Growth division is purpose-built to help brands scale profitably and strategically on Amazon. We support every stage of the Amazon journey, from early-stage channel entry to enterprise-level expansion, through a connected service model that spans 3P Management, 1P Management, and 3P Distribution.

What sets us apart is our ability to match business models to business moments across a brand's Amazon lifecycle. Whether we're helping a brand take control of its presence through 3P Management, streamline vendor operations via 1P, or unlocking new revenue through our owned retail Distribution model, we operate with agility, transparency, and a relentless focus on performance.

Our team blends deep Amazon fluency with category-specific expertise across CPG, offering tailored strategies, full-funnel optimization, and executional excellence.

As part of Front Row's broader connected commerce offering, we bring Amazon into alignment with a brand's DTC, retail, and marketing ecosystem, ensuring that success on-platform fuels momentum off-platform, too.

The Role

For many brands, the biggest limit on marketplace growth sits upstream. It might be a distribution gap, a pricing conflict, weak brand awareness, or a retail plan pulling in another direction. To grow a brand on marketplaces, you have to understand the whole business.

As Enterprise Director, CPG, you'll be the connected commerce partner to Front Row's premier CPG brands. You'll support each brand's omnichannel strategy so what we learn off-channel sharpens what we do on marketplace. You'll lead Front Row's work directly and partner with the brand's other agency and retail partners where Front Row isn't running the work.

This is an analytical strategy role that requires hands-on experience leading enterprise CPG brands. You're as comfortable identifying strengths and weaknesses within a business, reading a marketing mix model, or presenting a strategic guidance plan. You'll lead strategy, own revenue growth across your portfolio, and build a team of omnichannel leaders to better guide holistic CPG growth across a complex retail system.

Your Impact at Front Row

Lead Brand Growth Strategy

  • Shape each brand's annual growth plan, turning revenue, margin, and share targets into a clear strategy and the execution to deliver it.

  • Diagnose what's holding growth back, whether it's brand awareness and demand generation, pricing and promotion, product-market fit, or retail performance, and trace how each constraint affects marketplace results.

  • Balance long-term brand building against near-term demand capture, and show how that balance affects growth, MER, and margin.

  • Define the role of each sales outlet (DTC, marketplaces, specialty and mass retail), and where growth in one lifts or cannibalizes another.

  • Apply category context specific to CPG.

  • Help brands earn visibility in AI-driven discovery through AEO/GEO, with LLM citations a core Front Row focus in the years ahead.

  • Give strategic direction to Front Row's Amazon team, who own day-to-day activation on marketplace.

Guide Decisions with Data and Modeling

  • Set the measurement agenda for each enterprise client in partnership with Front Row Analytics [and our MMM partner], and turn what works across your portfolio into Front Row's standard for enterprise brands.

  • Make MER each brand's headline efficiency measure, and use MMM to explain what drives it: each lever's contribution, saturation point, and marginal return.

  • Measure brand building as rigorously as performance, tracking awareness, consideration, and branded search demand alongside MMM's long-term effects.

  • Combine MMM, lift and geo holdout tests, and attribution into one measurement approach, and model the payoff of different spend levels in P&L terms a CFO recognizes.

  • Bring DTC, marketplace, retail POS, and SPINS or Circana data into a single MER-anchored scoreboard for brand leadership, using Front Row's proprietary tools, including Catapult, to move faster.

Own Portfolio Growth

  • Own your portfolio's revenue and growth targets, and report on both directly to Front Row leadership.

  • Expand each relationship by solving the brand's next growth problem, bringing in Front Row's strategy, creative, content, media, affiliate, and Distribution teams.

  • Build the strategy and measurement case at the center of enterprise CPG pitches, and be a visible voice for Front Row in the category.

Build the Team

  • Lead Front Row's CPG client pods, developing Client Partners and Account Directors into data-fluent strategists whose recommendations are backed by evidence.

  • Bring Front Row's strategy, analytics, creative, content, and media leads together around each brand as one connected team.

Your First Year

First 90 days: Build relationships with leadership at our top CPG partners and with your team. Assess each brand's growth levers, constraints, and measurement maturity, then deliver a growth point of view for your largest accounts with a MER target attached.

By six months: Every enterprise brand in your portfolio has a connected commerce plan tied to a total-business MER target, plus a measurement roadmap built with Front Row Analytics.

By twelve months: You've led at least one MMM-guided budget shift that improved MER and delivered incremental growth, hit your portfolio revenue targets, and expanded Front Row's role with several top partners. Your team is known across Front Row for its strategic and analytical depth.

The Experience We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • 7+ years in growth strategy, marketing strategy, or analytics, much of it leading omnichannel work for enterprise CPG brands.

  • Experience as the strategic leader on enterprise CPG brands, with a clear view of how retail, pricing, brand building, and advertising work together to drive growth.

  • Experience setting real budgets with MER targets, marketing mix models, and lift tests, and knowing which assumptions to question.

  • An analytical mind that finds the insight that matters in messy data and presents it so leadership acts.

  • Ownership of revenue targets for a client portfolio or brand P&L, with a record of growing both.

  • Experience building teams and leading other managers.

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Strong additions

  • Highly preferred: Hands-on AEO/GEO experience, especially earning brand citations and visibility in LLM answers.

  • Experience rebuilding a brand's measurement around MER, MMM, and brand health tracking, and moving leadership away from platform-reported ROAS.

  • Comfort pairing DTC and marketplace results with category share and retail POS data.

  • A brand-side, founder, operator, or strategy consulting chapter in your career.

  • Experience spanning prestige and mass Beauty, or specialty and mass VMS, plus an active presence in the CPG community.

How We'll Know It's Working

  • Portfolio revenue: retention and growth against annual targets, and the breadth of Front Row services each brand uses

  • Brand growth: profitable revenue and share gains across retail, DTC, and marketplaces

  • Evidence-led budgets: MER improvement and MMM-guided budget shifts that delivered incremental revenue, with every enterprise brand running a unified measurement plan

  • Brand strength: growth in awareness, consideration, and branded search demand

  • AI discovery: growth in brand citations and visibility across LLM answers

  • Team strength: stronger strategists on your team, promotions from within, and top performers who stay

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision

  • PTO

  • Summer Fridays

  • Wellness and commuter benefits

  • Work with a fun, consultative team of experts

  • Location – Ideally Hybrid in NYC - Open to fully remote

SALARY: $150,000 - $180,000 + Bonus

jobs.description:
Appunite is moving from selling engineering hours to owning outcomes. Platform Delivery Team (PDT) is the service behind that shift: we take responsibility for a defined result, like an internal platform for a client, scoped up front and delivered in fixed-price milestones. It’s built on lessons from real client projects and it’s the top priority of our Service Team. We need someone to own it as a product.

This is a product role, not a coordination role. You’ll define what success looks like, run discovery with clients and internal teams, test hypotheses and shape every next version. Selling outcomes changes how we scope, sell, staff and deliver, so you’ll also own the backlog of processes, tools and docs that make v1 real.

You’ll make sure what Sales promises is what Delivery delivers, working with GTM, Client Success, Service Delivery, designers and engineers - none of whom report to you. You’ll report to our CEO, work side by side with him at first, then take over full ownership.

Note: this role doesn’t cover our AI Implementation service.

What we offer

  • Salary: 16 000 - 22 000 PLN net/month B2B - depending on your experience

  • Remote first approach

  • Ownership of the service Appunite is building its core offer around

  • A ~1.5-2 year path to v1, with room to shape v2 and v3

  • Fast onboarding - a few pages of docs and you’re on real topics within a week

  • Design support from a dedicated consultant

Job requirements

  • You’ve owned a product or service from an early stage - defined success, set metrics and decided what goes into the next version.

  • You’ve run discovery yourself and separated the real problem from a premature solution.

  • You’ve aligned multiple departments through influence, not hierarchy.

  • You start from the actual state, not the plan, and challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Strong delivery skills: backlog, prioritization, getting things over the line.

  • You keep your pace when validation is slow and change course when data says so.

  • Fluent Polish and English.

Nice to have

  • Service design experience, especially service blueprints.

  • Experience with fixed-price or outcome-based delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Define the service’s North Star, success metrics and moments of truth in the client experience.

  • Run discovery and turn signals into hypotheses, experiments and next versions.

  • Design the service end to end on a blueprint, from first discovery call to delivery and acceptance.

  • Protect continuity between the sales promise and delivery.

  • Own and prioritize the initiative’s backlog and keep visible weekly progress.

  • Build documentation and processes that don’t depend on one person’s memory.

Our recruitment process

  1. Call with our People Team

  2. Take-home form - three product cases, about an hour

  3. Final interview (1.5 h) with our CEO and Head of Client Success

  4. Final decision

Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility)


WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility) coordinates the integration of privacy, legal, GEO and accessibility requirements across Amgen’s global web experiences. The role translates approved standards and expert guidance into practical requirements, reusable capabilities, risk-based readiness practices, and ongoing monitoring throughout the digital lifecycle. It partners with Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility, business, and technology teams; formal legal interpretations and policy decisions remain with the appropriate subject matter owners.

  • Monitoring, Audit, and Regulatory Change: Support compliance and consent monitoring, audit evidence, regulatory change management, issue escalation, and remediation in partnership with Privacy, Legal, Accessibility, and technology stakeholders.
  • Lifecycle Controls and Measures: Coordinate privacy and legal controls through ongoing changes and retirement, including data retention or deletion, tracker removal, vendor termination, and regulatory records. Track compliance health, exceptions, remediation aging, privacy incidents, and consent effectiveness.

Doctorate degree

Associate’s degree and 8 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience

High school diploma / GED and 10 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience

As a Senior Product Designer on our Patient Journey team, you’ll own the patient-facing flows that turn first-time visitors into patients who start and stay in treatment. Your design decisions show up directly in our conversion and retention numbers, not just in the mockups.

You’ll be the dedicated designer for the Patient Journey squad, partnering daily with a product manager, frontend and backend engineers, QA, and a data analyst, and reporting to our Director of Product. You own patient-facing flows end to end, from early prototype through validation to a shipped, measurable result in a HIPAA-regulated, AI-first environment where both speed and clarity matter.

Responsibilities

  • Own patient-facing conversion flows end to end, from framing the problem through prototyping, validation, and shipped design.
  • Design flows that clearly communicate MEDvidi’s care model and move patients toward the next step, anticipating their real questions and objections.
  • Partner closely with product and engineering to break “too hard / too long” down into shippable tests that launch in weeks.
  • Dig into product analytics and user research yourself to tie every design decision to a concrete metric: conversion, activation, or retention.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
