Our Core Values are… We do the right thing, We foster bright ideas, We invest in the future, and We celebrate success.

At PSC, we want work to enhance your life, not dominate it.

We:

  • Thrive in a culture where people are our greatest asset and we truly celebrate and value the individual.

  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit, love new ideas and are always looking to improve.

  • Understand that everyone has a personal life and provide a flexible work environment - you are an adult and we trust you to get the job done.

  • Provide amazing growth and leadership opportunities in an autonomous role.

  • Are a highly collaborative worldwide team of professionals defining the future of this industry.

  • Offer competitive compensation & benefits including private medical insurance, life insurance and annual income protection.

We encourage our people to continually learn, grow, and expand their skills and knowledge. Perhaps you would like to complete a master’s or a PhD but haven’t done so yet. We will reimburse 50% of your course fees, up to a maximum of $5,000.00 a year. We have offices across the US and People across the US and Canada. and have been working in a Remote Workstyle for years. We are open to remote or hybrid work, or we can offer you a place in one of our offices if you prefer.

Renewable Integration and Dynamic Modeling RMS/EMT

Position Summary

PSC is seeking a Power Systems Engineer to support renewable energy projects, including solar, wind, and battery energy storage. The engineer will develop plant models, perform dynamic studies, investigate model performance, and prepare technical reports. Responsibilities include managing assigned work from initial data review through client comments and final delivery.

Responsibilities

·Develop detailed and aggregate plant models, including collector systems, transformers, reactive compensation, and interconnection facilities.

·Configure generic dynamic models and integrate OEM inverter and plant controller models using project data and equipment settings.

·Perform model quality tests, voltage and frequency ride-through studies, and assessments supporting PRC-029 evaluations.

·Compare positive-sequence and EMT simulation results, investigate differences, and document findings.

·Troubleshoot initialization, control response, current limits, protection operation, and fault recovery.

·Update models from IFC to as-built configurations using final drawings, settings, and OEM model packages.

·Prepare model documentation, study reports, and submission packages, and resolve review comments.

·Coordinate with clients, equipment vendors, and technical reviewers; track assigned deadlines and identify missing information early.

Required Qualifications

·Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with a focus on power systems.

·Five (5) to Eight (8) years of relevant experience, including renewable generation or battery storage modeling and dynamic studies.

·Large Load Modeling

·Strong working knowledge of PSS/E and/or PSLF, including model development, initialization, and troubleshooting.

·Practical experience with PSCAD and OEM inverter and plant controller models.

·Understanding of inverter controls, voltage and reactive power control, frequency response, current limits, and protection.

·Ability to interpret single-line diagrams, equipment data, control settings, and per-unit quantities.

·Python experience for simulation automation, data analysis, and plotting.

·Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to manage assigned studies independently and work within a peer review process.

Preferred Qualifications

· Masters degree in electrical engineering with a focus on power systems.

·Experience across PSS/E, PSLF, and PSCAD.

·Experience with ERCOT

·ASPEN short-circuit modeling experience, including inverter fault-current representations.

·Experience with PRC-029 studies and regional model testing and submission requirements.

·Experience with RMS and EMT benchmarking, weak-grid studies, and battery charging and discharging operation.

·Experience integrating user-defined models and resolving software compatibility issues.

·Consulting experience involving concurrent projects, client reviews, and scope management.

·Professional engineering registration or eligibility is an asset.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is:

·$150,000-210k,000 USD depending on years of exp

·$158,000-220,000 CAD depending on years of exp

You may also be eligible to participate in our profit share program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits, among others. U.S.-based employees also receive, per calendar year, 10 scheduled paid holidays, and 10 days of sick leave. Additionally, regular full-time employees accrue up to 15 days of paid vacation. Benefits and perks listed on our careers page vary depending on the nature of employment with PSC and the country's work location.

If this sounds like something you would like to be a part of, we would love to tell you more.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.excerpt: Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence.
jobs.description:
Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence. Built on more than 35 years of proven results, Lyric combines responsible AI with clinical, payment, regulatory, and policy expertise to deliver transparent, auditable insights in milliseconds across real-time claims workflows. Lyric augments human decision-making so health plans can make faster, more accurate payments while maintaining full control. Today, Lyric supports 200 million lives, with nine of the top 10 U.S. health plans relying on its platform to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and support accurate payments.

Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship/sponsorship assumption and other immigration support are not available for this position.

We’re a company at the intersection of FinTech and Healthcare, committed to simplifying healthcare payment integrity and creating value for health insurers, healthcare providers, and consumers. We’re not a startup, but we move like one when it matters. Right now, we’re in the middle of a serious modernization of our payment integrity platform: replacing legacy .NET, rebuilding the experience layer around modern web frameworks, fixing data bottlenecks, and getting the product ready to scale.

We’re hiring a Full Stack Engineer whose center of gravity is the front end. You’ll spend most of your time designing and building the web experiences our customers actually live in – modular Angular applications, micro-frontend architecture, design systems, accessibility, performance, and the kind of interaction quality that makes a complex product feel simple. You’ll also reach into the backend with confidence: shaping the .NET APIs your UI depends on, tuning the queries that feed your screens, and making sure the seams between client and server are clean. You’ll work closely with product, UX, and DevOps to ship customer-delighting features at scale.

Here’s what makes this role different: you’re not just a frontend engineer who “also knows AI.” We want someone who has already figured out that tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex aren’t toys – they’re force multipliers. You’ll use AI agents every day to tear through component refactors, framework upgrades, test coverage, and the backend work that comes with full-stack ownership. But you also know when the AI is wrong, when to step in, and how to keep quality high. Think of it as having a junior engineer with infinite energy and zero judgment – your job is to supply the judgment.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES & KEY PERFORMANCE OUTCOMES

Lead the front-end modernization of the product

This is the bulk of what you’ll do. You’ll:

  • Design and build React applications that are modular, testable, and accessible by default – with a real point of view on component architecture, state management, routing, and shared libraries.

  • Own the experience layer end to end: design system contributions, responsive layouts, accessibility (WCAG), client-side performance, error and loading states, and the small details that separate a workflow people tolerate from one they trust.

  • Partner with UX on flows that hold up under real customer workloads – dense tables, long-running operations, complex permissioning – not just happy-path mockups.

What success looks like:

  • Customers notice the difference. Workflows feel faster, clearer, and more reliable, and the screens that used to generate support tickets stop generating them.

  • The front-end codebase becomes something the team is proud of: consistent patterns, real test coverage, stable build and release tooling, and a design system that other engineers actually reach for instead of reinventing.

Deliver full-stack features against a real .NET + PostgreSQL stack

Your features don’t stop at the API boundary. You’ll:

  • Shape and extend the .NET APIs your front end consumes – RESTful, versioned, and built for correctness and maintainability, not just “it works.”

  • Make pragmatic backend changes: adding endpoints, refactoring service boundaries, tightening contracts, and replacing legacy .NET code where it’s blocking the experience you’re trying to ship.

  • Get your hands into SQL when the UI demands it – query performance, indexing, transactional correctness – and contribute to data pipelines (Kafka, event-driven flows) when the work calls for it.

What success looks like:

  • You ship features end to end without needing a backend engineer to hand-hold each one. Critical paths land in modern code, sprint over sprint.

  • APIs that back your UIs get faster and more reliable. Database hot spots stop waking people up at night.

Ship modernization work at a pace that surprises people

This is your superpower. You’ll:

  • Use AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to power through component migrations, framework upgrades, API extraction, test scaffolding, and documentation – while catching hallucinations and preventing regressions before they hit a PR.

  • Build reusable playbooks the team can actually follow: prompt templates, repo-level agent instructions, migration checklists, review heuristics, and clear “definition of done” standards for AI-assisted changes – on both the front-end and backend sides of the codebase.

What success looks like:

  • You measurably move the needle – more modules migrated per sprint, faster PR turnarounds – without a spike in production bugs.

  • The team gets better because of you: PRs are clearer, test coverage grows, documentation stays current, and the same mistakes stop repeating.

Own it like it’s yours – especially because this is healthcare

You’ll:

  • Build with security and privacy as defaults, not afterthoughts – both on the client (safe data handling, careful state, sensible telemetry) and on the server (least privilege, auditability). This is healthcare. Getting it wrong isn’t an option.

  • Put real quality guardrails in place: component and integration tests, end-to-end coverage on the flows that matter, CI that blocks bad changes, structured logging, and front-end observability that tells you what users actually experience before they tell you.

  • Review code thoughtfully, have honest architectural conversations, and raise the bar without being a jerk about it.

What success looks like:

  • Fewer severity-1 incidents. When something does go wrong, root cause takes minutes, not hours.

  • Automated test coverage grows meaningfully on modernized code – across the UI, the API layer, and the integration seam between them. The team stops relying on “just test it manually.”

Work with real humans to ship things that matter

You’ll:

  • Partner with analysts, stakeholders, designers, and other engineers to turn business problems into working software – not just technically correct software, but software that actually solves the problem.

  • Help build delivery plans that are honest about trade-offs. “Right” vs. “right now” is a real tension – you’ll help the team navigate it with pragmatic milestones.

What success looks like:

  • Delivery is predictable. Customer onboarding milestones are met. Features ship with confidence, not crossed fingers.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years building and shipping production systems. Not side projects – real software with real users. You’re able to work independently and collaboratively in fast-moving teams.

  • Deep front-end experience with React/Next.js (or comparable depth in Angular with a willingness to lead in React). You’ve built and maintained non-trivial applications: component architecture, state management, routing, forms, accessibility, and performance. You’ve worked at the scale where shared libraries and design systems become real problems – not slides.

  • Strong fundamentals across the modern web platform: TypeScript, HTML, CSS, browser performance, accessibility, testing (unit, component, end-to-end), and the build/release tooling that goes with it.

  • Solid working experience with C# and modern .NET (Core and beyond). You don’t need to be the deepest backend engineer in the room, but you can confidently read, extend, and refactor service code – and you’ve done meaningful work in real codebases, not just greenfield.

  • Comfortable with SQL – enough to design reasonable schemas, write and tune the queries your UI depends on, and recognize when a performance problem belongs at the database, not the client.

  • API design experience – you’ve built and consumed service-oriented APIs with real versioning, auth, reliability, and testing practices, and you have opinions about what makes a backend pleasant (or painful) to integrate with from a front end.

  • Cloud experience with AWS and/or Azure. AWS is particularly relevant here.

  • You actually use AI coding tools as a daily driver. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar – and not just for autocomplete. You’ve used agents for multi-file refactors, migrations, test generation, and review workflows. You have opinions about what works and what doesn’t.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • You’ve led or played a significant role in a real front-end modernization – AngularJS to React, jQuery to a modern framework, a monolithic UI to micro-frontends, or similar. You know where the bodies are buried and you have the scars to prove it.

  • Deep design system or component library experience – you’ve built one, contributed substantially to one, or hauled a team off a tangle of one-off components onto something coherent.

  • You’ve done a legacy ASP.NET / .NET Framework modernization on the backend side.

  • Experience with distributed systems tooling – Kafka, event-driven architectures, or working with Postgres alongside SQL Server.

  • You’ve helped establish agent-friendly engineering practices: writing repo instructions that AI tools can follow, breaking work into agent-sized tasks, setting up CI guardrails for AI-generated code, feature flags, canary deployments – any part of the progressive delivery toolkit.

  • You communicate clearly. Good PR descriptions, straightforward design docs, pragmatic collaboration, low ego. We don’t need a rockstar – we need someone the team trusts.

  • Background in regulated domains (healthcare, fintech, payments) where “move fast and break things” will get you fired.

jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (m/w/d) E-Commerce Agentur · Remote
jobs.excerpt: Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen?
jobs.description:
Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen?

Du denkst in zusammenhängenden System, steuerst komplexe Organisationen und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Konzepte nicht auf Folien bleiben, sondern im Tagesgeschäft gelebt werden?

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE trägst du umfassende Verantwortung für Strukturen, Systeme und Teams.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In deinem täglichen Handeln führst du die Organisation durch Phasen von Wachstum und Veränderung. Entwickelst Strukturen, Systeme und Abteilungen weiter und stellst sicher, dass EVOLVE als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner reibungslos funktioniert - anstatt in Silos zu arbeiten.

Um eine zukunftsträchtige Agentur zu gestalten, nutzt du KI und Automationen gezielt als Wachstumshebel. Du definierst die operative System- und Automationsarchitektur und sorgst dafür, dass Technologie messbar zur Skalierung, Qualitätssicherung und Entlastung der Teams beiträgt.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann.

Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.

EVOLVE Digital bietet dir ein Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team aus 20+ erfahrenen Spezialisten.

Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran.

  • Denn die besten Prozesse bringen nichts, wenn niemand nachhält, ob sie greifen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

    Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du übersetzt die Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass das EVOLVE OS als ganzheitliches System und Kern unserer Dienstleistung funktioniert und sich fortlaufend weiterentwickelt

  • Du steuerst die operativen Abläufe vor allem innerhalb der Agentur und bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen über Onboarding.

  • Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten, wo sie benötigt und sinnvoll sind.

  • Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Für die Umsetzung stellen wir dir ein Team zur Verfügung.

  • Du betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag: Reminder, Check-ins, Dashboards. Ziele, die niemand nachhält, bleiben.

  • Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Bottlenecks im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- und Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.

  • Du kennst dich mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana aus und verstehst in den Grundzügen Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n.

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt.

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, da wir 100 % remote arbeiten.

  • Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Team Leads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google-Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen.

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur ,um Texte zu erstellen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Head of Operations

  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit

  • Attraktives Gehalt und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Umfangreiches Benefitprogramm, einschließlich einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterbenefits, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz und eine langfristige Perspektive mit der Möglichkeit, sich zum COO weiterzuentwickeln

  • Kollegiale und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und offener Feedbackkultur

  • Umfangreiche fachliche Fortbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Moderne Arbeitsgeräte, inklusive Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertigem Zubehör für das Homeoffice.

  • 2x jährlich stattfindende Teamevents / Workations

Nächste Schritte & Ansprechpartner

Ansprechpartner: Dein erster Kontakt ist Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin und sie freut sich schon darauf dich kennen zu lernen.

So wirst du Teil unseres Teams: Du willst Teil unseres Teams werden? Dann bewirb dich jetzt direkt. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist, Payments Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: About the Team/RoleWe are looking for a highly entrepreneurial Principal Data Scientist with deep payments expertise to help define and build the next generation of intelligent payment products.
jobs.description:
About the Team/Role

We are looking for a highly entrepreneurial Principal Data Scientist with deep payments expertise to help define and build the next generation of intelligent payment products. This individual will combine hands-on data science, machine learning, payment-domain expertise, and strong product instincts to identify high-value opportunities hidden within corporate payments data and turn them into production-ready intelligence. This is not a traditional analytics or reporting role. The successful candidate will start with ambiguous business problems, explore data, form hypotheses, build models and signals, and partner with Product and Engineering to turn insights into scalable capabilities. The role offers near-greenfield opportunity and end-to-end ownership within Corporate Payments, with a focus on revenue growth and measurable business value.


The initial focus includes exploring opportunities such as BIN routing optimization, where small improvements across high transaction volumes may create significant net benefit, as well as supplier onboarding, customer acquisition, and identifying suppliers that already accept card payments and could be connected to WEX customers. Over time, this work can help establish a trusted intelligence foundation for future AI agents and agentic payment experiences.


What You’ll Do:

  • Discover high-value payment opportunities by combining deep payments knowledge with exploratory data science and machine learning.
  • Use corporate payments data to identify opportunities for revenue growth, improved payment economics, supplier onboarding, and new customer acquisition; identify additional data that could unlock further analysis.
  • Build intelligent payment data products that move beyond dashboards to predictions, recommendations, optimization, and decisioning.
  • Develop models and signals related to merchant and supplier behavior, payment acceptance, authorization performance, BIN/interchange optimization, payment routing, fraud/risk, and payment economics.
  • Create connected intelligence across customers, suppliers, merchants, transactions, payment methods, networks, and other payment entities.
  • Identify patterns in large-scale transaction data that can improve acceptance, payment performance, revenue, and margin; form hypotheses and prove value with rigorous analysis.
  • Prototype quickly using Python, SQL, machine learning, and modern data platforms to demonstrate value before scaling solutions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to productionize models, signals, and decisioning capabilities.
  • Design experimentation and measurement frameworks to demonstrate the incremental business value of models and recommendations.
  • Help define the semantic and contextual intelligence needed for future payments AI agents and agentic experiences.
  • Act as a thought partner to Payments leadership, proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for fully defined requirements.
  • Mentor data analysts and collaborate with data scientists across the broader organization, sharing practices and raising the technical and data-science bar.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in data science or a related quantitative discipline, including hands-on work building production machine-learning, predictive, optimization, or decisioning solutions.
  • Deep subject-matter expertise in payments, credit cards, payment transactions, or payment infrastructure. Strong domain understanding is essential; technical ability alone is not sufficient.
  • Experience in several relevant areas such as authorization, acceptance, interchange, BINs, merchant behavior, payment routing, fraud/risk, transaction economics, settlement, or payment-network dynamics.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills and experience working with large-scale transactional datasets. Able to move between exploratory analysis, feature engineering, modeling, experimentation, and productionization.
  • Ability to understand not only what happened in payment data, but why it happened and what the business could do differently.
  • A builder and entrepreneurial mindset: able to independently identify an opportunity, explore data, test a hypothesis, prototype a solution, and develop a business case without requiring a fully defined roadmap.
  • Strong product instincts and judgment to distinguish technically interesting work from work that creates measurable business value.
  • Ability to work directly with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Risk, and business leaders and to communicate clearly and succinctly with director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Customer empathy, proactive collaboration and sharing of learnings, accountability to lead by example, and willingness to challenge existing approaches constructively.
  • Established technical leadership and a collaborative approach to mentoring others while remaining open to learning from peers.

Nice to Have:

  • Advanced degree (master’s degree or above) in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Economics, or another quantitative discipline. Equivalent depth demonstrated through experience may be considered on a case by case basis.
  • Experience with R and modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks. Python and SQL are required; SAS alone is not sufficient.
  • Experience at a major card network, card company, payment processor, transaction-focused fintech, or financial institution.
  • Curiosity about GenAI and agentic systems and interest in designing intelligence that can ultimately be consumed by AI agents.

Why This Role Matters

Corporate Payments has an opportunity to unlock meaningful revenue and net benefit from data that has recently become available. This role will lead the discovery and validation of those opportunities, including payment-routing and interchange economics, supplier connectivity, and customer growth. The successful candidate will have the autonomy to build a portfolio of high-value work, influence business decisions with evidence, and help establish scalable intelligence capabilities for future payment products and agentic experiences. As the portfolio grows, there may be an opportunity to build a supporting team over time; direct people management is not part of the initial role, and continued individual-contributor growth is also supported.


The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $215,000.00 - $243,800.00

Imagine being the person who sparks those “aha!” moments when engineers realize how much faster and smarter they could work.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

At Synera, we help engineering teams automate complex product development workflows with AI-powered automation. As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you’ll combine technical expertise with storytelling and consultative selling to show customers what’s possible - and how Synera can transform the way they build products.

You’ll work closely with Sales and Customer Success to understand customer challenges, design compelling technical demonstrations, and help engineering leaders see the real business value of automation.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of engineering, technology, and customer impact, this role is for you.

👉 Your main activities at Synera will look like:

  • You partner with Account Executives, Key Account Managers, and the CRO to drive revenue growth and support strategic deals.

  • You understand customer challenges and translate them into tailored demos, workflows, and technical presentations.

  • You design and deliver compelling live demonstrations that showcase the real-world impact of Synera.

  • You act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering teams and decision makers.

  • You collaborate with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs and successful customer adoption.

  • You inspire engineers and engineering leaders by showing how automation can transform their workflows.

  • You continuously learn from customers and share insights with Product, Sales, and Customer Success.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You deeply understand the capabilities of the Synera platform.

  • You confidently deliver customized product demos using existing workflows.

  • You actively support the sales process and help build compelling ROI narratives for customer decision makers.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You build custom demo scenarios and technical teasers directly in Synera.

  • You help establish scalable processes for demo planning, delivery, and coordination with Customer Success.

  • You become a trusted technical voice in strategic deals and customer conversations.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary range is (OTE -

inclusive of base salary and target commission):

Experienced Level: 73,500 - 95,700EUR

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • You will interact with interesting customers on engineering and manager level.

  • You will take on a high level of responsibility right from the start.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in the Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000. You’ll also have the chance to grow together with us!

  • We don't count your vacation days as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Access to the mental health platform nilo to support your well-being.

  • We foster connection through regional team events and virtual coffee breaks, and bring everyone together for our annual 2–3-day Summer Event in Germany! 🌈

Requirements

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have several years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or Pre-Sales Engineer in B2B SaaS in the mechanical engineering domain.

jobs.title: Head of R&D Digital Business Innovation
jobs.excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

BeOne Medicines is seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking Head, R&D Digital Business Innovation to accelerate transformation across Global Research & Development (R&D) by pioneering AI-native ways of working and reimagining how work is performed, decisions are made, and teams collaborate.

This leader will work at the intersection of R&D strategy, business transformation, and Digital & AI to identify high-value opportunities and redesign workflows around the capabilities of AI, intelligent agents, automation, data, and digital technologies. Rather than simply applying technology to existing processes, the role will rethink work from first principles, determining what can be eliminated, simplified, automated, augmented, or fundamentally redesigned.

The role will lead business innovation from opportunity identification and experimentation through implementation, adoption, and measurable value realization. Initially, the focus will be on selected priorities, while progressively expanding AI-native workflow innovation and new operating practices across Global R&D.


Key Responsibilities:


1. Digital Business Innovation & Strategy

  • Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to transform R&D workflows, operating practices, and decision-making through AI and digital capabilities.
  • Challenge legacy processes and assumptions, focusing on what should fundamentally change rather than simply digitizing how work is performed today.
  • Translate business challenges into a focused portfolio of innovation initiatives with clear outcomes, priorities, and value hypotheses.
  • Lead selected cross-functional initiatives from opportunity identification through implementation, scaling, and value realization.

2. AI-Native Workflow Innovation

  • Reimagine end-to-end R&D workflows from first principles, using AI, intelligent agents, automation, and data to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.
  • Determine where work can be eliminated, simplified, automated, augmented, or redesigned, and define the optimal interaction between human expertise and AI.
  • Explore AI-native and agentic approaches that reduce manual work, handoffs, information synthesis, and coordination while enabling faster and higher-quality decisions.
  • Rapidly test new concepts through experiments, prototypes, and proofs of value, using evidence to determine what to scale, redesign, or stop.
  • Define appropriate human oversight, decision rights, accountability, and controls for AI-enabled workflows, particularly in scientific, medical, quality, and regulated activities.

3. Business Transformation & New Ways of Working

  • Partner with R&D leaders to translate AI-native workflow designs into sustainable changes in processes, roles, skills, behaviors, decision rights, and operating practices.
  • Enable teams to move beyond using AI for individual tasks toward integrated AI-enabled ways of working embedded in day-to-day workflows and decisions.
  • Build stakeholder ownership, trust, and readiness for new ways of working, addressing barriers to adoption and change.
  • Establish feedback and learning mechanisms to continuously improve workflows, user experience, and business effectiveness.

4. Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnership

  • Serve as a senior innovation partner to R&D leaders, bringing AI-native thinking, external perspective, and constructive challenge to business opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Digital & AI Product Management, Data Science, Technology, and functional teams to translate business opportunities into scalable solutions and new operating practices.
  • Lead the business transformation dimension of digital and AI initiatives, including opportunity definition, workflow redesign, business adoption, and value realization.
  • Influence senior stakeholders, align diverse perspectives, accelerate decisions, and remove barriers to innovation.
  • Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, continuous learning, and willingness to challenge established ways of working.

5. Business Impact & Scalable Innovation

  • Define measurable business outcomes and value hypotheses for innovation initiatives, supported by clear performance baselines and targets.
  • Measure impact across areas such as cycle time, productivity, quality, cost, user experience, and decision effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers when expected business value is not being realized.
  • Scale successful innovations across R&D functions and geographies where they can create broader value.
  • Develop repeatable approaches and playbooks for AI-native workflow innovation, adoption, scaling, and value realization.

Qualifications and Experience:


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, science, engineering, technology, or a related field and 14+ years of relevant experience; advanced degree and 10+ years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Significant experience leading complex business innovation, transformation, process redesign, digital initiatives, or organizational change in a global, matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to think AI-natively and redesign workflows from first principles, rather than simply applying technology to existing processes.
  • Demonstrated track record of challenging established practices and delivering measurable improvements in business performance.
  • Experience taking innovation from opportunity identification and experimentation through implementation, adoption, scaling, and value realization.
  • Strong understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI, intelligent agents, automation, and data-driven decision support, with the ability to translate them into practical business opportunities.
  • Strong strategic and systems thinking, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and execution capabilities.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders, navigate ambiguity and resistance, and mobilize cross-functional teams across organizational boundaries.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a commitment to continuously understanding emerging AI capabilities and their implications for how R&D work can be performed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or another complex, knowledge-intensive and regulated industry.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical R&D processes, with experience in Clinical Operations highly desirable.
  • Experience applying generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, advanced analytics, or emerging technologies to business workflows.
  • Familiarity with process redesign, human-centered design, experimentation, agile ways of working, or digital product development.
  • Experience working across global and culturally diverse organizations.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.
  • Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.
  • Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.
  • Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.
  • Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.
  • Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.
  • Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.
  • A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.
  • Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.
  • Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.
  • Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.
  • If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.
  • Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. $127,000—$141,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL.   • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Communications

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Global Communications to help lead Quince’s media strategy and external storytelling as the company enters its next stage of growth.

This is a rare build. You will be the sole owner of the communications function, reporting directly to the Head of Brand Strategy & Narrative, with the mandate and autonomy to shape how one of the most closely watched companies in retail is understood by the market. Quince's story is not a typical retail story. It is a story about a system: a manufacturer-to-consumer model that changes the economics of quality. The right candidate will find that irresistible.

Great communications is not about announcements. It is about shaping how the market understands a company over time, and choosing the moments, voices, and stories that compound into trust. We are looking for someone who operates at that altitude while still loving the craft.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute Quince's proactive global media strategy across business, retail, technology, and consumer press, translating the company's manufacturer-to-consumer model into coverage that builds long-term brand equity and trust
  • Serve as Quince's primary media relationships owner, cultivating deep, durable relationships with journalists and editors at outlets including BoF, Bloomberg, WSJ, WWD, Vogue Business, and Modern Retail, with credibility that gets calls returned
  • Originate and pitch story angles that advance Quince's core narrative: the operating system behind the brand, category expansion, and global growth, moving coverage beyond price and product into how the business actually works
  • Lead the drumbeat of proactive placements around company milestones, ensuring Quince tells its own story before others tell it for us
  • Write and edit at an executive standard across press releases, media briefs, executive commentary, fact sheets, and background documents, serving as the company's sharpest editorial filter
  • Prepare and position executive spokespeople for high-stakes media moments, owning briefing materials, message architecture, and interview prep in partnership with external media trainers
  • Act as the communications lead for cross-functional launches, partnering with product, merchandising, and growth to shape announcements from strategy through execution rather than at the press-release stage
  • Direct and hold accountable external PR agency partners, setting scope, driving output quality, and ensuring agency work ladders up to company narrative priorities
  • Build and own the measurement framework for earned media, reporting coverage quality, share of voice, and narrative penetration, not just clip counts
  • Design scalable communications systems, processes, and playbooks that allow the function to grow ahead of the company's next stage
  • Maintain constant fluency in the retail, commerce, and consumer landscape, anticipating news cycles and positioning Quince inside the stories that matter before they break

Qualifications

  • Experience working with consumer brands, retail platforms, or high-growth technology companies
  • Strong media relationships across business, retail, and consumer press

  • Experience managing agency partners and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Ability to translate complex ideas into clear and compelling narratives

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 155 000 $ - 185 000 $. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Programme de bonus annuel.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

jobs.excerpt: We AreAccenture is a global collective of innovators whose aim is to improve the way the world works and lives.
jobs.description:
We Are

Accenture is a global collective of innovators whose aim is to improve the way the world works and lives. Empowered with innovative tools, continuous learning, and a global community of diverse talent, we help clients address their most complex challenges.

Accenture Security helps organizations prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents. Our Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) team combines deep investigative expertise, incident response capabilities, and practical client guidance to help organizations understand and contain cyber threats, determine what happened, and recover with confidence.


You Are

A curious, detail-oriented digital forensics and incident response professional who enjoys solving technical problems and helping clients understand cybersecurity incidents. You bring foundational investigative skills, a commitment to preserving the integrity of evidence, and a willingness to learn from experienced practitioners. You work effectively within a team, communicate your findings clearly, and consistently deliver accurate technical work with appropriate guidance.


The Work

You will be part of a specialized DFIR team responding to cybersecurity incidents and conducting forensic investigations for clients across industries. As an Investigator, you will support evidence collection, forensic analysis, threat hunting, preparation of findings, and other client engagement activities under the guidance of more experienced investigators.


Projects and responsibilities might include:

  • Supporting the collection, preservation, processing, and analysis of digital evidence from endpoints, servers, and other relevant sources, following established procedures and maintaining accurate documentation.
  • Assisting with investigations of ransomware, business email compromise, unauthorized access, and other cybersecurity incidents by examining evidence and identifying relevant activity.
  • Using approved forensic tools, endpoint telemetry, and security logs to conduct assigned analysis and contribute to threat hunting and incident response activities.
  • Completing assigned investigative tasks with some guidance, maintaining clear work notes, meeting delivery expectations, and promptly raising questions, risks, or unexpected findings.
  • Preparing accurate investigative notes, evidence summaries, technical findings, and draft report content for review by senior team members.
  • Participating in client discussions and internal team updates, communicating technical information professionally, and supporting senior investigators in presenting findings.
  • Supporting practice operations, including evidence-handling systems, investigative tools, documentation, training, and improvements to established DFIR processes.

Travel may be required for this role. Travel will vary based on business needs and client requirements, including on-site incident response assignments.

Here's What You Need

  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in digital forensics, incident response, cybersecurity investigations, or closely related technical work.
  • Minimum of 2 years of foundational experience collecting, preserving, and analyzing digital evidence using established investigative procedures.
  • Minimum of 2 years working knowledge of cybersecurity incidents, common attacker techniques, operating systems, and security logs.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience using or supporting forensic, endpoint detection and response, or security analysis tools.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Ability to document technical analysis and communicate findings accurately in writing and verbally.
  • Ability to deliver assigned tasks with some guidance, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively in a client-service environment.
  • One recognized DFIR certification, such as GCFE, GCIH, GCFA, or equivalent, or active progress toward an equivalent certification.
  • Exposure to cloud or identity investigations involving Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, or AWS.
  • Familiarity with threat hunting, malware triage, memory analysis, or network forensic concepts.
  • Participation in ransomware, phishing, business email compromise, or unauthorized-access investigations.
  • Experience preparing evidence logs, chain-of-custody records, or other defensible investigative documentation.
  • Prior experience in a cybersecurity consulting, security operations, IT support, or incident response team.

jobs.description:
As a $1B publicly traded SaaS company, Workiva depends on secure, reliable, and intuitive workplace technology that empowers employees to do their best work.


Workiva is seeking a strategic, people-centered Sr. Manager, Workplace Technology to lead our Workplace Technology team. You’ll help evolve and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team that delivers secure, reliable, and intuitive technology experiences while continuously improving how technology enables Workiva and its people to succeed.


You’ll own the strategy and execution of our workplace productivity and collaboration portfolio, employee identity and access, technology support, incident management, and hardware lifecycle operations. You’ll balance operational excellence with innovation, using AI, automation, self-service, and strategic partnerships to improve employee experience and deliver measurable business value.


What You'll Do

Strategy, Innovation, & Leadership

  • Define and execute the Workplace Technology strategy, translating business priorities into a roadmap that balances worker experience, reliability, security, cost, and long-term innovation
  • Build a cohesive, accountable, and proactive team that goes beyond responding to technology needs to continuously improve how technology enables Workiva and its people to succeed; foster an inclusive, psychologically safe culture grounded in Workiva values
  • Coach and develop team members into subject matter expert, product owner, and senior engineering roles, expanding technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and decision-making autonomy
  • Embed AI, automation, self-service, and continuous improvement into team operations to deliver measurable productivity gains across Workiva
  • Establish and own team metrics, including SLAs, ticket deflection, cycle time, and worker satisfaction, to improve service quality, operational effectiveness, cost efficiency, and capacity
  • Lead contractors and vendors through a scalable augmentation model, ensuring effective delivery within budget and securing leadership approval for net-new spend
  • Build trusted cross-functional partnerships to identify opportunities, influence decisions, and align delivery and resource planning

Operational Excellence & Technology Ownership

  • Own the productivity SaaS portfolio (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian, Monday, and related systems), including roadmaps, lifecycle management, rationalization, and licensing within approved budgets
  • Own identity and access management (Okta, Lumos, SSO/SCIM, and employee lifecycle), executing policies that support SOC 2, SOX, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, and related requirements
  • Own enterprise incident and paging tooling (Rootly) and incident response for supported systems; establish consistent processes, strong governance, and follow-the-sun support across NA, EMEA, and APAC
  • Own hardware selection, forecasting, inventory, and vendor oversight within budget, while transitioning to a third-party managed model
  • Support offices and major events in partnership with Event team, Facilities and AV Events and Technology

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, including 3+ years of direct people management
  • Experience managing managers and/or established individual contributors across multiple regions and time zones
  • Proven success leading a support organization with defined SLAs and measurable service outcomes
  • Hands-on leadership and experience running productivity SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and Atlassian

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning identity and access management platforms (Okta or equivalent, SSO, SCIM, joiner-mover-leaver automation) in an environment subject to SOC 2, SOX, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001
  • Experience owning enterprise incident management and paging platforms, and leading incident response for supported systems
  • Experience leading contractors and external vendors as part of a blended team, with a track record of getting results from them
  • Demonstrated use of AI and automation to improve team and business productivity
  • Demonstrated urgency and bias to action, consistently driving initiatives from concept to delivery with speed and ownership
  • Experience managing licensing, forecasts, and budgets
  • Effective communication skills across technical and executive audiences
  • Previous success outsourcing the hardware lifecycle to a third-party vendor, with prior experience running it in-house
  • Experience transitioning a tenured, execution-focused team toward SME and product owner mindset
  • Experience with Lumos or comparable identity governance and automation platforms
  • Experience supporting FedRAMP-authorized or other regulated environments
  • Experience consolidating teams or leading an organizational merger
  • Experience building documentation and operating models that scale globally

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Embrace your inner wanderlust – expect up to 10% travel and attendance at major company events (e.g. SKO, Customer Conference)
  • Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, as we embrace flexible work arrangements

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $133,000.00 - $225,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator II - Care at Home
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a highly motivated Care Coordinator to support our Care at Home team.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Care Coordinator to support our Care at Home team. This role provides operational and non-clinical care coordination support to providers delivering in-home and telehealth care to high-risk and medically complex members, including members recently discharged from the hospital.
The Care Coordinator supports the member journey from referral through outreach, scheduling, enrollment, ongoing care coordination, and program discharge. Core responsibilities include managing referrals and communications, maintaining provider schedules, coordinating efficient driving routes, preparing patient charts, obtaining medical records, and completing provider-directed follow-up tasks.

This position works closely with members, caregivers, providers, primary care offices, hospitals, facilities, health plans, and community partners. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, comfortable with a high volume of calls and tasks, and able to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities while providing a positive member experience.

Our Values:
  • Put Patients First
  • Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams
  • Operate with Integrity & Excellence
  • Be Innovative
  • Work As One Team

What You'll Do

  • Manage incoming Care at Home referrals from receipt through outreach, scheduling, enrollment, or final disposition, including reviewing referral information, maintaining accurate statuses, and documenting outcomes and barriers.
  • Conduct high-volume outreach to members and caregivers by phone, text, and other approved methods to explain the program, support enrollment, schedule services, confirm visits, and follow up on missed or unsuccessful outreach.
  • Coordinate initial, follow-up, urgent, in-home, and telehealth appointments while actively managing provider schedules by filling openings, backfilling cancellations, rescheduling missed visits, and supporting established visit goals.
  • Build efficient in-home schedules by reviewing member locations, provider coverage areas, travel time, and visit logistics to geographically cluster appointments and reduce unnecessary drive time.
  • Prepare patient charts, obtain and upload medical records, and maintain accurate member, referral, appointment, provider assignment, and program information in designated systems.
  • Monitor provider task queues and complete non-clinical, provider-directed care coordination tasks, including coordinating and tracking referrals, authorizations, medical-record requests, durable medical equipment, home health, labs, imaging, hospice, and other ordered services.
  • Manage incoming calls, messages, faxes, and electronic tasks, and communicate with members, caregivers, providers, primary care offices, hospitals, facilities, health plans, and vendors to support timely follow-up and closed-loop coordination.
  • Support post-discharge and transitional care workflows, hospital tracking, member status changes, and program discharges, escalating clinical concerns, urgent requests, unresolved needs, and barriers to the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain required operational trackers, participate in meetings and process-improvement activities, provide cross-coverage when appropriately trained, and meet established expectations for timeliness, schedule utilization, chart preparation, documentation accuracy, task completion, and member service.
This is a non-clinical role. Care Coordinators complete provider-directed coordination activities but do not independently provide medical advice, assess symptoms, interpret clinical results, or make treatment decisions. Clinical concerns must be escalated to the appropriate licensed clinical team member.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma OR GED
  • Experience using Microsoft applications such as Word, Excel and Outlook
  • Experience working in healthcare setting preferred
  • Experience with referrals, authorizations, medical records, or care coordination strongly preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-acuity environment
  • BILINGUAL – Bilingual skills preferred, based on member population
You're Great for This Role if You Have:
  • Experience coordinating care for high-risk or medically complex members
  • Experience supporting post-discharge or transitional care workflows
  • Familiarity working closely with clinical providers and carrying out provider-directed coordination tasks
  • Strong organization skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to think critically and proactively identify barriers to care
  • A member-centered approach and strong communication skills

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This is a full-time, remote position. Hours are M-F 8 A - 5 P PST.
  • The national target compensation for this position is $21.00 - $24.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors.
