jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for an early-career Software Engineer to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build, maintain, and improve the applications that power our telehealth platform.

You'll contribute to real product features across merchant tools, patient experiences, internal systems, and backend services. Depending on the project, your work may involve frontend interfaces, backend development, APIs, databases, or integrations.

This role is ideal for someone who has a foundation in software development and is ready to grow through hands-on engineering work. Whether your experience comes from internships, coursework, personal projects, or an initial engineering role, we're interested in your ability to learn, solve problems, and build reliable software.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers while receiving technical guidance and gradually taking on more ownership.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative, asks thoughtful questions, cares about the quality of their work, and enjoys turning ideas into functional software.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain features across Bask's web applications.
  • Develop frontend functionality using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
  • Contribute to applications built with Next.js.
  • Implement backend features and services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Work with APIs to connect applications and backend systems.
  • Contribute to merchant-facing and patient-facing product experiences.
  • Help build internal tools and operational workflows.
  • Work with SQL databases to retrieve and manage application data.
  • Develop reusable frontend components and application functionality.
  • Collaborate with engineers to understand requirements and technical approaches.
  • Translate product specifications into working software.
  • Assist with integrating third-party services and existing platform APIs.
  • Investigate bugs and help troubleshoot production issues.
  • Write readable, maintainable, and well-tested code.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate technical feedback.
  • Learn and apply engineering best practices for reliability and security.
  • Contribute to application testing and quality assurance.
  • Improve existing features based on product feedback and technical requirements.
  • Help document implementation details and development processes.
  • Participate in technical planning and engineering discussions.
  • Collaborate with product managers and designers on feature development.
  • Learn Bask's application architecture and deployment workflows.
  • Use Git and collaborative development tools.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools while understanding and validating generated code.
  • Take increasing ownership of assigned engineering tasks and product features.

Requirements

  • Foundational software engineering experience gained through coursework, internships, professional roles, freelance work, or personal projects.
  • Understanding of core programming concepts and software development fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript.

Somewhere out there, a subpoena is being served. It has twenty-seven document requests, a Kafkaseque set of instructions, and someone on the other end who would like it handled yesterday. Next week, there will be more.

You can grind through that kind of volume by burning through headcount and leaving no stone unturned. Or you can meet it with creativity and judgment, stepping back to focus on what is actually needed and building systems so the next hundred meet the quality bar more easily than the last.

Litigation at Mercury is not about posturing or perfection. It’s about getting the important things right and knowing which things those are. As a Litigation Paralegal, you’ll join Mercury’s litigation team at a pivotal moment in the company’s story, drawing on your experience and judgment to help the company continue to innovate and scale as it builds a modern banking* experience trusted by more than 450,000 customers.

About the role

You’ll be a key member of our litigation team, supporting work across subpoenas, law enforcement requests, demand letters, discovery, and related workflows. You’ll partner closely with the Deputy General Counsel, Litigation & IP and Senior Litigation Paralegal but operate with a high degree of autonomy—owning high-volume processes, driving execution, and developing creative solutions that enable the team to amplify its impact even as the company grows and scales.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you’ll be trusted to figure out the right approach where there’s no playbook, manage competing priorities, and keep things moving—even when the path isn’t perfectly clear.

What you’ll be doing

  • You’ll own core litigation-related workflows across the team, including managing responses to subpoenas and law enforcement requests, supporting discovery efforts, and coordinating litigation holds and document production.
  • You’ll take the lead on high-volume intake and response processes, ensuring requests are tracked, deadlines are met, and responses are prepared efficiently and accurately.
  • You’ll manage demand letter workflows end-to-end, including intake, drafting responses for attorney review, and driving matters through resolution.
  • You’ll partner closely with attorneys to draft materials and move work forward independently, escalating more complex or higher-risk issues when needed.
  • You’ll collaborate with Legal Operations to build and improve systems that support this work, including developing templates, playbooks, and more scalable processes for handling subpoenas, summons, and related matters.
  • You’ll help oversee and improve automation and AI-assisted tooling in this space—ensuring outputs are accurate, handling exceptions, and identifying opportunities to expand automation over time.
  • You’ll work cross-functionally with teams across the company to gather information and coordinate responses, and externally with vendors or outside counsel where needed.

Who you are

An exceptional paralegal with 4+ years of experience with a law firm or in-house legal team (or a combination of both). In addition, you’ll have:

  • Meaningful experience supporting subpoenas, law enforcement requests, discovery, and other high-volume legal workflows
  • Strong judgment and comfort taking ownership of work from start to finish
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • A proactive, low-ego approach and a willingness to jump in where needed

What we’d love to see

  • A systems-oriented mindset—you’re always looking for ways to help us meet the quality bar more efficiently and consistently
  • Creativity and a willingness to push beyond “the way things are normally done”
  • Strong AI instincts and experience – can evaluate tools, deploy them responsibly, and drive adoption to make the team meaningfully faster

About the Legal team

Our Legal team exists to help Mercury build faster and better – responsibly.

We focus on thinking from first principles, creating valuable business outcomes, producing high-quality work, and doing it in a super-collaborative, growth-oriented team setting. We partner closely with teams across the company and believe that good legal judgment, applied thoughtfully, enables innovation rather than standing in its way.

jobs.description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

About the Role

Fingerprint is looking for a Technical Product Manager (P3) to help turn product strategy into clear, well-executed product delivery. This role is ideal for someone who is building strong product management fundamentals, enjoys working closely with engineering and design, and is energized by keeping product work organized, well-documented, and moving toward release.

In this role, you will own specific product features or workstreams under the guidance of a Sr Technical Product Manager. You will help translate product intent into clear user stories, jobs-to-be-done, acceptance criteria, release plans, documentation, and operational updates. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Analytics, Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure product records are accurate, dependencies are visible, stakeholders are informed, and shipped work meets the expected customer and business outcomes.

This role blends TPM expectations with the Delivery Product Owner operating model: the Sr TPM sets product direction, priorities, success metrics, and major tradeoffs; the TPM helps ensure that direction becomes shippable, well-understood, and well-supported product increments.

What you’ll do

Product delivery and execution

  • Own delivery coordination for specific product features, epics, or workstreams within priorities and constraints set by the Sr TPM.
  • Translate Sr TPM intent into clear user stories, jobs-to-be-done, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done.
  • Maintain Jira epics, tasks, acceptance criteria, and delivery status in partnership with Engineering.
  • Keep systems of record accurate and current, including Notion, Jira, Productboard, and relevant roadmap or release tracking tools.
  • Support backlog refinement, sprint-ready sequencing, and release readiness activities.
  • Track delivery risks, open questions, dependencies, and decisions; escalate when a change impacts goals, metrics, customer commitments, timeline, scope, pricing, eligibility, or cross-stakeholder priorities.
  • Attend technical reviews and build enough technical context to follow architecture, implementation, and tradeoff discussions.

Product documentation and communication

  • Create and maintain clear feature documentation with oversight from a more senior TPM.
  • Document product use cases and represent assigned feature use cases confidently with internal stakeholders.
  • Support PRDs by creating clear user stories, JTBD, acceptance criteria, and customer/business context for assigned features.
  • Draft or support internal release notes, product updates, and stakeholder communications.
  • Help ensure developer documentation is updated when product behavior changes.
  • Communicate feature status, known limitations, delivery timing, and release readiness to internal stakeholders.

Customer, market, and product insight

  • Monitor relevant customer feedback channels, support channels, Productboard insights, and internal stakeholder requests.
  • Create insights for issues that may qualify as product limitations or product improvements.
  • Participate in customer discovery, customer brainstorms, user experience discussions, and product feedback sessions.
  • Collect qualitative and quantitative data to support prioritization conversations.
  • Understand the competitive landscape for assigned product areas and stay aware of relevant technical or market developments.

Product operations and launch support

  • Help maintain roadmap and feature records as work progresses through lifecycle stages.
  • Support product launch readiness by coordinating across Engineering, Product Marketing, CS, Sales, and Support.
  • Assist Product Marketing with customer education materials, release communication, and launch artifacts.
  • Help prepare product updates for internal forums such as CS/SE syncs or release channels.
  • Track post-launch success metrics for epics and issues, and help summarize learnings for future iterations.

What success looks like

A successful TPM at Fingerprint:

  • Owns specific product features or workstreams reliably, while operating within product priorities set by a Sr TPM or product leader.
  • Creates clear, actionable user stories, JTBD, acceptance criteria, and feature documentation.
  • Keeps Jira, Notion, Productboard, and roadmap records accurate and up to date.
  • Understands the technical domain well enough to articulate the needs of technical personas and participate in technical discussions.
  • Reviews Jira epics, tasks, and acceptance criteria with the Team Lead and Sr TPM.
  • Understands engineering estimates and can communicate delivery implications to the appropriate internal stakeholders with support.
  • Talks about and demonstrates specific product features confidently to internal stakeholders.
  • Articulates the product roadmap and current feature priorities, including relevant business priorities and JTBD, with assistance.
  • Collects qualitative and quantitative inputs for prioritization decisions.
  • Understands success metrics for epics and issues and helps track metrics post-launch.
  • Escalates appropriately when a decision moves beyond delivery execution and affects customer promises, business outcomes, product metrics, pricing, eligibility, or strategic priority.

Requirements for Success

  • Experience in product management, product ownership, business or product analysis, technical program management, solutions or support engineering, or a similar role working with technical products such as APIs, SaaS platforms, developer tools, fraud prevention, security, or analytics.
  • Strong written communication skills, including creating structured product documentation, developer guides, and stakeholder updates.
  • Familiarity with agile product development, backlog management, release readiness, and cross-functional delivery workflows for API and data-centric products.
  • Ability to partner with Engineering and Design to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria, and user experience expectations; comfort reading technical documentation and discussing implementation details with engineers.
  • Ability to use product analytics, customer feedback, and stakeholder input to support product decisions, with experience using tools such as Productboard, Notion, Jira, Amplitude, Sigma, SQL, or similar systems.
  • Attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and ownership of operational details, with a bias toward making ambiguous work clearer for the team.
  • Curiosity about customer problems, technical systems, and business tradeoffs; willingness to ask questions, suggest ideas, and learn product strategy through hands-on execution.
  • Experience supporting product launches, release notes, customer education, or GTM coordination.

Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $126k - $170k

  • Chicago: $126k - $145k

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. jobs.title: Group Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreCatalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group, funded entirely from its own operating cash.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group, funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, an investment education and research company that grew from two co-founders to 160+ people and 4,500+ paying members in four years. Its growth is heavily direct-response and driven by paid media.


Read This Before You Go Further

This is not the marketing job of a single education company, and it is not a brand-only role. You will run marketing across unlike businesses, each with a different customer, channel mix and economics. You will work with the senior people in each business, move between very different conversations in the same day, and be accountable for how customers are generated and what they cost.

Analytics and financial acumen come first. Brand and storytelling still matter and you will keep building them, but right now the group needs an operator who can read a P&L, find where customers are really coming from and shift effort to what works. We are a young, founder-led group that moves at an uncomfortable pace.

Why This Role Exists

Catalyst Capital has grown on the strength of one high-performing business and its direct-response engine. The group now spans education, publishing, software and investment vehicles. Each needs marketing designed for its own customer journey, and the group needs one leader who can see across all of them, allocate effort and spend where the return is best, and keep the brand and positioning coherent as the group expands.

Concretely, you will:

  • Own marketing strategy, budget and scoreboard across every business, tied to customers, revenue and pipeline.
  • Generate customers profitably in each business using the channels that fit it: direct response and paid media, organic and SaaS growth, events and partners.
  • Understand the metrics and the P&L of each business, and how marketing drives them.
  • Work with the senior leaders of each business, and lead the Head of Growth at Decentralized Masters.
  • Own conversion, positioning and brand across the group, and keep building them as the group repositions as an investment education and research business.
  • Protect the brand and reputation in a financial, investment-related category.

What You Will Own

1. Customer Acquisition & Revenue Accountability Across the Portfolio (Primary)

  • Own lead volume and quality, cost per acquisition, conversion and revenue contribution in each business.
  • Design and run the go-to-market for each business: direct response and paid media for Decentralized Masters and Future Finance, SaaS and organic growth for Legacy, events and partners for Inflection Club.
  • Oversee paid media, organic, affiliate, partnerships and lifecycle through business-level leaders.
  • Understand the full customer journey across channels, including retention, upsell and renewal, and how it sets allowable acquisition cost.
  • Decide where the next dollar and the next hour of marketing effort go across businesses.

2. Data, Analytics & P&L

  • Set analytics and attribution standards so every business can see what is working.
  • Understand each business's P&L and how marketing drives it. Partner with finance on unit economics, payback and spend guardrails.
  • Build, guide and oversee processes for budgetary control and accountability of all marketing spend.
  • Report on performance to the CEO and leadership team on a fixed rhythm.

3. Working Across Business Units

  • Work with the senior people in each business, adapt quickly between very different businesses and conversations, and keep a clear view of the umbrella group.
  • Build shared marketing services where they create real leverage, and keep them out where they would blur a business's own focus.
  • Partner with the CEO, COO, CFO, sales, product and education on launches, offers and messaging.
  • Own go-to-market for businesses in build.

4. Brand, Positioning & Conversion

  • Own positioning and messaging across the group, including the repositioning of Decentralized Masters as an investment education and research company.
  • Keep building brand across businesses and spokespeople, and make positioning a conversion lever, not just a style guide.
  • Own brand governance and creative standards across a fast-moving, distributed team.

5. Team & Network

  • Lead the senior marketing leaders, including the Decentralized Masters growth leader, and develop the talent already here.
  • Bring an agency-style playbook and a strong network of agencies, media partners and operators, and put it to work for the group.
  • Set clear goals, operating rhythms and accountability across businesses.

6. Compliance, Reputation & Risk

  • Ensure marketing claims and messaging are appropriate for a financial and investment audience across education, publishing, software and investment products, working with legal and compliance.
  • Own public communications, press and crisis response.
  • Manage brand safety across ads, influencers, affiliates and partners.

Requirements

What You Must Bring

Required

  • 12+ years in marketing, including 5+ years in senior leadership (CMO, VP Marketing, agency leader or equivalent) at a company or agency that grew meaningfully.
  • Direct-response expertise and a record of generating customers profitably, including high-ticket and low-ticket funnels and paid media at scale.
  • Strong analytics: you understand the metrics for each channel and funnel, can read a P&L, and can show how marketing drives it.
  • Experience managing marketing across more than one business, brand or client, ideally at agency level, and the ability to pivot between them.
  • Understanding of customer journeys across channels, including SaaS, organic, events and partner-led growth, not only paid media.
  • Strong conversion and positioning skills, and a record of building brand alongside performance.
  • A strong professional network of agencies, partners and operators.
  • A record of hiring, developing and leading senior marketers.
  • Executive presence: credible with founders, senior business leaders, partners and press.
  • A prolific, demonstrable user of AI tools in marketing work. You can show us what you have built or automated.

Strongly Preferred

  • Familiarity with the financial landscape and investment-related offers, and AGORA-style financial publishing.
  • Experience marketing in a regulated or closely scrutinized category, including investment products or funds.
  • Experience with SaaS growth and subscription or continuity economics.
  • Experience with events and partner-led growth.
  • Experience supporting an institutional capital raise or sale process from the marketing side.
  • Experience leading a distributed, international team.

Personality & Cultural Fit

  • Direct communicator who challenges the founders with data, in the room, in real time.
  • Equally credible with a media buyer, a SaaS leader and an institutional adviser.
  • Entrepreneurial and comfortable in ambiguity: you build the answer rather than wait for the brief.
  • Operator mindset with the discipline of a finance leader and the instincts of a marketer.
  • Zero tolerance for sloppy work, in your team or in yourself.
  • Effective in a high-performance culture

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive Base
  • Performance bonus tied to revenue and growth outcomes.
  • Full-time, 40 hours a week, with a flexible schedule and unlimited PTO.
  • Entirely remote, working from anywhere in the world, with team off-sites.
  • Direct access to the founders, a peer relationship with the Group COO and Group CFO, and genuine authority over marketing across the group.
  • An inherited growth engine and team, so you are building on a working system rather than starting from zero.
  • A supportive, dynamic culture with team members across 30+ countries.

If you are a brand director looking for a bigger title without the accountability for numbers, this is not it.

If you have generated customers profitably across more than one business, understand the P&L behind it, and want to do it again from profitability with your own mandate, we should talk.

jobs.excerpt: IntellaTriage continues to GROW! IntellaTriage Nurses enjoy the benefits of working from home, providing care, without the stress and expense of commuting each day!
jobs.description:
IntellaTriage continues to GROW!

IntellaTriage Nurses enjoy the benefits of working from home, providing care, without the stress and expense of commuting each day!

**MUST have or be willing to obtain a Compact RN license

**MUST live in/work from a Compact US state

**Minimum of 2 years as a Nurse

**Minimum of 1 year of experience in a fast-paced environment (i.e. ED, Critical Care, Surgical Services, Med/Surg, etc.)

**Must have high speed internet

**Must be tech savvy, enjoy a fast-paced environment, and have no concerns typing

**Must be available to work 2 out of every 3 weekends & 1 weekday per week.

> 3 shifts per 2 week pay period Mon-Fri, rotating 5p-11p CST

> 2 of every 3 weekend rotation (Sat & Sun) rotating 8a-4p/ 2p-10p

Our Nurse Advice Line Nurses:

  • Have proven experience in a fast-paced, critical-thinking environment; ED, Critical Care, Surgical Services, etc.
  • Work a minimum of 2-3 shift per week (Mon-Fri).
  • Preferred scheduling for their weekday requirements.
  • Work 2 weekends or every 3 weeks, both Saturday and Sunday on those weekends with rotating times. (For example: weekend 1: work, weekend 2: work, weekend 3: off)
  • Train for 3 weeks. First week is Monday-Thursday 9a-6p CST. Remaining two weeks training will be dependent upon preceptor availability but will likely be an evening shift.
  • Must have a compact license and live in that compact state. (no states with pending legislation or future implementation dates are considered current compacts)

What is important to know?

We are growing and excited to be able to support our clients’ nursing staffs in the field who need time to focus on work-life balance, as well, while being able to trust that we are there to support them and their patients during nights and weekends!

  • Patient care is #1. We do not have call quotas. We employ the best nurses to provide the best care.
  • When our patients or their families reach our triage line, they immediately speak directly with a nurse.
  • We do not have PRN positions.
  • We are super busy. If you like fast-paced roles, keep reading…
  • Any nurse may pick up additional shifts, if shifts are available for the clients’ they are trained to support.
  • We will provide you with a laptop and headset.
  • Nurses are required to provide their own high-speed internet (only fiberoptic or coaxial cable internet is compatible with our remote call center technology).
  • Our laptop is required to be directly connected to your modem. Working through Wi-Fi is not compatible with our systems. The calls will drop.
  • It is essential to have a home office or quiet space free from noise or distractions in your home (Privacy/HIPAA compliant space is required).
  • Training is provided remotely and is paid; no travel is required in this role.
  • MUST be able to follow instructions (verbal and written) and be comfortable with technology (tech savvy).
  • Must remain in good standing and ensure their home state license remains active.
  • IntellaTriage will cover the cost of non-compact state licensure based on the client(s) that are assigned for support.
  • All nurses must have a compact license and reside/work in that state.
  • Shift prep is a minimum clock-in of 30 minutes prior to taking calls; this is paid time to prepare.
  • Once calls roll to the next team/shift, our nurses remain clocked in and complete any remaining charting before leaving for the day. This may take 30 minutes or this may take 2 hours. It depends on the pace of the calls received during that shift and the pace of your ability to quickly navigate technology and type.

Sound exciting to you?

Then… put those days on the floor and that commute or hours on the road between patients’ homes behind you! Our nurses enjoy working from their own home office; no more purchasing scrubs, expensive takeout, and the large gas bill along with extra wear-and-tear on your vehicle.

Most importantly, working remotely enables you to spend more time with those you love!

Requirements

  • MUST have or be willing to obtain a Compact Nursing License (States with pending legislation or future implementation dates are not considered current compacts until the implementation date.)
  • 3+ years as a RN
  • Experience in a fast-paced environment: i.e. ED, Surgical Services, or Critical Care.
  • Must be comfortable with technology and accessing multiple applications remotely to perform documentation during calls.
  • Ability and comfort typing.
  • Fluency in English is required, additional languages are a bonus.
  • Must physically reside in the U.S. and be legally eligible to work for any employer.
  • Must be able to complete the 3-week orientation and training (Schedule listed in this posting).
  • Must be available to work Saturday & Sunday on your team's required weekends; 2 of every 3 weekends.
  • Holidays as they are required (rotation).
  • Able to handle stress and multitask when calls are coming in (minimum of 5+ calls per hour on weekdays, and much higher on weekends).
  • Able to communicate with patients and families with empathy while also maintaining adherence to client protocols.
  • Must maintain CEU’s as designated by the states you are answering calls in.
  • Must attend any in-services, additional training on an as needed basis.
  • Able to pass background check and nurse licensing check.

Benefits

All Remote Nurse Advice Line RN's, once trained to their originally assigned team are at $25/hourly. All part-time nurses accumulate PTO, based on the number of hours they work (per year). All part-time nurses receive an additional 3-paid-sick-days per year. All part-time nurses are eligible to participate in our 401(k) plan.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are seeking a Senior Staff Security Researcher to join our Agentic Security Operations Center (SOC) Content-Layer Research team in a remote position within the United States (with an in-office preference for Santa Clara, CA), reporting directly to the Director of Security Research. In this critical individual contributor role, you will lead the content layer, architecting the connectors, normalization mappings, and security data models that transform raw telemetry from dozens of enterprise vendors across EDR, identity, cloud, network, and vulnerability feeds into structured context our AI agents can reason over. Partnering closely with AI engineers, platform architects, product managers, and global research teams, you will directly govern data quality and drive measurable improvements in the accuracy and reliability of agentic conclusions.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor, inspect, and evaluate agentic incidents and investigations across customer environments, performing root-cause analysis across source alerts, data pipelines, and agent reasoning to supply evidence-backed feedback to the AI team
  • Define necessary telemetry fields and contextual requirements for analyst-grade investigations while ensuring the content layer reliably surfaces required data across all detection surfaces
  • Research, analyze, and onboard end-to-end telemetry from emerging security vendor APIs and log schemas, mapping them seamlessly into a unified security data model
  • Architect telemetry normalization, multi-source correlation, and governance frameworks to maintain strict data integrity and consistency across hundreds of vendor mappings
  • Design, implement, and benchmark incident rules and triage logic to eliminate false positives and validate the precision of alert grouping

Who You Are

  • You are a recognized technical authority in threat detection and security telemetry who establishes strategic technical standards rather than merely executing defined tasks.
  • You are an autonomous, hands-on individual contributor with a proven record of driving complex technical roadmap deliverables from inception to production.
  • You bring exceptional analytical discipline and research rigor to troubleshooting complex data regressions, schema inconsistencies, and model evaluation challenges.
  • You excel at cross-functional partnership, articulating intricate technical problems with clarity to software engineers, AI researchers, and SOC analysts alike.
  • You are deeply committed to data governance and proactive quality baselines, preventing customer-facing regressions and continuously elevating detection efficacy.

What We're Looking For

  • Practical experience working with, evaluating, or optimizing AI agents, large language models, or automated reasoning workflows in security operations or threat analysis
  • 10+ years of dedicated experience in security engineering, detection engineering, threat hunting, or threat research within an enterprise SOC, MDR provider, or security vendor
  • Comprehensive expertise in enterprise security telemetry schemas and trust boundaries across endpoint (EDR), identity (Entra ID, Okta, Active Directory), cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP audit logs), and network (ZTNA, proxy, firewall, DNS)
  • Advanced analytical and data querying proficiency using SQL or equivalent data analysis languages to establish baselines, perform impact analysis, and validate raw telemetry
  • Hands-on proficiency modifying schemas and data pipelines using Python and JSON alongside the demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt proprietary query tools and APIs
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills capable of translating complex security telemetry and AI behaviors into actionable technical specifications

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Specialized expertise designing, evaluating, and fine-tuning multi-agent architectures or autonomous LLM reasoning frameworks for threat triage and incident response
  • Strong background in offensive security, red teaming, or penetration testing with the insight to evaluate whether agent-constructed attack timelines and narratives are technically plausible
  • Practical experience with open security data schemas (e.g., OCSF, ECS, Google UDM, Splunk CIM) combined with a track record of developing commercial security products in high-growth environments

das wichtigste in kürze

Standort: 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands möglich, gerne bist du aber in unseren schönen Büros in Berlin oder Rostock willkommen.

Anstellung: Vollzeit, unbefristet

Vergütung: 50.000–60.000 € Fixgehalt plus leistungsabhängigen Bonus
Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine in Deutschland erforderlich

Start: ab sofort oder nach Absprache

deine aufgaben

  • Du führst Erstgespräche mit IT-Leitung, Head of Infrastructure und Geschäftsführung in der technischen Tiefe

was du mitbringst

du bist uns wichtig

About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Trase:

Trase is AI, Uncomplicated. Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase is an end-to-end platform for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise—bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption to drive efficiency and significant cost savings.

We’re in production at Duke Health, where our agents save over 5,490 hours of clinical labor annually in a single department. We’ve raised $10.5M from Red Cell Partners and top the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. Now we’re scaling.

Senior Product Manager, Origin: Enterprise AI Platform

You'll own the product experience for the people who deploy, administer, and govern AI agents across an organization. Your job is to make it easy for customers to put agents into production, understand how they're operating, understand and accept risk, and maintain the controls and trust their business requires.

You’ll be the product manager for Trase Origin, our platform for deploying and governing AI agents. You’ll work with customers, sales and presales, GRC, and our federal team to gather requirements, then write the PRDs engineering builds from. You'll own strategy, discovery, priorities, delivery, and results.

What You Will Do

  • Understand the customer: Work directly with administrators, platform teams, and governance stakeholders. Learn how they operate, where adoption gets stuck, and which problems matter enough to solve.
  • Set direction and ship: Define the outcomes, choose what to build, and work with engineering and design to deliver it. Make clear tradeoffs, keep the scope useful, and follow through after launch.
  • Make enterprise AI manageable: Own experiences that help customers administer agents, manage access and policies, and understand activity, usage, and cost across their organization.
  • Build trust into the product: Help customers evaluate risk, approve agents for production, and maintain visibility and accountability. Partner with GRC and our federal team to translate customer requirements into engineering deliverables to ship usable product capabilities.
  • Support production operations: Give operators the visibility and controls they need to monitor agents, understand problems, and keep them running reliably.
  • Drive product-led growth: Make installation, setup, and adoption straightforward across managed and customer-operated environments. Reduce the friction between evaluating the platform and putting it to work.
  • Own the results: Connect product decisions to adoption, customer value, and licensing revenue. Work with sales and product marketing to understand buying barriers and help customers succeed.

About You

  • You've owned and shipped enterprise software used by administrators, platform teams, or security and governance stakeholders.
  • You can work through complex technical and organizational requirements and turn them into a clear, usable product.
  • You think like an entrepreneur. You find valuable problems, test your assumptions, and decide where to invest.
  • You assume you can change the outcome and act on it. You go find the customers, evidence, and collaborators you need without waiting for someone to hand you a plan.
  • You learn quickly, ask precise questions, and exercise sound judgment when the information is incomplete.
  • You ship. You make decisions, resolve obstacles, and stay accountable for whether the work improves the customer's experience.
  • You understand that enterprise controls and ease of adoption both matter, and you have experience making them work together.

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, or production observability.
  • Experience with identity, access management, governance, or compliance capabilities.
  • Experience serving regulated enterprises or government customers.
  • Experience with self-service enterprise software, cloud marketplaces, or multiple deployment models.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer to help ensure that AI-powered features across Bask Health behave accurately, reliably, and consistently before and after they reach production.

Bask Health supports the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting patient experiences, merchant operations, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce capabilities. As we introduce more AI-powered functionality, we need dependable ways to verify that these systems work as intended under realistic conditions.

You'll build and maintain evaluation workflows that test large language models, AI assistants, retrieval systems, and automated features against clearly defined product requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role that combines AI evaluation, software testing, automation, and production quality assurance. You'll develop test scenarios, evaluation datasets, automated checks, and tools that help engineering teams identify problems before they affect users.

Your work may include testing AI-generated responses, validating structured outputs, evaluating tool-calling behavior, checking retrieval accuracy, and identifying regressions caused by changes to prompts, models, or application code.

You'll collaborate with applied AI engineers, machine learning engineers, backend engineers, product managers, and quality-focused engineering teams to define expected behavior and translate those expectations into repeatable evaluations.

You'll also help establish processes for reviewing AI failures, documenting recurring issues, and determining whether a feature meets its acceptance criteria. You'll work with engineers to reproduce problems and verify that fixes address the underlying issue.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll pay particular attention to privacy, permissions, unsupported medical claims, and AI behavior that could interfere with approved clinical or pharmacy workflows. Evaluation systems should help verify that AI features remain within their intended operational boundaries.

This position emphasizes practical testing, thoughtful engineering, and continuous improvement. You'll contribute to evaluation standards while independently implementing and maintaining the tools and tests that support AI quality.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys finding difficult edge cases, understands how AI behavior differs from traditional deterministic software, and wants to help build products that users can depend on.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement evaluation workflows for AI-powered applications across Bask Health.
  • Build automated tests for large language model outputs and AI application behavior.
  • Develop evaluation datasets that represent realistic user requests and product workflows.
  • Create test scenarios for patient-facing, merchant-facing, and internal AI features.
  • Implement checks for response accuracy, relevance, completeness, and consistency.
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for unsupported claims and misleading information.
  • Test structured model outputs for schema compliance and application compatibility.
  • Build evaluations for AI tool calling and authorized action execution.
  • Validate that AI assistants respect application permissions and tenant boundaries.
  • Test retrieval-augmented generation systems for grounding and information relevance.
  • Develop regression tests that identify unexpected changes in AI behavior.
  • Integrate evaluation checks into engineering development and release workflows.
  • Create automated comparison tests for prompts, model versions, and configuration changes.
  • Develop scripts and utilities that simplify AI evaluation execution.
  • Build reporting tools that summarize evaluation results and failure patterns.
  • Investigate failed evaluations and help engineers reproduce underlying issues.
  • Work with product managers to define expected AI behavior and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with applied AI engineers to improve prompts and application logic.
  • Test AI applications against unusual inputs, ambiguous requests, and difficult edge cases.
  • Develop evaluation cases for prompt injection and unauthorized tool-use attempts.
  • Support human review workflows for outputs that require subjective assessment.
  • Track recurring AI failures and help prioritize reliability improvements.
  • Monitor production evaluation signals and investigate quality regressions.
  • Document test coverage, evaluation procedures, and known limitations.
  • Improve evaluation efficiency, repeatability, and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews, engineering planning, and technical discussions.
  • Support controlled testing and rollout of new AI-powered features.
  • Own assigned AI evaluation projects from test design through implementation, reporting, and ongoing improvement.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, test automation, quality engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience developing automated tests for production software applications.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable languages.
  • Familiarity with large language models and modern AI-powered applications.
  • Understanding of software testing methodologies and test case design.
  • Experience building automated testing scripts, frameworks, or validation tools.
  • Familiarity with API testing and backend application integrations.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and common AI model failure modes.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated responses against expected requirements.
  • Experience working with structured data and validating application outputs.
  • Familiarity with regression testing and software release processes.
  • Experience debugging application failures and reproducing technical issues.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure application behavior.
  • Familiarity with databases and application data models.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
  • Understanding of continuous integration and automated testing pipelines.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to create clear, reproducible test cases.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Ability to distinguish application defects from model behavior limitations.
  • Experience documenting technical issues and communicating findings.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based application environments.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a quality-focused engineering mindset.
  • Ability to independently own evaluation and test automation projects.

Nice to Have

  • Experience evaluating large language models or generative AI applications.
  • Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model APIs.
  • Experience with LangSmith, DeepEval, Ragas, promptfoo, or comparable evaluation tools.
  • Familiarity with LLM-as-a-judge evaluation techniques.
  • Experience developing AI evaluation datasets and test benchmarks.
  • Understanding of human evaluation and response labeling workflows.
  • Experience testing retrieval-augmented generation systems.
  • Familiarity with embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
  • Experience evaluating AI agents and tool-calling behavior.
  • Familiarity with prompt injection testing and AI security evaluations.
  • Experience implementing AI regression tests in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience building automated evaluation reports or dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Playwright, Jest, Vitest, Pytest, or comparable testing frameworks.
  • Experience testing TypeScript or Node.js applications.

Localpayment is a fintech company specializing in local and cross-border payment solutions for emerging markets. Our platform enables global companies to accept payments in local currencies through native methods in each country, facilitating their international expansion.
In 2024, Localpayment entered into a strategic partnership with Aleph Group, a global technology and digital media company. This collaboration enhances our capabilities and reach, combining robust payment infrastructure with a broader digital ecosystem.
We are looking for a Treasury Banking & Partnerships Specialist to build and manage the network of banks, crypto exchanges and investment counterparties behind Localpayment's Treasury services: multicurrency wire-in/wire-out, stablecoin liquidity and the investment of cash balances, taking each relationship from prospecting to live operation.
Reports to: Head of Treasury. Location: Remote (occasional travel). Scope: Global, Treasury services (multicurrency wires, crypto, investments).
How do we work?
You’ll join a collaborative team that values autonomy, initiative, and quality to build robust and scalable solutions that power global payments.

Responsibilities

• Multicurrency banking: prospect and onboard banks, correspondent banks and global account providers for USD, EUR and other currencies, improving coverage, cut-offs and costs of international wires.
  • Crypto exchanges & OTC: develop relationships with exchanges and stablecoin (USDT/USDC) OTC desks for fiat/crypto conversion, liquidity and custody, within approved limits.
  • Investments: source and onboard banks, brokers, money market fund managers and custodians for the placement of corporate and operational cash.
  • Negotiate fees, FX spreads, limits, cut-off times, SLAs and contractual terms.
  • Lead onboarding with Compliance, Legal, Tax, Operations and Engineering: KYC/due diligence, contracts, and API, host-to-host or TMS connectivity.
  • Manage the counterparty portfolio and pipeline: coverage gaps and backups by currency, scorecards, counterparty risk and reporting to the Head of Treasury.
  • Coordinate with Localpayment's Partnerships team (Operations), which owns local payment rails, to avoid overlap and share market intelligence.
  • Drive AI-based automation of banking and partnerships work, including counterparty research, pipeline and scorecard analysis, onboarding documentation, and bank/partner communications.

Requirements

• Experience: 4+ years in banking relationships, transaction banking, FI coverage or treasury business development at a bank, PSP, cross-border fintech, EMI or crypto exchange.
  • Wires & multicurrency: international payments, SWIFT, correspondent banking, multicurrency accounts and cut-off management.
  • Crypto: working knowledge of exchanges, stablecoin OTC desks, on/off-ramps and related compliance (KYC/KYB, Travel Rule).
  • Investments: short-term instruments (time deposits, money market funds, T-bills) and counterparty risk.
  • Languages: Spanish and advanced English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Python and SQL to automate cash positions, reconciliations, quotes and reporting.
  • AI proficiency: daily hands-on use of generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or similar) to automate and analyze treasury partnerships work such as counterparty research, pipeline and scorecard analysis, fee and contract comparison, reporting and bank/partner communications; building prompts, agents or automations; and critical judgment of AI outputs and data risks, using company-approved tools.
  • Advanced Excel (models, pivot tables, Power Query) and hands-on use of online banking platforms and banking APIs.
  • Nice to have: Network with banks and EMIs in Europe and LatAm; TMS experience (e.g., Kyriba); degree in Finance, Economics, Business or Engineering.
The hiring process will assess practical, hands-on use of AI tools applied to treasury work.

Benefits

• Be part of a high-impact company growing across global markets.
  • Work on meaningful challenges in the fintech space.
  • Join a fast-paced, remote-first environment backed by Aleph Group.
  • Competitive compensation and opportunities for growth.

jobs.description:
Opportunity:

DeVry University focuses on developing long-term relationships with superior instructors who have high professional standards, excellent communication skills, enthusiasm and a commitment to providing the finest practitioner-focused education. We are seeking primarily industry professionals to teach and share their knowledge and experience with undergraduate and graduate students in a variety of fields.

Courses meet once or twice a week for eight weeks. Face-to-face interaction is blended with technology (such as online discussions and online assignments) for an enhanced learning environment. Faculty are responsible for facilitating student learning by teaching courses and programs in accordance with DeVry University requirements. Faculty develop course syllabi and lesson plans and apply teaching techniques to best achieve course and programmatic objectives. All DeVry instructors will participate in a comprehensive faculty training program and ongoing faculty development activities to ensure the highest quality instruction. DeVry University does not guarantee any specific number of work hours or assignments, which may vary based on the University’s needs and discretion. As you explore this opportunity, we invite you to view this brief video highlighting how our faculty engage in meaningful student support.

Responsibilities:

Develops and provides students with an approved DeVry University syllabus that follows a template established by the local campus, and which includes the terminal course objectives. Organizes, prepares, and regularly revises and updates all course materials. Uses appropriate technological options for online technologies and course-related software, including Websites, e-mail, and online discussions for preparing the course and making it accessible to students. Models effective oral and written communications that engage the students, provide clarity, and improve student learning. Sets clear expectations for the course by publishing course terminal objectives, assignment/examinations dates, and weight the distribution of various evaluation categories. Ensures that the content and level of material included on exams correspond to the course terminal objectives. Demonstrates consistency and fairness in the preparation and grading of exams and provides timely feedback to students. Embraces and integrates the responsible use of AI technologies in the classroom to enhance teaching and learning outcomes. Demonstrates the ability to recognize, evaluate, and address appropriate and inappropriate student use of AI tools in academic work. Completes other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

A doctorate in Engineering Technology, Engineering, Applied Engineering, Industrial Technology, or a closely related field is required, with at least 18 graduate credit hours in engineering technology, applied engineering, systems engineering, electronics, manufacturing technology, or related technical disciplines.

Applicants must upload unofficial graduate-level transcripts with their application. Degrees must be awarded by an institution accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation, or by an international institution determined to hold equivalent accreditation.

Three to five years of applied professional experience in engineering technology, technical systems implementation, manufacturing environments, industrial systems, or applied engineering roles. Demonstrated experience with applied engineering technologies and technical systems, including the use of modern tools, instrumentation, automation systems, or engineering technologies used in industry environments. Industry-recognized certifications or professional credentials relevant to engineering technology, industrial systems, automation, or applied technical disciplines. Strong subject matter expertise in applied engineering principles and technical problem-solving, combined with effective communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse learners. Knowledge of engineering standards, safety practices, and quality assurance processes within technical and industrial environments. Faculty must have a commitment to ongoing professional development in instructional technology, digital literacy, and responsible AI practices. Additional requirements driven by state licensing, institutional policy, or accreditation standards may apply.

Preferred Qualifications:

Industry certifications related to engineering technology, industrial automation, manufacturing systems, or applied technical disciplines. Experience with modern engineering technologies, such as automation systems, robotics, instrumentation, computer-aided design, or advanced manufacturing technologies. Experience applying systems engineering principles, including technical troubleshooting, process improvement, and system integration. Experience with industry quality and operational frameworks, including continuous improvement, production management, or technical project management. Experience with programmatic or regional accreditation processes, including outcomes assessment, curriculum alignment, and continuous improvement initiatives. Two to five years of teaching experience at the post-secondary level, preferably in engineering technology, applied engineering, electronics technology, industrial technology, or related technical disciplines. Active membership or engagement in professional engineering or engineering technology organizations to maintain current industry knowledge and professional engagement. Experience integrating laboratory-based instruction, technical simulations, engineering design projects, and applied problem-solving activities into post-secondary instruction to support hands-on learning

Pay:

Visiting Professor pay is based on level, credit hours taught per 8-week session, and location.

Pay may vary in most states from $1500-$2700 per 8-week session.

Pay in the states of AZ, CA, IN and PA is paid at an hourly rate of either $22.00/hour or $23.50/hour.

jobs.title: Search Ads Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Strategic Finance is a high-visibility, high-impact role embedded in the company’s decision-making core. You will partner with our executive, product, and go-to-market (GTM) teams, owning the financial modeling and analysis that drives our product and corporate strategy, optimizes our GTM engine, and informs critical operational decisions.

What you’ll do:

  • Partner with Product and GTM leaders to evaluate the financial ROI and viability of new products, business lines, and R&D investments.
  • Own the long-range plan, connecting product and revenue metrics to financial outcomes and keeping reporting accurate, timely, and consistent.
  • Build and maintain financial models that translate operating plans into outcomes, risks, and opportunities, including unit economics, pricing analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives on resource allocation, operational efficiency, and scaling business processes.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, corporate finance, or investment banking.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, with a rigorous, quantitative approach to forecasting, budgeting, and measuring operational performance.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial concepts into clear narratives for non-financial stakeholders and to partner with senior leaders.
  • A high standard for operational excellence and a clear sense of how to turn ambiguous business questions into actionable plans.

  • Commitment to our values:

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

This position is responsible for managing the complete project lifecycle, coordinating cross-functional technical teams, overseeing resources and budgets, and ensuring the successful delivery of projects aligned with customer objectives, contractual requirements, and federal cybersecurity standards.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience managing large-scale IT and cybersecurity projects, strong technical knowledge of enterprise infrastructure and cloud environments, and demonstrated expertise in Agile project management methodologies. The candidate must demonstrate exceptional leadership, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate diverse technical teams, and engage effectively with senior government stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions on schedule and within budget.

  • Project Planning, Scope & Resource Management: Develop comprehensive project management plans defining project scope, objectives, deliverables, resource requirements, budgets, staffing needs, schedules, and major milestones. Assess project dependencies, acquire necessary resources, and establish realistic execution strategies to support successful delivery.
  • Agile Project Execution & Delivery Management: Apply Agile methodologies and project management best practices to initiate, plan, execute, monitor, and close technical projects. Break complex initiatives into manageable development cycles, prioritize workstreams, and improve team productivity, delivery timelines, and responsiveness to changing requirements.
  • Cybersecurity & Engineering Project Coordination: Manage day-to-day execution of technical projects across Security Operations Center (SOC), Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM), CI/CD, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, cloud infrastructure, and engineering teams. Coordinate with development and engineering teams to manage enhancements, defects, technical requirements, and architectural dependencies while promoting continuous improvement in delivery processes.
  • Project Performance, Risk & Milestone Tracking: Establish and maintain project schedules, performance metrics, risk registers, action items, and deliverable tracking mechanisms. Monitor project progress, identify potential delays or resource constraints, implement corrective actions, and provide timely reporting to leadership and customer stakeholders.
  • Budget Management & Operational Oversight: Manage project budgets, resource utilization, staffing allocations, and operational priorities to ensure efficient execution of large-scale IT initiatives. Oversee technical implementation activities involving enterprise systems, application integration, deployment, user support, and training across diverse operational environments.

Facilitate project planning discussions, communicate technical progress, resolve execution challenges, and obtain stakeholder approval for scope, schedule, cost, and quality management plans.

Maintain project documentation, support governance and compliance activities, and identify opportunities to improve project delivery efficiency, operational effectiveness, and overall service quality.

Demonstrated ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams consisting of personnel with diverse technical skills, job classifications, and operational responsibilities.
