jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era.  Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it.
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

  • Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
  • Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
  • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.
  • Clear writing and comfort working async: we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English.

The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises.
  • Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity.
  • Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own the adoption metrics: you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it.
  • Lots of room to improve: we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far.
  • Your own engineering team: you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Small numbers: we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating.
  • No playbook: this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.

jobs.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.


We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world's most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come.


Gilead is seeking a development and regulatory counsel to join its Global Development & PDM Legal Business Partner team. The candidate will serve as a primary point of contact for the business, be responsible for advising and collaborating on a range of regulatory and development matters throughout the product lifecycle, liaise with other legal experts, and develop solutions for complex business matters.

The successful candidate will be able to work independently and possess a strong knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical regulatory laws, rules and regulations, industry practices and standards, and have demonstrated experience in analyzing complex issues and developing innovative solutions to business challenges. The candidate will possess a strong business acumen and legal expertise to proactively identify, analyze, and navigate potential legal and compliance considerations and risk within areas of responsibility and formulate and communicate compliant and practical solutions that meet business objectives. The candidate will work closely with Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory CMC, Quality, Global Patient Safety, Program Strategy Teams (PSTs), Development Teams, Clinical, and global affiliates. The candidate will work across Gilead’s Corporate and Legal organization to coordinate and communicate legal input on matters in collaboration with other Gilead Legal Business Partners, the Office of Ethics and Compliance, Government Affairs, and Public Affairs, across geographic and therapeutic areas.


While this position is posted as remote, candidates who are based Foster City, CA and able to work onsite are strongly preferred.


Core Job Responsibilities Include

  • Serving as a Legal Business Partner to global Development functions, including Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Policy and Intelligence, R&D Quality, Patient Safety, and cross-functional Gilead Asset Teams (GATs);
  • Providing legal guidance for the portfolio of Gilead products on GXP requirements, adverse-event reporting, data integrity, clinical data management, inspection and audit readiness, quality investigations, product quality and CMC matters, and regulatory submissions and health-authority interactions; Advising the business on a variety of supply chain issues, including drug shortages, product recalls and regional export and import requirements;
  • Keeping up to date and maintain knowledge advising on pertinent regulatory developments relevant to the business in the U.S. and key international markets;
  • Assisting in the drafting and review of agreements related to various business needs, including Quality Agreements;
  • Advising across the product lifecycle, including development strategy, regulatory pathways, established-product considerations, loss of exclusivity, strategic discontinuation or withdrawal of marketing authorizations, and regulatory data protection
  • Providing regulatory and development counsel to the Corporate Legal team for mergers and acquisitions, licenses, collaborations, and other strategic transactions;
  • Providing legal interpretation of complex and evolving regulatory requirements and translating them into risk-based compliance programs, governance structures, policies, controls, and operational processes that enable compliant execution of business objectives;
  • Proactively identifying the need for, draft, and provide legal advice on corporate policies, SOPs, and guidance documents;
  • Supporting and collaborating with a global matrix of teams effectively, including partnering with other members in Legal, Ethics and Compliance, Government Affairs, Public Affairs, in Foster City and international affiliates, including the Intercontinental Region (ICR) and Global Patient Solutions (GPS),to ensure consistency in guidance and approach across areas of the overall business and help the business operate within legal, regulatory, and ethical requirements;
  • Establishing strong partnership relationships with global Research and Development teams, as well as key cross functional teams engaged in development activities, characterized by a high-level of collaboration, responsiveness, strong understanding of scientific and business objectives, and mutual respect;
  • Driving increased efficiency, coordination, and effectiveness of legal advice, processes, and support to meet the needs of the business and other key stakeholders;
  • Defining, direct, and conscientiously manage the work of outside counsel; and
  • Providing senior business stakeholders with training and updates, policy support, and learnings to support effective risk management.
  • U.S. Juris Doctorate (J.D.) degree; active law license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction;

Basic Qualifications:

  • U.S. Juris Doctorate (J.D.) degree; active law license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, 6+ years of legal experience supporting clients in the pharmaceutical industry, preferably at a multinational company and/or a reputable, highly rated law firm, or a combination of both;

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience advising clients on FDA and regulatory matters, preferably with some device expertise;
  • Ability to exercise judgment and independently determine and take appropriate action;
  • Ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical recommendations and solutions and clearly communicate requirements and rationale for advice;
  • Ability to manage workload priorities in a matrixed environment;
  • Experience handling multiple projects in fast-paced environment, with a high degree of client service orientation, and performing successfully in cross-functional teams;
  • Able to independently handle complex matters with minimal supervision and an understanding of when to elevate issues to senior management for awareness or decision-making;
  • Proven judgment in working through complex issues, including those with significant strategic risk considerations;
  • Demonstration of excellent interpersonal, strategic thinking, communication, and organizational skills; and
  • Consistent demonstration of Gilead’s core values: Teamwork, Accountability, Inclusion, Excellence and Integrity.


Critical Success Factors


  • Judgment:Demonstrates expertise and sound judgment, understands how assigned responsibilities support Gilead’s business objectives, and is able to provide practical, risk-balanced advice based upon a thorough understanding of the scope of an issue, taking full advantage of internal networks and external intelligence. Ability to work in grey areas and solution oriented.
  • Collaboration:Works in close collaboration with others to gain a firm understanding of available legal, functional, and business resources; integrates information from a number of sources; capably navigates a matrixed environment; and works well in a team in order to achieve optimal business results.
  • Anticipation: Anticipates changes in law, enforcement, and/or business objectives; proactively recognizes challenges; develops contingency plans; and adapts approach as necessary to manage risks effectively and mitigate issues before they arise.
  • Influencing Skills: Builds strong relationships with business partners to tactfully influence and gain their support to drive desired outcomes. Represents Gilead externally to trade associations and government agencies.

People Leader Accountabilities

  • Create Inclusion – knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.

Leidos is seeking a Windows System Engineer to support Federal Civil customer in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

POSITION SUMMARY:

This position supports the engineering, operation, maintenance, and modernization of secure, mission-critical enterprise Windows Server and hybrid cloud infrastructure across geographically distributed environments. The Windows System Engineer partners with the Senior Windows System Engineer to implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows, virtualization, and cloud solutions across on-premises and hybrid environments. You’ll collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, and service desk teams to ensure system availability, performance, and security, while supporting infrastructure modernization, documentation, configuration management, and continuous improvement.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, implement, and administer Windows Server environments (2012, 2016, 2019, 2022), Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Microsoft 365, alongside core infrastructure services including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V, PKI, Group Policy (GPO), and file/print services.

  • Support the planning, deployment, and lifecycle replacement of server infrastructure under senior engineering guidance. Assess, install, and recommend innovative technologies across databases, systems management, virtualization, network storage, and security measures.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of Client/Server architecture to deploy solutions securely within internal and external production environments.
  • Continuously monitor system health, availability, performance, and capacity trends. Gather operational metrics and implement approved improvements to proactively prevent incidents and strengthen service delivery.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues involving multiple interconnected systems, implementing approved corrective actions and escalating complex architectural challenges to the Senior Windows System Engineer as needed.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and change tickets throughout their entire lifecycle, ensuring technical accuracy, thorough documentation, and strict adherence to SLAs.
  • Participate in incident investigations by gathering diagnostic data, identifying root causes, recommending solutions, and executing corrective and preventive tasks.
  • Create, update, and maintain system diagrams, configuration records, technical implementation plans, disaster recovery procedures, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for common issue resolution.
  • Collaborate within a hybrid, multi-location operations team alongside internal engineering groups, security teams, vendors, and service providers to coordinate maintenance windows and execute technical tasks.
  • Communicate technical information, status updates, and project progress clearly to Executives, Managers, Peers, and Customers.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 4 years’ experience; additional years of experience accepted in lieu of a degree.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting complex enterprise Windows Server infrastructure (Windows Server 2012, 2016, 2019, and 2022) in production environments.
  • Competent in essential administration concepts around Active Directory, Group Policy (GPO), DNS, DHCP, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
  • In-depth knowledge of scripting and task automation using PowerShell.
  • Hands-on experience supporting virtual computing platforms (such as VMware/vSphere) and familiarity or hands-on experience administering Windows Server workloads in hybrid cloud environments (such as AWS EC2 or Microsoft Azure).
  • Hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and hardening Windows Server security baselines, executing monthly OS patching, and performing vulnerability remediation activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot multi-system server and application issues, assist with root cause analysis (RCA), and implement approved corrective actions.
  • Experience executing server infrastructure changes, OS upgrades, and system migrations in production environments following established change control procedures.
  • Experience updating and maintaining accurate system architecture diagrams, technical documentation, configuration records, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working alongside senior engineers, cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to resolve operational issues.
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8140 / IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Active certifications in Microsoft server or cloud technologies (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or Endpoint Administrator).
  • Active CompTIA Security+ CE certification (or equivalent DoD 8140 / IAT Level II baseline certification).
  • Active AWS and/or Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Solutions Architect, or Azure Solutions Architect).
  • Hands-on experience administering and integrating Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), including hybrid identity synchronization, conditional access, and enterprise authentication.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Fullstack
jobs.excerpt: Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence.
jobs.description:
Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence. Built on more than 35 years of proven results, Lyric combines responsible AI with clinical, payment, regulatory, and policy expertise to deliver transparent, auditable insights in milliseconds across real-time claims workflows. Lyric augments human decision-making so health plans can make faster, more accurate payments while maintaining full control. Today, Lyric supports 200 million lives, with nine of the top 10 U.S. health plans relying on its platform to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and support accurate payments.

Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship/sponsorship assumption and other immigration support are not available for this position.

We're a company at the intersection of FinTech and Healthcare, committed to simplifying healthcare payment integrity and creating value for health insurers, healthcare providers, and consumers. We're not a startup, but we move like one when it matters. Right now, we're starting on a large modernization of our payment integrity platform: ripping out legacy .NET, rebuilding around clean APIs, fixing data bottlenecks, and getting the product ready for scale.on FullStack Engineer to build intuitive, performant web experiences backed by scalable, eventdriven services. You’ll own endtoend delivery—from modular Angular frontends (including microfrontend strategies) to resilient .NET microservices—working closely with product, UX, DevOps, and QA to ship customerdelighting features at scale. If you thrive in fastpaced environments, care deeply about clean architecture and DX, and enjoy solving complex UI/UX and distributedsystems challenges, this role is for you.

Here's what makes this role different: you're not just a .NET engineer who "also knows AI." We want someone who has already figured out that tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex aren't toys - they're force multipliers. You'll use AI agents every day to tear through migrations, refactors, and test coverage that would take a traditional team weeks. But you also know when the AI is wrong, when to step in, and how to keep quality high. Think of it as having a junior engineer with infinite energy and zero judgment - your job is to supply the judgment.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES & KEY PERFORMANCE OUTCOMES

Ship modernization work at a pace that surprises people

This is your superpower. You'll:

  • Use AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to blow through framework upgrades, refactors, API extraction, test scaffolding, and documentation - while catching hallucinations and preventing regressions before they hit a PR.

  • Build reusable playbooks the team can actually follow: prompt templates, repo-level agent instructions, migration checklists, review heuristics, and clear "definition of done" standards for AI-assisted changes.

What success looks like:

  • You measurably move the needle - more modules migrated per sprint, faster PR turnarounds - without a spike in production bugs.

  • The team gets better because of you: PRs are clearer, test coverage grows, documentation stays current, and the same mistakes stop repeating.

Modernize a real .NET + SQL Server stack into something you'd be proud of

You'll:

  • Upgrade legacy services to current .NET (LTS where it makes sense), untangling architecture boundaries and fixing the performance issues that have been "known" for years.

  • Push toward a proper API-layer architecture - RESTful, versioned - built for correctness and maintainability, not just "it works."

  • Get your hands dirty with SQL Server: query performance, indexing, transactional correctness. If there are data pipeline needs (Kafka, etc.), you'll help build those too.

What success looks like:

  • Legacy surface area shrinks sprint over sprint. Critical paths live in modern code. Fewer "oh, that's still in the old system" conversations.

  • APIs get faster and more reliable. Database hot spots stop waking people up at night.

Own it like it's yours - especially because this is healthcare

You'll:

  • Build with security and privacy as defaults, not afterthoughts. Least privilege, safe data handling, the works. This is healthcare - getting it wrong isn't an option.

  • Put real quality guardrails in place: automated tests that actually catch things, CI that blocks bad changes, structured logging, observability that tells you what's happening before users do.

  • Review code thoughtfully, have honest architectural conversations, and raise the bar without being a jerk about it.

What success looks like:

  • Fewer severity-1 incidents. When something does go wrong, root cause takes hours, not days.

  • Automated test coverage grows meaningfully on modernized code. The team stops relying on "just test it manually."

Work with real humans to ship things that matter

You'll:

  • Partner with analysts, stakeholders, and other engineers to turn business problems into working software - not just technically correct software, but software that actually solves the problem.

  • Help build delivery plans that are honest about trade-offs. "Right" vs. "right now" is a real tension - you'll help the team navigate it with pragmatic milestones.

What success looks like:

  • Delivery is predictable. Customer onboarding milestones are met. Features ship with confidence, not crossed fingers.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years building and shipping production systems. Not side projects - real software with real users.solving skills; able to work independently and collaboratively in fastmoving teams

  • Some C# and modern .NET experience (Core and beyond). Especially in large codebases and you've done meaningful refactoring and migration work, not just greenfield.

  • Strong SQL Server chops - schema design, query tuning, performance troubleshooting. You've worked on data-heavy applications where the database wasn't an afterthought.

  • Cloud experience with Azure and/or AWS. Azure is particularly relevant here.

  • API design experience - you've built and maintained service-oriented architectures with real versioning, auth, reliability, and testing practices.

  • You actually use AI coding tools as a daily driver. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar - and not just for autocomplete. You've used agents for multi-file refactors, migrations, test generation, and review workflows. You have opinions about what works and what doesn't.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • You've actually done a legacy ASP.NET / .NET Framework modernization before. You know where the bodies are buried and you have the scars to prove it. Bonus points for Azure modernization patterns.

  • You communicate clearly. Good PR descriptions, straightforward design docs, pragmatic collaboration, low ego. We don't need a rockstar - we need someone the team trusts.

  • Experience with distributed systems tooling - Kafka, event-driven architectures, or working with Postgres alongside SQL Server.

  • Front-end experience with Angular and/or React/Next.js.

  • You've helped establish agent-friendly engineering practices: writing repo instructions that AI tools can follow, breaking work into agent-sized tasks, setting up CI guardrails for AI-generated code, feature flags, canary deployments - any part of the progressive delivery toolkit.

  • Background in regulated domains (healthcare, fintech, payments) where "move fast and break things" will get you fired.

***The US base salary range for this full-time position is:

$125,241.00 - $187,862.00

The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and does not reflect the value of the total rewards compensation. ***

Working closely with the Tech Lead and engineering teams, you will help define and implement scalable automation approaches for complex projects, improve testing efficiency, and ensure reliable, high-quality software delivery.

  • Strong programming skills, preferably in Groovy or Java, with the ability to develop, maintain, and optimize automation frameworks.
  • Ability to build automation solutions from scratch, explain technical approaches, and mentor other engineers.

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD practices, including building and maintaining automated test pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI/CD and Gradle.

  • Strong organizational skills and experience with issue-tracking and test management tools such as Jira.
  • Experience testing in cloud-native environments, with exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, and AWS.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing custom performance and load testing utilities using Groovy/Java, including supporting libraries and tools such as Jackson, Logback, and Chart.js.

  • Participate in architectural and technical discussions, contributing to the design of scalable, reliable, and testable systems.

Leadership & Collaboration

Deep Fission is seeking a Financial Reporting Manager to manage the day-to-day execution of the Company's external financial reporting with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and serve as a key technical accounting resource within the Finance organization. Reporting to the Controller, this individual contributor role carries significant responsibility for SEC filings, technical accounting research, equity administration, and internal controls, and works closely with the Controller on significant accounting matters, disclosures, and external reporting decisions. This role suits a technically strong candidate who has direct public-company reporting experience, works well through complex accounting questions, and is comfortable operating in a growing environment where processes continue to evolve.

ACCOUNTABILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

SEC and External Reporting:

  • Prepare quarterly and annual SEC filings, including Forms 10-Q and 10-K, and support other SEC filings as needed, including proxy statements, registration statements, and Forms 8-K involving financial information.

Technical Accounting Research:

  • Research and document accounting positions on complex or non-routine transactions, and prepare clear technical accounting memoranda that support well-reasoned conclusions.
  • Monitor new and emerging FASB and SEC guidance, evaluate its applicability to Deep Fission, and lead or support implementation as needed.
  • Serve as the day-to-day resource for technical accounting matters across the Finance organization.

Equity Administration and Reporting:

  • Help implement and maintain Morgan Stanley Shareworks as the Company's equity administration platform, and administer equity activity, including grants, RSU vesting and settlement events, stock option exercises, and other equity transactions.

Stock-Based Compensation:

  • Prepare and maintain accurate supporting calculations, reconciliations, and disclosures related to stock-based compensation and other equity transactions.

Internal Controls & SOX:

  • Help design, document, and execute the Company's internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) program, and manage the day-to-day operation of key controls.
  • Coordinate with external auditors and other departments to support Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) readiness.

Audit:

  • Serve as a key day-to-day contact for external auditors during quarterly reviews and the annual audit.
  • Manage prepared-by-client lists, supporting schedules, and technical inquiries.

Close Support:

  • Support month-end close as needed, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and other supporting schedules.

Policies and Procedures:

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience with stock-based compensation accounting under ASC 718 and equity-related accounting.
  • Experience supporting or operating within an internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) environment.

Preferred:

jobs.description:
DescriptionSprout Social is looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our Tooling team and help shape how engineers build, test, deploy, and operate software across the company.

Why join Sprout’s Engineering team?
Great developer experience has company-wide impact. Tooling team builds the platforms, automation, and workflows that help Sprout’s engineers ship better software faster. Our scope spans CI/CD and continuous delivery, AI-assisted development and engineering agents, internal developer tools, and observability. As a Staff engineer, you’ll set technical direction and stay close to the code, turning complex problems into reliable tools that teams want to use. You’ll partner with engineers across Sprout to understand what slows them down, improve their daily workflows, and measure the difference your work makes.

What you’ll do

  • Define technical direction for developer tooling alongside the Tooling Engineering Manager and engineering partners. Turn ambiguous, cross-team problems into architecture, practical milestones, and working software.
  • Design, build, and evolve our CI/CD and continuous delivery platforms. Reduce build and test times, improve pipeline reliability, and make releases faster and safer across different services and application stacks.
  • Build AI-first engineering workflows, including AI-assisted coding and agents that support development, testing, and operational tasks. Evaluate tools, integrate them into the software delivery lifecycle, and establish patterns other teams can adopt.
  • Partner with Product Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security to create secure-by-default, self-service workflows. Lead adoption through clear documentation, thoughtful migrations, and direct collaboration with the engineers who use your tools.
  • Lead technical initiatives across teams, building alignment on design decisions and tradeoffs. Measure outcomes through CI duration, developer feedback, platform adoption, software delivery performance, and operational health.
  • Multiply the impact of other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, mentorship, and reusable engineering patterns. Combine technical leadership with hands-on implementation.
  • Improve engineering observability and developer integrations so teams can understand and troubleshoot their systems. Own the long-term reliability and maintenance of the tools you build, and automate repetitive work.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a curious, pragmatic engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with experience building platforms for other developers. You enjoy investigating why a pipeline is slow, listening to feedback, and testing ideas across different services. You can connect long-term technical direction to incremental delivery, bring others along without formal authority, and take responsibility for systems throughout their lifecycle.

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 7+ years of experience developing and operating production software, with strong programming skills in a language such as Python, Go, Java, or Ruby.
  • Experience designing, building, and improving CI/CD systems and software delivery workflows, including diagnosing build, test, and deployment bottlenecks.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools and evaluating their output through code review, testing, and validation. Ability to identify where AI or agent-based workflows improve engineering work and where human judgment and controls are essential.
  • Experience leading complex technical initiatives across multiple teams: setting direction, writing design proposals, making tradeoffs, coordinating dependencies, and delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Experience building reliable internal platforms or developer tools, including operating production services, troubleshooting distributed systems, and reducing operational toil.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions across teams.
  • Professional English proficiency in verbal and written communication

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience building or integrating engineering agents or shared AI development platforms, including evaluation, access controls, and monitoring of quality, reliability, and cost.
  • Experience with observability platforms and integrations such as Datadog, Sentry, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins modernization, deployment orchestration, source control automation, package management, or artifact repositories.
  • Experience using software delivery metrics, such as DORA metrics, alongside developer feedback to prioritize and validate improvements.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout’s onboarding and learn about our products, engineering culture, and the customers our platforms ultimately support.
  • Align with your manager on Staff-level expectations, initial priorities, and your growth goals. Build relationships with Tooling and partner teams in Poland and the US.
  • Learn our CI/CD platforms, deployment tools, AI engineering workflows, and observability ecosystem, including GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Datadog.
  • Trace the developer journey from local development to production. Gather feedback and establish a baseline for an initial improvement opportunity.

Within 3 months, you'll start hitting your stride by:

  • Deliver an initial improvement to a developer workflow, with a clear baseline and evidence of its impact.
  • Develop a working understanding of our platform architecture, software delivery lifecycle, and the needs of teams using our tools.
  • Use observability and pipeline data to investigate performance and reliability issues and identify recurring sources of developer friction.
  • Build the operational knowledge needed to support Tooling-owned services, troubleshoot issues, and improve their reliability.
  • Contribute to code and design reviews, pairing with teammates and sharing what you learn.
  • Use experimentation and developer feedback to test assumptions and improve the team’s tools and ways of working.
  • Lead a design proposal for a cross-team initiative, aligning stakeholders on the problem, success measures, tradeoffs, dependencies, and rollout approach.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce maintenance burden through automation, simpler designs, and better self-service capabilities.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Lead delivery and adoption of a meaningful improvement to CI/CD, AI development workflows, or observability across multiple engineering teams.
  • Partner with product engineers to refine the solution using their feedback and support adoption through documentation, migration tooling, and hands-on collaboration.
  • Resolve performance or reliability bottlenecks across build, deployment, and integration environments, and use what you learn to improve shared platform patterns.
  • Demonstrate measurable gains in developer experience or delivery performance while maintaining quality, security, and reliability.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and technical decisions clearly across teams, building alignment and resolving dependencies.
  • Mentor teammates through implementation and design decisions, and revisit your growth plan with your manager.

Within 12 months, you'll make this role your own by:

  • Be a trusted technical partner for Tooling and the engineering teams that rely on its platforms.
  • Shape a multi-quarter technical roadmap with your manager and engineering partners, balancing developer needs, platform health, and strategic investment.
  • Lead cross-team initiatives from discovery through rollout and ongoing operation, addressing risks early and communicating tradeoffs transparently.
  • Guide architecture decisions and establish reusable patterns that make development, delivery, and operations simpler across Sprout.
  • Demonstrate sustained improvements in CI performance, delivery reliability, platform adoption, and developer satisfaction.
  • Help engineers grow their technical judgment and ability to lead initiatives through mentorship, pairing, and thoughtful feedback.
  • Build lasting partnerships across engineering and use them to identify the next high-impact opportunities for Tooling.
  • Advance AI-first development practices through evaluated tools and agents, clear guidance, and workshops that help engineers use them effectively and responsibly.
  • Bring your own ideas for improving how Sprout engineers work, and help turn the most promising ones into capabilities used across the company.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

jobs.description:
As Product Manager – Generative AI (GenAI), you will define, deliver, and commercialize client-facing GenAI capabilities across IDeaS products, with an initial focus on capabilities IDeaS groups under ‘IDeaS Intelligence’. You will turn complex revenue, commercial, and operational data into trusted, intuitive experiences that help hospitality professionals understand performance, explore causes, summarize insights, and take informed action.

You will work at the intersection of customer problems, product strategy, user experience, data, AI engineering, analytics, and responsible AI. The role owns outcomes rather than models alone: selecting the right problems, defining the experience, establishing quality and safety standards, validating value with customers, and driving adoption at enterprise scale.

This role requires strong product judgment, practical fluency in GenAI product patterns, and the ability to translate emerging technology into dependable SaaS capabilities. Success depends on balancing speed of learning with accuracy, security, privacy, explainability, cost, latency, and customer trust.

What you’ll be doing...

GenAI Product Vision and Strategy

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for GenAI-powered experiences within IDeaS Intelligence and the broader IDeaS product portfolio.
  • Identify high-value client problems where conversational interfaces, summarization, explanation, natural-language exploration, content generation, or agent-assisted workflows can improve commercial decision-making.
  • Distinguish where GenAI is the right solution from use cases better served by deterministic analytics, optimization, workflow automation, or conventional user experience patterns.
  • Develop investment hypotheses and business cases grounded in customer value, strategic differentiation, adoption potential, implementation effort, operating cost, and commercial opportunity.
  • Monitor relevant AI market, technology, regulatory, and hospitality trends and translate them into practical product choices.

Customer Discovery and Experience Definition

  • Lead discovery with revenue leaders, analysts, property teams, multi-property operators, and enterprise customers to understand decisions, workflows, trust requirements, and adoption barriers.
  • Define end-to-end GenAI experiences, including entry points, conversation flows, follow-up interactions, source grounding, citations, user controls, escalation paths, and human review.
  • Translate customer and business needs into product requirements, product playbooks for AI execution, user stories, acceptance criteria, prototypes, and measurable experience-quality targets.
  • Design for different levels of AI confidence and user expertise, ensuring outputs are clear about evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, recommended next steps, and limits.
  • Run concept tests, design-partner programs, alpha and beta releases, and structured feedback loops with strategic customers.

AI Product Development and Evaluation

  • Partner with AI/ML Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, Design, Analytics, Security, Privacy, Legal, Quality Assurance, and domain experts to deliver production-grade capabilities.
  • Define and prioritize product patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, structured outputs, in-context assistance, multi-turn conversation, summarization, and agent-assisted workflows.
  • Create evaluation frameworks that combine offline test sets, expert review, automated evaluation, red-team scenarios, and production telemetry.
  • Establish release criteria for groundedness, factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, usability, latency, reliability, safety, and cost per interaction.
  • Own the product response to failure modes such as hallucination, unsupported recommendations, prompt injection, data leakage, stale context, inconsistent answers, and overreliance by users.
  • Ensure feedback, corrections, model and prompt changes, evaluation results, and production incidents contribute to a disciplined continuous-improvement cycle.

Responsible AI, Trust, and Enterprise Readiness

  • Embed responsible AI principles into product requirements and lifecycle decisions, including fairness, transparency, accountability, privacy, security, accessibility, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Define how experiences communicate source provenance, limitations, confidence, and the distinction between generated explanation and authoritative IDeaS calculations or recommendations.
  • Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, and Architecture to define data boundaries, retention expectations, access controls, auditability, vendor and model governance, and acceptable-use safeguards.
  • Ensure all defined and agreed boundaries and controls are implemented prior to release.
  • Maintain clear product documentation for intended use, known limitations, evaluation evidence, and operational ownership.

Delivery, Commercialization, and Adoption

  • Own prioritization and product delivery across discovery, experimentation, production hardening, launch, and scaled adoption.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Commercial teams on positioning, packaging, monetization, competitive differentiation, demonstrations, and sales enablement.
  • Work with Solution Success, Consulting, Support, and customer-facing teams to define onboarding, education, adoption, feedback, and support models.
  • Develop launch and release-readiness plans that include quality evidence, operational monitoring, support playbooks, customer communications, and rollback or feature-control options.
  • Communicate decisions, trade-offs, progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to executives, delivery teams, and customer stakeholders.

Measurement and Product Growth

  • Define a balanced scorecard covering customer outcomes, adoption, engagement, answer quality, trust, task completion, time saved, retention, revenue impact, operational reliability, latency, and unit economics.
  • Instrument user journeys to understand which questions are asked, where users abandon or correct outputs, which capabilities drive repeat use, and where the experience fails to create value.
  • Use experimentation and cohort analysis to improve discoverability, usefulness, trust, and sustained adoption without optimizing solely for conversation volume.
  • Continuously refine the roadmap using customer evidence, evaluation results, product telemetry, commercial performance, and changes in AI capability or cost.

What you’ll bring to us…

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, Economics, Operations Research, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, AI/ML products, Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, or related software roles.
  • Experience defining and delivering customer-facing SaaS or enterprise software products from discovery through launch and adoption.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex customer problems, data, and technical constraints into clear product requirements and intuitive experiences.
  • Practical understanding of GenAI product concepts, including large language models, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design.
  • Ability to define measurable quality and business outcomes and make evidence-based prioritization decisions.
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to explain AI behavior and trade-offs to technical, commercial, executive, and customer audiences.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing without direct authority.

Preferred

  • Experience building or managing production GenAI, conversational AI, analytics, decision-support, or agent-assisted products.
  • Experience in hospitality, travel, revenue management, pricing, forecasting, commercial optimization, or enterprise business intelligence.
  • Familiarity with experimentation, LLM evaluation, model and prompt versioning, observability, red teaming, and AI quality or safety practices.
  • Experience with enterprise data architectures, APIs, semantic layers, identity and access management, privacy, security, or multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and regulated or high-trust use cases.
  • Experience supporting commercialization, packaging, monetization, go-to-market, and adoption of new technology capabilities.

We Support Who You Are….

As a global company, we strive to create an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives spark innovation and meet the challenges of an evolving world. Whether you’re launching a new career or expanding your current one, IDeaS is a company where you can balance great work with all other aspects of your life.

At IDeaS, we also aspire to live our values each day by being Accountable, Curious, Passionate and Authentic. And we continue our quest to build a more inclusive environment that attracts, represents and provides a place for diverse ideas, unique perspectives, and authentic voices.

Responsive Web Design

Developer Collaboration & Handoff

Feedback & Iteration

Design Quality Assurance

  • Review implemented pages against approved designs.
  • Identify visual inconsistencies, layout issues, and usability concerns.
  • Recommend fixes to maintain a high standard of design quality.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Professional experience in web design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment, layout skills, and attention to detail.

  • Strong written and spoken English for clear communication with distributed teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to refine work based on feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take pride in producing polished, thoughtful design work and maintain high standards without constant supervision.
  • You communicate proactively, clarify requirements early, and keep collaborators informed.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and focus on delivering the best outcome for users and the business.
  • You work effectively in an asynchronous environment and manage your workload reliably.
  • You collaborate well with developers and understand the importance of accurate design handoffs.
  • You take ownership of your designs from concept through final implementation review.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality, user-centered web designs that align with project goals.
  • Responsive layouts that deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • A well-maintained design system with reusable, consistent components.
  • Clear handoffs that help developers implement designs accurately.

You’ll begin by reviewing feedback and comments on active design files and prioritizing your work. Depending on project needs, you may refine a landing page, develop a reusable design component, or revise a product interface.

jobs.excerpt: About AlphaSense: The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making.
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and reliability of our global financial data extraction and normalization platform. This system ingests filings across formats (HTML, PDF, APIs, spreadsheets), extracts and standardizes financial data using a combination of AI and deterministic systems, and delivers trusted, traceable outputs at scale to downstream financial services teams and customers.

This role owns the self-sourcing and extraction foundation used by multiple teams across the organization. Today, human validation is used as a safety net. Your mission is to systematically reduce human dependency by increasing system correctness, confidence, and trust, without sacrificing speed or scalability.

You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, AI-driven extraction, data quality, and platform architecture, raising the technical bar and reshaping how we build reliable systems.

Who You Are:

  • 15+ years of experience building and operating large-scale production systems
  • Proven experience designing data ingestion, extraction, or processing systems at scale
  • Deep expertise in one or more of:
    • Distributed systems
    • Data platforms and pipelines
    • AI/ML-powered extraction or classification systems
    • Platform or infrastructure engineering
  • Demonstrated ability to design trustworthy systems that combine probabilistic (AI) and deterministic approaches
  • Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, failure modes, and iterative hardening
  • Experience reducing operational or human overhead through better system design
  • Track record of technical leadership across teams without formal people management
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity where none exists
  • Passion for using AI responsibly and effectively to deliver scalable, high-confidence systems
  • Nice to Have
    • Experience with document understanding, NLP, or financial data extraction
    • Experience building provenance, lineage, or confidence-scoring systems
    • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and modern data stacks
    • Experience shaping or owning internal platforms used by multiple teams

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the architecture and evolution of our large-scale data extraction and normalization platform
  • Design systems that process hundreds of thousands of records across heterogeneous sources (PDF, HTML, APIs, XLS) with high reliability
  • Define and implement strategies to minimize human-in-the-loop validation through AI-based validation, confidence scoring, provenance tracking, and deterministic safeguards
  • Establish clear system contracts for correctness, traceability, and confidence (e.g., “where did this number come from?”)
  • Balance AI-driven approaches with procedural and rules-based systems where they improve reliability and explainabilityIdentify and remediate architectural and operational bottlenecks impacting scale, accuracy, and developer velocity
  • Act as the technical authority to block poor designs, redesign critical systems, and introduce new platforms or tooling when necessary
  • Partner with product and downstream consumers to define quality bars, SLAs, and success metrics
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for production issues, reliability failures, and systemic risks
  • Mentor senior engineers, shape technical culture, and raise expectations for system design and execution
  • Contribute to long-term technical strategy while remaining hands-on with critical implementations

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

Compensation Range
$246,000—$339,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.description:
Work Model: 100% Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Accounts Receivable / Finance

Build Your Career With Alia Services

Alia Services connects talented professionals with growing companies around the world. We specialize in remote recruitment, workforce, and payroll solutions, helping organizations build exceptional teams while creating meaningful career opportunities for professionals.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Accounts Receivable Representative (AR Representative III) who is ready to take ownership of complex accounts, drive collections performance, and become a trusted resource within the AR team.

If you have strong B2B accounts receivable and collections experience, enjoy solving complex payment issues, and are comfortable communicating directly with customers and internal stakeholders, this could be a great next step in your career.

Why Join Alia Services?

At Alia Services, we want our team members to feel supported throughout their employment while having opportunities to grow professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to:

  • 100% Remote Work – Work from the comfort of your home while collaborating with an international team and client.
  • Health Insurance – Health insurance coverage provided through SafetyWing, beginning as soon as you are hired.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – Enjoy paid time off to rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Reliable Payroll – Consistent payroll administration and support from the Alia Services team.
  • Dedicated HR Support – Access to our People Operations team for employment-related questions, support, and guidance throughout your time with us.
  • Professional Growth – Opportunities to develop your skills, gain international experience, and grow professionally.
  • Coaching & Feedback – One-on-one coaching, ongoing feedback, mentorship, and development opportunities.
  • International Experience – Gain valuable experience working remotely with international companies and teams.
  • Cross-Functional Development – Opportunities to expand your knowledge and gain exposure to different areas of the business.
  • Equipment Coordination – Equipment support and coordination may be available depending on the position and client requirements.
  • Ongoing Employee Support – From onboarding through your day-to-day employment, Alia Services serves as your dedicated partner throughout your experience with the client.

With Alia Services, you're not just being placed in a remote role we remain part of your employment journey, providing ongoing HR, payroll, benefits, and professional support while you grow in your career.

About the Role

As a Senior Accounts Receivable Representative, you will play an important role in maintaining the financial health of the organization by managing customer accounts, resolving outstanding balances, and ensuring timely and accurate collections.

This is more than a transactional AR position. You'll independently manage accounts and escalations, communicate directly with customers regarding aged receivables, collaborate with teams across the organization, and serve as a knowledgeable resource for other members of the AR team.

Success in this role requires a combination of strong collections experience, attention to detail, customer communication, problem-solving, and ownership.

What You'll Do

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and proactively follow up on past-due invoices via phone and email
  • Independently manage aged receivables and customer-level escalations
  • Lead customer conversations regarding outstanding balances and payment resolution
  • Maintain account aging in accordance with established KPIs and productivity expectations
  • Research and resolve short payments, overpayments, returned payments, and other account discrepancies
  • Support payment research and credit validation activities
  • Determine appropriate small-balance and month-end write-offs in accordance with established procedures
  • Make recommendations to leadership regarding the collection of significantly past-due accounts
  • Maintain accurate and detailed account and invoice notes

Customer & Cross-Functional Support

  • Partner with Sales, Account Executives, Customer Service, and Finance to resolve AR-related concerns
  • Provide customers with invoice copies, statements, payment confirmations, and other requested documentation
  • Process and distribute reprinted or adjusted invoices as needed
  • Provide high-touch support for complex or escalated customer accounts
  • Communicate professionally with both internal and external stakeholders throughout the collection process

Senior-Level Support & Team Collaboration

  • Serve as an Accounts Receivable subject matter resource for the team
  • Provide training, coaching, and mentorship to other AR Representatives on processes and best practices
  • Assist team members with complex AR situations and escalations
  • Provide coverage for other team members when needed
  • Support reporting and payment platforms such as Tableau and SnapPay, as applicable
  • Identify opportunities to improve AR processes, workflows, and overall efficiency
  • Consistently work toward meeting or exceeding established aging and performance KPIs
  • Perform additional responsibilities based on team needs and assigned workflows

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Accounts Receivable, Billing, Collections, Finance, or a related function
  • Strong experience managing customer accounts and past-due receivables
  • Experience communicating directly with customers regarding outstanding balances and payment resolution
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team
  • Ability to remain professional and solution-oriented when handling escalated or complex accounts
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Outlook

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a corporate or B2B Accounts Receivable environment
  • Experience managing complex or high-value customer accounts
  • Strong 10-key speed and accuracy
  • Experience mentoring or supporting other AR professionals
  • Experience with Tableau, SnapPay, or similar financial/reporting platforms
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Finance, Account Management, and Customer Service

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You'll be a strong fit if you're someone who takes ownership of your accounts rather than waiting for problems to escalate. You're comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with customers, investigating discrepancies, coordinating with multiple departments, and following an issue through until it's resolved.

You're also someone your teammates can rely on. You enjoy sharing your knowledge, helping others navigate difficult accounts, and contributing to a strong and collaborative AR team.

Ready for Your Next Opportunity?

If you're an experienced Accounts Receivable professional looking for a remote opportunity where you can take greater ownership, work with complex accounts, and continue developing your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your career with Alia Services.

jobs.description:
At TRG, we operate in a global environment where diverse perspectives, cultures, and personalities shape everything we do. We hire talented people from all over the world who are passionate about their craft and committed to working shoulder-to-shoulder to empower our customers in their fight against crime and terror.

Our Core Values define us:

  • Whatever it takes – We take ownership and deliver.
  • Passion is our fuel – We learn, grow, innovate.
  • We make an impact – We challenge the status quo.
  • We work together – One for all, all for one.

Your team

You will be part of our Sales team, working at the intersection of intelligence, technology, and customer engagement.

This position combines account ownership with deep technological and investigative expertise. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Presales and Customer Success to drive meaningful conversations with customers and position TRG’s solutions in complex, high-stakes environments.

About you

As an IntelligenceOfficer in the Sales team at TRG, you will own and drive the sales cycle within your assigned territory, while leveraging your background in intelligence and analysis to engage customers on a deeper, more consultative level.

This is not a traditional “quota-only” sales role, you will act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure to complex intelligence problems, guiding customers through data-driven insights, and demonstrating how TRG’s technology can support real-world investigations.

You will play a key role in shaping opportunities, influencing strategy, and bridging the gap between customer needs and product capabilities.

What you’ll work on:

  • Lead solution-driven sales conversations, combining commercial focus with analytical depth
  • Own and drive the full sales cycle within your assigned territory (from opportunity creation to deal closure and expansion)
  • Engage with customers (law enforcement, intelligence, financial, cyber sectors) to understand investigative challenges and translate them into solutions
  • Deliver or co-deliver high-quality product demos and use-case storytelling, tailored to customer needs
  • Work closely with Pre-Sales to design POCs, demos, and investigative scenarios that resonate with stakeholders
  • Build and execute a territory strategy, including pipeline follow-ups , prioritization, and account management
  • Support the creation of proposals, commercial offers, and deal structuring
  • Act as a bridge between customer and internal teams, ensuring alignment across Product, R&D, and Customer Success
  • Be the professional go to in the region for intelligence analysis methods, intelligence collection and fusion tools , and data-analysis trends to strengthen customer conversations
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and R&D based on market and customer insights
  • Contribute to refining how TRG positions and sells its technology in your region

What we look for:

  • Experience in intelligence, investigations, or analytical roles (law enforcement, military, OSINT, risk intelligence, etc.)
  • Proven ability or strong potential to operate in a customer-facing / sales environment
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to structure complex problems
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills
  • Ability to balance commercial objectives with solution depth
  • Independent, proactive, and results-driven mindset
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities
  • Native-level English + fluency in German language is an advantage

You’ll stand out if you have:

  • Experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical sales
  • Hands-on OSINT expertise
  • Experience working with government, law enforcement, or intelligence clients
  • Exposure to complex B2B or public-sector sales environments

Your perks:

  • Working from home Hit your goals from the comfort of your home because we value the performance, not the place.
  • Flexible hours because we promote work-life balance.
  • Yearly performance bonus to reward good performance and hard work.
  • Paid medical insurance because we like to take care of you.
  • Daily lunch allowance so you can save lots of money, time, and effort by enjoying your free lunch at the office or home every day.
  • Sport/Gym(Exercise) allowance to focus more on yourself, your well-being, and your health.
  • Udemy unlimited subscription to promote your learning and development and grow your career.
  • Onboarding plan and training so that you have a smooth induction and feel confident and ready to take over your new role.
  • Equipment support so you have all the tools to do effectively and efficiently your work.
  • No dress code because we want you to be as comfortable as possible.
  • Gifts and rewards for celebrating birthdays, anniversaries, and personal milestones.
  • Happy hours, coffee time, online team building, company events, and much more to promote team bonding and of course to have fun!
  • Fresh fruit, snacks, coffee, and tea at the office because work makes us hungry!

About us

TRG deals with Data Fusion and AI products for civilian protection.

Our mission is to empower our customers to fight crime and terror through state-of-the-art technologies that provide accurate and precise intelligence.

Our product, Intellectus, is the only cloud-based all-in-one fusion platform with integrated web intelligence, discovery capabilities, advertisement intelligence, virtual ID management, and third-party database integration that can be deployed in less than 24 hours.

Want to learn more? Visit our website at and our LinkedIn page.

TRG Tech Research Group Limited processes and/or controls all data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 2016/679. For more information visit our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
FSG is the solution for operational excellence being sought by private fund managers who wish to focus solely on raising capital and identifying investment opportunities. We support the entire life-cycle of our clients’ private funds and management company, managing the execution of investments, the experience of their investors, and the compliance, finance and human resource solutions needed to satisfy all regulatory requirements. Our team is asked to serve our clients with consistent excellence and accountability, while being allowed to live their definition of success. We focus on bringing new team members on board who share our passion for providing excellence in our service, while never wavering from our Principles of integrity, effort, communication and protecting time with our families.

Investor Reporting Associate

FSG is the opportunity to learn and experience the finance industry for a people-oriented, hard-working, team player. Our unique culture is built by the team and for the team. Our compensation structure provides unlimited upside to our team members. We will teach you all that you need to know to be successful on our team, so we do not generally require any specific degree or work history. We just hope you are as non-traditional and eager to prove yourself as we are!

Your key responsibilities are to deliver white glove service and honor the FSG Principles while:

  • Prepare, review, and distribute investor statements, capital account reports, performance reports, tax documents, and investor communications in accordance with established deadlines
  • Validate investor balances, capital activity, performance data, and reporting outputs against fund accounting records; investigate and resolve discrepancies, data exceptions, and reporting issues
  • Maintain investor reporting platforms, portals, and client databases, including data entry, updates, document uploads, access management, and record maintenance
  • Execute daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reporting activities accurately and on schedule, supporting established reporting cycles and deliverables
  • Respond to investor inquiries regarding account activity, reporting packages, performance information, document requests, and portal access; support investor onboarding and Partner account maintenance
  • Partner with internal teams to obtain, validate, and reconcile reporting information; document procedures and contribute to process improvements that enhance accuracy, efficiency, and investor experience
