Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Overview
The Group Director, Officer Talent Acquisition and Search (OTAS) will lead and develop a high-performing executive recruitment team responsible for attracting, engaging, and placing exceptional executive talent across Walmart. This leader will set the vision and strategy for executive recruitment, build a world-class search capability, and ensure an exceptional experience for candidates and business leaders throughout the executive search process.
This role requires an accomplished executive recruiting leader with a strong track record of leading people, delivering complex executive searches, and building trusted relationships with senior executives and external search partners. The Group Director will elevate the team's capabilities, establish innovative and effective recruiting practices, and ensure we consistently identify and attract the leadership talent needed to deliver on Walmart's business priorities.

In close partnership with Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, this role will connect executive recruitment with talent planning, leadership development, executive onboarding, and coaching. The Group Director will play a critical role in advancing Walmart's vision of becoming a Talent Academy by building a sustainable pipeline of exceptional leadership talent and strengthening our ability to develop, attract, and retain the leaders of the future.

Joining Walmart means being part of a people-led, tech-powered organization that values innovation, collaboration, strong relationships, and meaningful impact.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership and Team Development
  • Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing executive recruitment team, establishing a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and exceptional service.
  • Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development plans while coaching team members to strengthen their executive search expertise, advisory capabilities, and business acumen.
  • Build organizational capability and ensure the team has the skills, tools, resources, and capacity to deliver exceptional executive recruiting outcomes.
  • Foster an environment where team members are empowered to innovate, continuously improve, and deliver outstanding results.


Executive Talent Strategy and Search Excellence
  • Define and execute a comprehensive executive recruitment strategy aligned with Walmart's business priorities and evolving leadership needs.
  • Lead complex, high-impact executive searches, ensuring the identification, assessment, attraction, and placement of exceptional executive talent.
  • Build and maintain robust pipelines of diverse, highly qualified executive talent to support both immediate hiring needs and long-term leadership requirements.
  • Establish consistent, high-quality search practices that drive insight, quality, efficiency, and speed while strengthening the internal executive recruiting capability and reducing dependency on external search partners.
  • Develop a global executive recruiting approach that supports the organization's leadership needs across markets and business segments.


Exceptional Candidate and Stakeholder Experience
  • Champion an exceptional, differentiated candidate experience throughout every stage of the executive search process, ensuring candidates feel informed, valued, respected, and engaged.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior business leaders, executives, candidates, and external partners, serving as a strategic advisor on executive talent and market insights.
  • Establish a high standard of partnership, communication, and execution that strengthens Walmart's reputation as an employer of choice for top executive talent.
  • Navigate complex and sensitive searches with exceptional judgment, discretion, confidentiality, and relationship management skills.


Strategic Talent Partnerships
  • Partner closely with Talent Management to connect executive recruitment with talent planning, leadership development, executive onboarding, and coaching.
  • Collaborate with Talent Acquisition delivery leaders to align executive search priorities with critical leadership needs across business segments.
  • Develop and manage strategic partnerships with external executive search firms, ensuring access to the best talent and maximizing the value of external recruiting investments.
  • Contribute to Walmart's Talent Academy vision by strengthening the connection between external executive talent acquisition, internal leadership pipelines, and long-term talent development.


Operational Excellence and Financial Stewardship
  • Continuously evolve executive recruiting processes, technology, and practices to improve quality, efficiency, speed, and the overall candidate experience.
  • Leverage data, market intelligence, and recruiting insights to inform executive talent strategies and measure team effectiveness and search outcomes.
  • Own the financial strategy for executive recruitment, including agency partnerships, external search spend, resource allocation, and investment decisions relative to business demand.
  • Ensure thoughtful transition planning and support for executive departures and leadership changes, partnering with appropriate stakeholders to maintain continuity and address business needs.


Key Priorities
  • Build and Lead an Exceptional Team: Develop a highly capable, engaged, and results-oriented executive recruiting team known for its expertise, partnership, and ability to deliver.
  • Attract the Best Executive Talent: Establish Walmart as a destination for top executive talent through innovative search strategies, strong market relationships, and compelling candidate engagement.
  • Deliver an Exceptional Candidate Experience: Set a high bar for every candidate interaction, ensuring a thoughtful, personalized, and seamless executive search experience.
  • Build a Leading Executive Search Capability: Strengthen internal search expertise, advisory capabilities, and delivery excellence while optimizing the use of external search partners.
  • Advance the Talent Academy Vision: Connect executive recruitment with talent planning, internal talent development, and leadership readiness to build a sustainable pipeline of future leaders.
  • Be a Trusted Strategic Partner: Build exceptional relationships with senior leaders and key stakeholders, providing sound counsel, market insights, and executive talent recommendations.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications
  • Minimum of 5 years of direct executive recruitment experience, with a demonstrated track record of successfully leading and delivering executive-level searches.
  • Demonstrated success leading, managing, coaching, and developing high-performing teams. Strong people leadership skills are essential.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish trust, influence, and partner effectively with C-suite executives, senior business leaders, candidates, and external search partners.
  • Proven ability to attract, assess, engage, and secure top executive talent for complex and highly visible leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex executive searches with sound judgment, discretion, confidentiality, and strong negotiation skills.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business priorities into effective executive talent strategies.
  • Strong understanding of executive talent planning, talent management, and leadership development.
  • Experience managing recruiting budgets, agency partnerships, and external search investments.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building or transforming an internal executive recruitment function.
  • Experience leading global executive searches and partnering across diverse business segments and markets.
  • Experience leveraging recruiting technology, data, and market intelligence to improve executive search effectiveness.
  • Experience integrating executive recruitment with broader talent and leadership development strategies.

Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

jobs.excerpt: About NicheNiche is the leader in school search.  Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free.
jobs.description:
About Niche

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role

The Manager, Site Reliability is the single technical and people leader for a small, high-ownership Site Reliability team (3–4 engineers) focused on building reliable, scalable, and secure environments that power the applications our students and schools rely on. This is a pivotal role in executing our strategy to accelerate product development and reduce barriers to software delivery without sacrificing quality and reliability.

This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role with technical fluency as a nice-to-have — the Manager, Site Reliability (Tech Lead Manager) is expected to be hands-on with code, architecture, and technical decision-making on a regular, ongoing basis, in addition to owning the full scope of people leadership: 1:1s, growth, performance, and hiring. Where a typical EM posting emphasizes strategy, stakeholder management, and guiding technical direction through others, the TLM personally takes on inbound coding work, personally owns technical debt, and personally carries enough depth in every project their engineers are running to challenge and improve the technical approach — not just track progress against it.

There is no separate Tech Lead on this team. The Manager, Site Reliability (TLM) holds both halves of the job — technical decision making and people management — as one accountable owner.

Success for the team is measured by reliability and performance metrics for the overall product and delivery systems, reduced incident detection and recovery times, adoption rates of platform tools and services, increased product development team self-service, modernization efforts across a portfolio of legacy services and infrastructure, and reduction of recurring toilsome or interrupt activities.

What You Will Do

  • Take on inbound SRE and platform work directly rather than delegating it by default — you are a working contributor to incident response, infrastructure automation, and tooling, not just their reviewer
  • Own technical debt and infrastructure modernization within your team's scope, prioritizing and resolving it directly rather than routing it to someone else
  • Maintain deep enough understanding of every project your engineers are running — observability, disaster recovery, infrastructure work — to push on it, not just check in on it
  • Own delivery outcomes and the team's quality bar: reliability and performance metrics, incident response effectiveness, and platform tool adoption
  • Guide technical direction through system design, architectural consult, and hands-on code review, ensuring engineering excellence
  • Own people leadership for your team: career development, performance management, hiring, and overall team health for 3–4 Site Reliability Engineers
  • Own — jointly with engineering leadership — how the team works. Today that's Agile Scrum or Kanban; you're expected to give feedback and help shape and implement our development process
  • Ensure the team balances urgency over perfection, while maintaining high standards for quality and reliability
  • Model effective AI-assisted development in your own hands-on work and set the standard for your team's usage

During the First Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Get hands-on in the codebase and infrastructure your team owns — not just reading it, but shipping something
  • Build rapport with your direct reports and understand each ongoing project (observability, disaster recovery, infrastructure work) deeply enough to have a real technical opinion on it
  • Work alongside the team to learn the tech stack, the products you support, and the team's current process (ceremonies, planning, review, oncall, incident response) as it exists today.

Within 3 Months:

  • Be a regular, direct contributor to inbound technical work — incident response, platform tooling, technical debt, infrastructure — alongside your team, not just reviewing their output
  • Foster a culture of quality by providing thoughtful, constructive feedback through code reviews and pairing, and promoting adoption of platform tools and practices
  • Make your first joint call with engineering leadership on a process adjustment and technical improvement, however small
  • Have established a working rhythm for 1:1s, performance conversations, and career development with each direct report
  • Join the on-call rotation suggesting improvements to improve response time and repeated notifications

Within 6 Months:

  • Demonstrate ownership of a nontrivial technical decision or architectural direction for your team's systems (e.g., observability platform adoption, disaster recovery improvements, infrastructure)
  • Show a track record of catching and correcting technical or platform issues before they became delivery problems, including participating in disaster recovery and incident response exercises
  • Complete a full performance/calibration cycle for your directs

Within 12 Months:

  • Have led — jointly with engineering leadership — a deliberate evolution of your team's process, grounded in what's actually worked for your team rather than an inherited default
  • Be a recognized technical authority for Site Reliability, trusted with architectural calls without needing to route them elsewhere
  • Have full confidence navigating the Niche codebase and triaging technical work, getting directly involved as needed
  • Have a demonstrated record of balancing hands-on technical contribution with sustained people leadership — neither crowding out the other

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong, current hands-on software engineering experience — this role requires writing and reviewing code regularly, not occasionally
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • 3+ years of professional platform engineering experience incorporating DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering principles
  • Prior experience owning technical direction, or people management, and a clear readiness to take on both at once
  • Comfort operating without a separate Tech Lead to lean on — you are the final technical word for your team
  • Experience with distributed systems and technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), kops, HashiCorp Vault, Grafana, GitHub Actions, Postgres, Kafka/MSK, Redis/Valkey, or equivalent platforms (Azure/GCP also welcome)
  • Understanding of modern microservice-based architectures and methodologies
  • Experience with Golang, TypeScript, and React is a plus
  • Experience with or strong aptitude for AI-assisted development tooling and workflows
  • A track record of making pragmatic technical trade-offs under real delivery pressure
  • Experience with, or openness to evolving, agile/Scrum-based team processes
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written

Compensation

Our national target base salary range is $146,000-$183,000, plus participation in our Annual Bonus and Stock Option Program. Base compensation will be commensurate with experience and skills.

At Niche, our Total Rewards Philosophy is centered around creating a workplace environment that attracts, motivates, and retains top talent by providing a comprehensive and competitive rewards package. This philosophy is built on the principles of performance-based compensation, best-in-class benefits and work-life balance, and employee well-being.

Interview Process

Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams. We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience. The interview process is outlined here:

  • Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

  • Video Interview with Hiring Manager - 45 Minutes

  • Technical Assessment - 45 Minutes

  • Team Interview - 45 Minutes

  • Leadership Interview - 45 Minutes

WhyNiche?

  • We are a fully flexible workforce empowering our employees to choose to work remotely, in our Pittsburgh office or whatever combination suits you
  • Full time, salaried position with competitive compensation in a fast-growing company
  • Best-in-class 100% paid employee health plan, including vision and dental and supplemental coverage

Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

As a Creative Quality & Compliance Specialist, you’ll play an integral part in the overall quality and regulatory integrity of creative output across the Healthcare division, serving as the quality and compliance checkpoint within the creative production workflow. In this role, you’ll report directly to the Creative department and work alongside Creative Project Managers who own delivery timelines and task trafficking.

You will act as the gate through which every piece of creative passes before it reaches client Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) reviewers and again before it goes live. You'll review ads, landing pages, emails, social content, and video for MLR regulatory compliance, brand and design standards, and copy accuracy. Additionally, you’ll operate hands-on inside Veeva Vault PromoMats—managing claims, annotations, references, and submission packages—while building and refining the quality standards the creative team works against to raise the bar across the healthcare portfolio.

While your primary authority is quality and compliance, you’ll also support the creative production workflow by maintaining deliverable trackers, coordinating feedback cycles with client stakeholders, and trafficking tasks between the creative team and client POCs. As the Creative Project Manager and Account PM lead delivery management at scale, you will keep the creative lane organized and moving while ensuring nothing ships that shouldn’t.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Pre-Submission Compliance QA: Review all creative assets against MLR requirements — claims accuracy, fair balance, ISI placement, reference linking, branded vs. unbranded vs. disease-awareness rules — before they enter client Medical, Legal, and Regulatory review.
  • Post-Approval Launch QA: Final quality proof of approved assets — landing pages, ads, emails, creative — before they go live, confirming that approved content was implemented correctly and no errors were introduced in production.
  • Veeva Vault PromoMats Operations: Own the hands-on Veeva workflow — annotating assets, entering and linking claims, managing references, tracking submission status, and packaging 2253 filings.
  • Brand & Design Standards Enforcement: Review creative output for visual consistency, spec adherence, and style guide compliance across all healthcare client deliverables.
  • Copy Quality Review: Review all copy for grammar, tone, messaging accuracy, and alignment with approved claims and client brand voice.
  • QA Process Documentation & Refinement: Build, maintain, and continuously improve the quality and compliance standards, checklists, and review processes the creative team follows.
  • Creative Workflow Coordination: Support creative production operations alongside the Creative Project Manager and Account PM — maintaining Asana boards and deliverable trackers, communicating timelines and managing feedback cycles with client stakeholders, trafficking tasks between the creative team and client POCs, coordinating with cross-channel PMs on shared deliverables, and organizing client-provided assets within Power Digital’s file structure.
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes.
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital’s Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department.
  • Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • 4+ years in healthcare or pharmaceutical creative production, agency or in-house, with direct exposure to MLR review workflows
  • Demonstrated understanding of FDA OPDP guidance and 21 CFR 202, including fair balance, ISI placement, branded vs. unbranded vs. disease-awareness content rules, and 2253 filing requirements
  • Veeva Vault PromoMats experience (annotating, claims management, submission tracking) highly preferred
  • Strong eye for brand consistency, design quality, and copy accuracy across digital formats (paid social, display, landing pages, email)
  • Process-oriented with the ability to document, maintain, and improve QA standards without external direction
  • Comfortable reviewing and providing clear, actionable feedback on creative work from designers, copywriters, and freelancers
  • Proficiency with Asana or comparable project management platforms
  • Experience working alongside project management teams in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Bonus: Veeva PromoMats certification, experience with modular content strategies, or prior work across both pharma-regulated and non-regulated healthcare clients

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • First-pass approval rate: 80%+ of assets cleared by client M/L/R reviewers on first submission
  • QA turnaround time: internal reviews completed within defined SLA (e.g. 24–48 hours)
  • Pre-launch error rate: <2% of launched assets requiring post-launch correction
  • 100% accuracy on 2253 filings and regulatory submission packaging
  • Documented QA standards maintained and current across all supported accounts

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Establish the pre-submission and pre-launch QA checkpoints as defined, repeatable stages in the creative workflow.
  • Own the Veeva PromoMats workflow for assigned accounts — claims, annotations, references, and submissions operating cleanly from day one.
  • Build and maintain the QA standards documentation (checklists, compliance reference guides, brand review criteria) the creative team works against.
  • Develop a working rhythm with Creative Project Managers so that QA is a checkpoint in the pipeline, not a bottleneck.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. jobs.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

About the Role

This is a role for someone who wants to set the visual standard for PrizePicks, make a lot of the work with their own hands, and build a team of supervillains while they do it.

PrizePicks is a skill-based Daily Fantasy sports platform where fans make Picks and build Entries. The Creative Collective is the small, high-conviction team that decides how the brand looks, sounds, and shows up. The talent is some of the best and hungriest we've worked with. The work is fun, the team is fun, and we don't take ourselves too seriously. We take the work very seriously.

As Creative Director, you're the visual authority for the brand. You set the direction for campaigns across OOH, TVC, social, and in-app messaging, and you shape how the brand evolves from sport to sport and year to year. You lead Design, Copy, and Creative Ops, and you're still in the files: designing OOH, end cards, and phone screens for TV, and steering key visuals alongside your designers.

This is a player-coach seat. Expect to spend roughly 60 to 70 percent of your week making and directing the work, and the rest leading the team and representing Creative in the room. You're also the first gate. Nothing reaches the Head of Brand & Creative until you've pushed it, sharpened it, or killed it.

The team has the talent. It needs more firepower. The impact you have on this business will set us apart from the competition.

How We Work

Lead with conviction: Be Iverson

Bring work you believe in and have a strong POV. Authenticity matters more than the idea itself. If the idea could live with another brand's logo on it, it doesn't belong here. We'd rather refine a bold idea than try to save a safe one.

Sharpen each other: Be Pharrell

Value direct feedback and be comfortable in conflict. Debate makes the work better. Once a call is made, we move together. Mediocre work is a collective failure, not an individual one.

Execute under pressure: Be Jordan

The standard does not change when the moment does. We move with precision and continually refine our judgment. Practice or clutch time, you show up with the same intensity.

Show up fully: Be Virgil

Show up wherever you are needed, whenever you are needed, without hesitation. Not for credit, for the outcome. It's not about doing everything. It's about doing what's required to make it right.

What You'll Do

Set the visual direction

  • Own the visual direction for campaigns across OOH, TVC, social, and in-app messaging
  • Define how the brand flexes across sports and evolves year over year while staying unmistakably PrizePicks
  • Build and present visual identity and direction decks to the broader Marketing org as visuals are finalized
  • Bring a way of thinking about our creative process and brand that we're not even considering yet, and push PrizePicks to be the standard for creative and branding in this space

Make the work

  • Design hands-on: OOH, TV End Cards & Creative, campaign key visuals, in-app messages, and whatever the moment calls for
  • Art direct motion and video, and add motion treatments yourself when they elevate the work
  • Hold craft high at volume across every format and platform

Lead the team

  • Manage Design, Copy, and Creative Ops.
  • Own performance reviews, hiring decisions, and career growth for your team
  • Learn each person's strengths and gaps, and put them where they do their best work
  • Act as the first gate for creative: push it, sharpen it, or kill it before it goes to key stakeholders.
  • Have the ability to recommend when additional resources are needed beyond the teams capacity with strong business cases.
  • Run creative reviews with direct, useful feedback, and make sure the team moves together

Partner across the business

  • Be the face of Marketing & Brand Creative beyond just marketing.
  • Present finalized creative and visual direction to the wider org, and explain why the work works
  • Partner with Legal to make great work inside compliance guardrails
  • Keep the work culturally connected, from the TVC down to organic social

Who You Are

  • A maker first. You want to be in the files, and you lead by raising the bar on the work itself
  • Opinionated with taste. You can say why something is right, and you can kill what isn't
  • Culturally fluent. You know the difference between participating in culture and chasing it, and your ideas start from real insight, not trends
  • Hungry, fast, and efficient. Volume doesn't scare you
  • A builder of people. You grow talent, set a high standard, and give feedback that makes the work and the person better
  • More than a designer focused on craft. You're constantly looking for ways to break through & grow teams
  • Low ego, high standards. If a teammate's idea beats yours, you back it

Qualifications

  • A portfolio of strong work across sports and entertainment. We care about the work more than the years, and Daily Fantasy or adjacent industry experience is not required
  • Experience leading and growing a creative team
  • Figma and Adobe Creative Suite are mandatory
  • Hands-on craft across OOH, TV and video, social, and digital or in-app
  • Strong concepting instincts
  • Experience presenting creative direction to cross-functional partners and senior leaders
  • Comfort creating great work within legal and compliance guardrails
  • Hungry, fast, and efficient
  • A passion for sports, hip-hop, and/or culture

Bonus Points

  • Motion design experience (a major plus)
  • AI in your workflow in some way, shape, or form
  • Experience on athlete, talent, or creator campaigns and shoots
  • Experience building or evolving a brand system across multiple categories or properties

What to Expect

We work incredibly hard, and we care a lot about how PrizePicks is perceived in the world. To keep it a buck, that might mean some long days, sometimes nights, and rare weekends to make sure we stay ahead of the game.

What Success Looks Like

In six months, your impact is already visible. The team under you is growing and taking on bigger things, and you're bringing a different level of thinking to our creative process and branding.

In twelve months, you have full control of the creative team. You know each person's strengths and gaps, and you know how to push the team to its full potential. You have a solid understanding of the brand and how to present culturally connected ideas, not only at the TVC level but across every channel we impact. You will have made sure that PrizePicks is the standard when it comes to creative and branding in this space.

Location

  • While we prefer candidates based in New York City or Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates.

Working at PrizePicks:

The typical salary range for this position is $160,000 to $200,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. jobs.description:
gestalte mit uns die energiewende

Wir von TESVOLT Energy machen es für Betreiber kleiner und mittlerer Batteriespeicher erstmals möglich, lukrativ am Flexibilitätshandel teilzunehmen. Bisher hatten sie keine Chance, einen guten Trader zu finden, der ihre kleineren Speicherkapazitäten an der Energiebörse handelt. Wir bringen sie gebündelt als virtuelles Kraftwerk ans Netz – gehandelt durch die besten Trader am Markt.

Unsere Arbeit ist technisch anspruchsvoll, datenbasiert und nah an der Praxis. Genau das begeistert unser Team: ein Umfeld, in dem Analyst:innen, Entwickler:innen und Strateg:innen gemeinsam etwas bewegen können.

Du denkst Infrastruktur nicht nur mit, sondern voraus? Du willst Systeme bauen, die stabil, sicher und skalierbar sind – und gleichzeitig Entwicklerteams empowern? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Diese Stelle kannst du remote bei uns ausführen.

deine aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Marketing bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Nachbereitung von Kampagnen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommunikationsmaßnahmen ein.
  • Du erstellst und pflegst Content für unsere Website, LinkedIn und weitere Kommunikationskanäle und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Themen verständlich, professionell und zielgruppengerecht aufbereitet werden.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Broschüren, Grafiken und weiteren Marketingmaterialien und achtest dabei auf eine saubere Umsetzung unseres Corporate Designs.
  • Du wirkst bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Messen, Veranstaltungen und vertriebsnahen Kommunikationsformaten mit.
  • Du wertest Marketing Kennzahlen aus, bereitest Ergebnisse übersichtlich auf und hilfst dabei, unsere Aktivitäten datenbasiert weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei der Erstellung von Erlösberechnungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen für Batteriespeicherprojekte.
  • Du bereitest Kundendaten, Projektinformationen sowie Angebots- und Präsentationsunterlagen strukturiert für Vertrieb, Partner und Management auf.
  • Du pflegst CRM und Kundendaten zuverlässig und stellst sicher, dass relevante Informationen sauber dokumentiert und für das Team nutzbar sind.
  • Du bekommst einen umfassenden Einblick in Marketing und Sales eines innovativen Unternehmens der Energiewirtschaft, von Website Texten und LinkedIn Beiträgen über Kampagnen bis hin zu konkreten Vertriebsprojekten.

dein profil

  • Du absolvierst ein Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft, Energiewirtschaft oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Du interessierst dich für erneuerbare Energien, Batteriespeicher, Energiehandel und die Frage, wie wirtschaftlich tragfähige Lösungen die Energiewende voranbringen können.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und zuverlässig und hast Freude daran, Themen sauber aufzubereiten und sichtbar voranzubringen.
  • Du verfügst zwingend über gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B1/B2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst Inhalte klar, präzise und adressatengerecht formulieren.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel.
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Marketing-Content, Präsentationen oder Social Media Beiträgen sind von Vorteil.
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, visuelle Kommunikation und saubere Unterlagen ist wünschenswert.
  • Du hast Lust auf die hands-on Mentalität eines jungen Start-ups und schätzt gleichzeitig die Zugehörigkeit zu einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe

warum wir?

Wir sind ein Team aus Batteriespeicher-, Daten- und Energiemarktexpert:innen, die vorher teils bei

Energiehandel aus erster Hand mit.

klugen Ideen, starken Partnern und einem besonderen Team.

jobs.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Chamorro-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Chamorro Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Chamorro Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Chamorroand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inChamorroand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for One Hundred Eighty (180) days from the posting date of May 15, 2026.

jobs.excerpt: About UsTameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for an ML Platform Engineer, Evaluation Systems to build and maintain the infrastructure that allows Bask Health to evaluate machine learning models and AI-powered applications reliably, consistently, and at scale.

Bask Health supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses through a platform that connects patient experiences, merchant operations, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce capabilities. As machine learning and AI become more integrated into these systems, we need dependable infrastructure for measuring model quality, comparing changes, and understanding how AI systems perform before and after deployment.

You'll help develop the platform services, data pipelines, execution environments, and monitoring capabilities that support machine learning evaluation across engineering teams.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on the operational infrastructure behind evaluation systems. You'll work with cloud services, distributed processing, model integrations, databases, and automated workflows to support repeatable experiments and large-scale evaluation jobs.

Your work may include building evaluation job orchestration, managing benchmark datasets, developing experiment tracking systems, supporting model comparisons, and creating infrastructure that stores and analyzes evaluation results.

You'll collaborate with machine learning engineers, applied scientists, AI evaluation engineers, and backend engineers to understand their technical requirements and build reusable systems that support different model types and evaluation methodologies.

You'll also help improve the reliability and reproducibility of evaluation workflows. This includes ensuring experiments can be repeated, datasets and configurations are versioned, failures are observable, and results can be compared accurately over time.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, evaluation infrastructure must support appropriate privacy controls, secure data access, and responsible handling of sensitive information. You'll help ensure evaluation datasets and model outputs are managed according to approved security and operational requirements.

This position emphasizes strong infrastructure engineering, practical machine learning knowledge, and ownership of production platform services. You'll contribute to architecture, build scalable systems, improve operational performance, and help engineering teams evaluate AI capabilities more effectively.

  • Develop infrastructure for storing and versioning evaluation datasets.
  • Build systems for tracking model configurations, prompts, parameters, and evaluation results.

  • Develop automated pipelines for benchmarking machine learning models.

  • Support evaluation workflows for large language models, predictive models, and retrieval systems.

  • Build logging and tracing capabilities that help engineers investigate evaluation problems.
  • Develop systems for managing evaluation artifacts, reports, and historical results.
  • Integrate evaluation infrastructure with model registries and ML development workflows.
  • Implement automated quality checks that support controlled model releases.
  • Build reliable retry, timeout, and failure recovery mechanisms for evaluation workloads.
  • Optimize evaluation execution performance, infrastructure utilization, and operational costs.
  • Support distributed evaluation workloads across cloud-based compute resources.
  • Collaborate with machine learning engineers to define evaluation infrastructure requirements.
  • Work with applied scientists to support reproducible experiments and benchmark comparisons.
  • Develop tools that simplify evaluation configuration and execution for engineering teams.
  • Implement secure access controls for evaluation datasets and results.
  • Ensure evaluation systems respect tenant boundaries and approved data-handling practices.
  • Investigate infrastructure incidents and improve evaluation platform reliability.
  • Document evaluation infrastructure, deployment procedures, and operational standards.
  • Own assigned ML evaluation platform projects from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages.

  • Experience developing APIs and backend service integrations.
  • Understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure and production deployments.
  • Familiarity with automated testing and continuous integration practices.
  • Understanding of machine learning model versioning and experiment reproducibility.
  • Experience working with relational databases and structured datasets.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines and batch processing workflows.
  • Experience designing reliable background job systems.
  • Understanding of infrastructure scalability, performance, and fault tolerance.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and production observability.
  • Experience implementing retries, timeouts, and error recovery.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure service communication.
  • Familiarity with configuration management and deployment automation.
  • Experience writing maintainable, well-tested production code.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex backend or infrastructure issues.
  • Understanding of software release processes and operational reliability.
  • Experience using Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
  • Ability to translate machine learning requirements into scalable infrastructure.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with machine learning engineers, applied scientists, and software engineers.
  • Ability to independently own engineering projects from design through deployment.

We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Chin Hakha-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Chin Hakha Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.00 - $1.15 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Chin Hakha Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Chin Hakhaand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inChin Hakhaand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for One Hundred Eighty (180) days from the posting date of May 15, 2026.

stellenausschreibung

Mit unserer Marke deinSchrank.de stehen wir für maßgefertigte Möbel „Made in Germany“. In unserer eigenen Produktion fertigen wir in Losgröße 1 und begeistern Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa – überwiegend über unsere digitalen Kanäle.
Unser Marketing bauen wir gerade neu auf. das erwartet dich

  • Du verantwortest die Conversion-Optimierung unserer Online-Shops und baust ein systematisches Testprogramm auf, in dem dauerhaft Tests laufen.
  • Du entwickelst Hypothesen aus Daten, Nutzerverhalten, Kundenfeedback und Wettbewerbsvergleichen und priorisierst sie in einem transparenten Backlog.
  • Du konzipierst A/B-Tests, setzt Varianten KI-gestützt um – etwa Mockups, Texte und Layouts – und wertest sie statistisch sauber aus.
  • Du optimierst unseren Online-Konfigurator, Produktseiten, Checkout und Landingpages und reduzierst gezielt Hürden und Abbrüche im Planungs- und Kaufprozess.
  • Wo der Traffic für A/B-Tests nicht reicht, arbeitest du mit qualitativen Methoden wie Session-Analysen, Heatmaps und Nutzerbefragungen.
  • Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse und Learnings in einem Testlog und stellst sie regelmäßig im Management und im Team vor.
  • Du baust agentische Workflows für Analyse, Variantenentwicklung und Reporting auf.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Performance Marketing, CRM, Content, Design und unserer Webentwicklung zusammen.

das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in der Conversion-Optimierung, idealerweise im E-Commerce, mit einer großen Zahl selbst verantworteter Tests
  • Ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Änderungen wirklich verkaufen – und nicht nur, was gut aussieht
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Testmethodik und Statistik, z. B. Signifikanz, Laufzeiten und Stichprobengrößen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Analyse- und Testing-Tools wie GA4, Microsoft Clarity oder gängigen A/B-Testing-Plattformen
  • Ein ausgeprägtes UX-Verständnis; Webdesign-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus, Programmierkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich
  • Eine starke KI-Affinität und Erfahrung darin, Mockups, Varianten und Analysen mit KI-Tools zu erstellen
  • Durchsetzungsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse auch auf Management-Ebene überzeugend zu vertreten
  • Erfahrung mit konfigurierbaren oder erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten ist von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Niederländisch ist ein Plus
  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise; ein Wohnort im Raum Köln/Bonn ist ein Plus

das bieten wir dir

  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unseres Testprogramms – inklusive der Freiheit, es mit KI-Agenten zu skalieren – und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis mit einer fairen, leistungsgerechten Vergütung in einem wachstumsstarken, innovativen Unternehmen
  • Moderne Tools und eine eigene KI-Infrastruktur für das Marketing
  • 30 Urlaubstage und eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung
  • Eine offene Kommunikationskultur, flache Hierarchien und ein familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld
  • Eine gezielte Einarbeitung sowie Weiterbildung und Förderung deiner Entwicklung
  • Rabatte auf unsere Möbel, „Family and Friends“-Angebote und weitere Mitarbeitervorteile
  • Remote-Arbeit aus ganz Deutschland und regelmäßige Mitarbeiter-Events vor Ort

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Chin Senthang-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Chin Senthang Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.60 - $0.75 per minute

Position Overview:

The Chin Senthang Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Chin Senthangand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. jobs.excerpt: Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C).
jobs.description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

About the Role

The Enterprise Learning Training Design Manager will lead the CAS Training Design team in developing high-quality, scalable learning experiences that improve employee capabilities, operational performance, retention, and business results across Farmers.

This role manages Learning Experience Designers, Content Developers, and rotational design resources, providing direction, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure learning solutions meet consistent instructional, visual design, accessibility, and technical standards.

The team is evolving from a traditional trainer-led delivery model toward a modern, capability-based learning ecosystem that embeds learning into everyday work through technology, performance support, and leaders as teachers. As a key leader in this transformation, you will help determine the most effective learning approach for each business need, whether that means developing an interactive digital module, a concise job aid, a short video, or resources that enable supervisors to coach employees directly.

The ideal candidate combines strong instructional design expertise with people leadership, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to balance quality, speed, and business impact in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop Learning Experience Designers and Content Developers, promoting high-quality work and continuous improvement.
  • Establish and maintain instructional design, visual design, accessibility, and technical quality standards across learning materials.
  • Review learning assets and provide actionable feedback to improve instructional effectiveness, usability, and learner experience.
  • Manage team workload, project priorities, resource allocation, and deadlines to ensure efficient and timely delivery.
  • Guide the selection of appropriate learning solutions, including e-learning, videos, job aids, performance support, and supervisor-led coaching.
  • Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to align learning solutions with operational needs and business objectives.
  • Drive the evolution toward a scalable, capability-based learning model that embeds learning into everyday work.
  • Promote the use of learning technologies, innovative design practices, and AI tools to improve development efficiency and learning outcomes.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, templates, and best practices to improve consistency, scalability, and team effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to improve learning processes, content quality, and business performance through continuous evaluation and innovation.

Requirements

  • Significant experience in instructional design, learning experience design, training development, educational technology, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or coaching design professionals or content development teams.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies, adult learning principles, and digital learning development.
  • Experience reviewing learning materials and providing detailed feedback on instructional effectiveness, visual design, accessibility, usability, and technical quality.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, balancing team capacity, prioritizing requests, and delivering high-quality work within established timelines.
  • Ability to evaluate business needs and recommend appropriate learning solutions based on complexity, urgency, scalability, and expected impact.
  • Experience with e-learning development tools, digital learning platforms, and multimedia learning solutions.
  • Strong understanding of visual design principles, content structure, learner experience, and accessibility considerations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, designers, developers, and operational leaders.
  • Strong coaching, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Fluent English, with the ability to communicate effectively with international stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred in Instructional Design, Instructional Technology, Educational Technology, Curriculum and Instruction, Adult Learning, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Additional knowledge of Cognitive Psychology, Learning Sciences, Graphic Design, UX Design, Multimedia Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Accessibility, Organizational Development, or Business Management is an advantage.

Benefits

  1. Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  2. Comprehensive benefits package
  3. Career development and training opportunities
  4. Flexible work arrangements
  5. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  6. Private Health and Dental Insurance
  7. Pension Plan
  8. Meals tickets
  9. Life Insurance

Emerse, a dynamic Sales Consulting business, is searching for the next Sales Super Coach. We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced sales leader or coach to join us as a Certified Sales Coach.

We are seeking a seasoned professional with proven sales experience and results, looking to transition into a coaching/consulting role, or an existing coach interested in helping business owners across the US, UK, and Europe smash their sales targets. On average, our coaches earn approximately $150,000 - $250,000 (variable and uncapped).

This role is a primarily remote role from anywhere in the US (with primarily eastern time work hours). Your purpose: embed lasting sales performance by applying proven strategies, building accountability, and delivering exceptional coaching experiences.

This is not your typical consultancy gig; it’s a chance to make a measurable difference every day.

  • Deliver high-impact coaching engagements using Emerse IP and methodology

  • Facilitate team bootcamps, strategy workshops, and performance reviews

  • 10+ years in B2B sales and leadership roles.
