We’re hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us.

Job Summary

May Mobility is entering an exciting phase of growth as we expand our first-of-its-kind autonomous shuttle and mobility services across the nation. Launched in 2017 with a strong team of experienced roboticists and software engineers with decades of experience fielding robotic systems in the wild, May Mobility is looking to expand its team of robotics engineers with a background in robotics or autonomous vehicles.

As Perception Lead, you will own the technical direction of how our vehicles see and interpret the world. This is a hands-on role focused on three priorities: advancing scene detection so the system reliably recognizes its operating context and engages the right behavior; hardening perception against sensor degradation and adverse weather (rain, snow, fog, glare, low light, and sensor soiling or occlusion) so performance degrades gracefully and safely; and driving major architectural updates to evolve our perception stack into a scalable, maintainable, production-grade foundation. You will set the technical bar, mentor engineers, and deliver capabilities that operate safely in the real world.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Work independently with cross-functional teams to develop software and system requirements.
  • Lead major architectural updates to the perception stack, including system-level design, modularization, and migration strategies that improve scalability, latency, and maintainability across the fleet.
  • Design, develop, and own scene detection and activation capabilities, classifying the operating scene/scenario and triggering the appropriate perception behaviors and operational design domain (ODD) logic at runtime.
  • Improve perception robustness under degradation and adverse weather, including sensor fault detection, health monitoring, graceful degradation, and fallback strategies for rain, snow, fog, glare, low-light, and sensor soiling/occlusion conditions.
  • Design, implement, and test state-of-the-art perception features on time with high quality, industrial-grade production code.
  • Integrate large-scale multi-modal models (including but not limited to VLMs and LLMs) into the perception stack to improve semantic scene understanding and reasoning.
  • Track and trend technical performance of perception in the field.
  • Lead major feature development including feature design, code reviews, issue diagnosis, and resolution.
  • Lead extensive testing to validate features and satisfy release schedules.
  • Lead development related to data, development, and ML pipelines, specifically focused on multimodal data alignment for training foundation models.

Skills and Abilities

Success in this role typically requires the following competencies:

  • Proven ability to architect and evolve large-scale perception or autonomy systems, balancing performance, latency, safety, and long-term maintainability.
  • Strong grasp of perception robustness and reliability engineering, including degraded-sensor operation, adverse-weather handling, fault detection, and graceful degradation.
  • Experience with scene/scenario understanding and runtime activation logic (e.g., context classification, ODD monitoring, behavior triggering).
  • Familiar with ML development cycle, deployment, and optimization.
  • Deep understanding of data: data pipeline, data balancing, data mining, and data-driven performance improvement.
  • Knowledge of multimodal learning techniques, including contrastive learning and prompt engineering for zero-shot visual recognition.
  • Deep understanding of testing frameworks and workflows.
  • Excellent attention to detail and rigorous testing methodology.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and team-leading abilities.

Qualifications and Experience

Candidates most successful in this role typically hold the following qualifications or comparable knowledge or experience:

Required

  • A minimum of 5+ years of industry experience working on real-world robot systems maintaining high-quality industrial-grade code.
  • Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering, or a field that requires a strong mathematical and/or engineering foundation.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or making major architectural decisions for a perception, robotics, or autonomy software stack.
  • Strong programming skills in C/C++/Python; software development in Linux environments.
  • Strong experience in ML/DL development with PyTorch/TensorFlow.
  • Direct experience developing or fine-tuning large-scale multi-modal models (e.g., multi-sensor fusion models, foundation models, including VLM backbones) for real-world perception applications.
  • Experience working on a combination of several of the following real-time areas:
    • Computer Vision: object detection, classification, segmentation.
    • Semantic scene understanding, scene/scenario detection, and open-vocabulary detection.
    • Perception robustness in degraded or adverse-weather conditions.
    • Multi-target tracking and sensor fusion.
  • Extensive experience deploying features/ML/DL models in real-time systems with high accuracy and low latency.

Desirable

  • Experience developing all-weather / adverse-condition perception, sensor degradation modeling, fault detection, and graceful-degradation strategies for safety-critical systems.
  • Experience with scene/scenario classification, ODD monitoring, and runtime capability activation in autonomous systems.
  • Experience re-architecting or migrating large, legacy perception systems to modern, scalable frameworks.
  • Experience utilizing large-scale multi-modal models for edge-case (long-tail) detection and explainable AI in autonomous systems.
  • Familiar with synthetic data in ML system development.
  • Familiar with Reinforcement Learning (RL) for ML systems.
  • Familiar with ML/DL optimization on real-time products with limited compute resources (e.g., quantization of large transformer models).
  • Strong background demonstrated through high-quality capability deliveries to robots working in the field.

Physical Requirements

  • Standard office working conditions which includes but is not limited to:
    • Prolonged sitting
    • Prolonged standing
    • Prolonged computer use
  • Travel required? - Moderate: 11%-25%

Benefits and Perks

  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Healthcare and Dependent Care Accounts available.
  • Rich retirement benefits, including an immediately vested employer safe harbor match.
  • Generous paid parental leave as well as a phased return to work.
  • Flexible vacation policy in addition to paid company holidays.
  • Total Wellness Program providing numerous resources for overall wellbeing
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and/or people of color are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every qualification. At May Mobility, we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workforce, so if you’re excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway! Role overview

We're looking for an experienced personal finance writer with strong knowledge of the financial landscape across Russia and excellent writing and editorial skills in Russian.

You'll help create, review, and maintain accurate, engaging, and accessible personal finance content for nudge, covering everything from everyday money management and budgeting to investing, retirement, and other financial topics relevant to the local market.

This role combines personal finance expertise, strong writing and editorial skills, and the effective use of AI-assisted tools. You'll be responsible for creating clear, accurate, and engaging personal finance content that helps people understand their options and make informed financial decisions. AI-assisted tools support research, editing, and quality assurance, while human judgement, accuracy, and editorial ownership remain central to everything we produce.

Responsibilities

  • Act as nudge's personal finance subject-matter expert for Russia, maintaining a strong understanding of local financial products, regulations, government initiatives, and developments affecting consumers

  • Research, pitch, write, and refine personal finance content, including evergreen articles, educational posts, and other formats

  • Use AI-assisted tools to support research, editing, and quality assurance while maintaining full editorial responsibility for the content

  • Critically evaluate suggestions and feedback from AI-assisted editorial tools, applying independent judgement to determine appropriate changes

  • Participate in human-in-the-loop (HITL) editorial workflows, reviewing feedback, resolving identified issues, and ensuring content meets nudge's quality standards

  • Independently verify financial information using reliable and authoritative sources

  • Review and update existing content to reflect changes in legislation, financial products, and local market developments

  • Adapt complex financial topics into clear, practical, and engaging content appropriate for the intended audience, while following nudge's editorial guidelines and tone of voice

  • Identify relevant and timely content opportunities, proposing ideas based on market developments, audience needs, and content priorities

  • Collaborate with regional content managers and other internal stakeholders to meet deadlines and maintain consistent editorial standards

Skills and experience

The ideal candidate should:

  • Have strong knowledge of personal finance across Russia, including relevant financial regulations, consumer financial products, and government schemes

  • Demonstrate excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills in Russian, with the ability to explain complex financial information clearly and naturally

  • Have experience creating clear, accurate, and engaging personal finance content that makes complex financial topics accessible to different audiences

  • Be comfortable using AI-assisted tools within an editorial workflow, with an understanding of their strengths and limitations

  • Demonstrate strong editorial judgement and the ability to critically evaluate automated suggestions rather than accepting them without question

  • Understand the importance of human oversight, factual accuracy, and accountability when using AI-assisted tools

  • Be adaptable and willing to learn new technologies and editorial processes

  • Have strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing financial figures, regulatory requirements, eligibility conditions, and other potentially sensitive information

  • Be able to write and edit naturally in Russian, ensuring that content is locally relevant and does not read like a literal translation or unedited AI output

  • Have strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence and professionalism to represent nudge in client-facing discussions when required

  • Be organised, reliable, and able to manage deadlines while working independently in a remote, collaborative environment

  • Be adaptable and open to evolving tools, technologies, and editorial processes

Experience with AI-assisted editorial processes, localisation, personal finance content, or multilingual editorial workflows would be an advantage.

We're looking for a Travel Consultant to own high-volume outbound member texting for a travel membership company whose members are primarily college students. You will send outbound texts to a large volume of members on a recurring basis, personalizing each message just enough to feel human, fun, and relevant rather than copied and pasted. This role is about speed, accuracy, and quality at scale — not strategy, marketing, or primarily inbound support.

The audience is college-aged. They text casually, they know when something feels scripted, and they respond to people who feel like peers rather than customer service reps. The right person for this role is digitally native, plugged into social media and current culture, and can match the energy and communication style of a college student naturally. If you can text like a friend, bring genuine enthusiasm to the work, and stay sharp and detail-oriented while moving through a high volume of conversations, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Full-time, 100% remote role
  • Preferred overlap with EST hours
  • Paid Time Off and Holiday observance per company policy
  • Clear path to expanded responsibilities including inbound support and broader member success work as trust is built

What You'll Work On

  • Send outbound texts to a large volume of members using approved messaging patterns and base templates
  • Personalize messages so they feel timely, human, and casual rather than copied and pasted
  • Review recent message history before sending so members do not receive repetitive styles or tones
  • Notice details such as recent or upcoming travel, or planning stage, and use them to choose the best message variation
  • Move through a high number of conversations quickly while staying accurate and detail-oriented
  • Read member conversations regularly to build familiarity and judgment over time
  • Follow messaging guidance while making smart small adjustments when needed
  • Escalate unusual, high-stakes, or unclear situations rather than guessing

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Role: Solutions Architect


Who we are

RBRO Solutions builds best-of-breed software for the legal and corporate legal markets, serving customers around the globe. Join a modern, agile team that keeps us among the top companies in our industry.


Our core values: Innovation, Experience, Excellence, Partnership, Balance, Integrity, Diversity and Gratitude.


What to expect

  • Build your career with a growing technology company
  • A challenging, collaborative team environment
  • Competitive salary and medical benefits
  • Salary range: $90,000–$115,000 CAD

About the role

The Solutions Architect turns business needs into sound technical solutions. You will work with business leaders, project managers, vendor architects and subject-matter experts to identify needs, plan delivery alongside other initiatives, and make sure solutions are secure, scalable and maintainable.

Our products run as hosted cloud services and as on-premises installs at customer sites, so the role needs strong judgement across cloud, hybrid and on-premises designs.


Reports to: Director, Software Development/CTO


Responsibilities

Architecture and strategy

  • Own the target architecture and the roadmap that engineering teams deliver against, documenting current state, future state and the transition between them.
  • Lead modernization from .NET Framework 4.8 and Web API 2 to .NET 8/10 and ASP.NET Core, including containerizing Windows services.
  • Own security architecture: Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWT, secrets management (Key Vault, Secrets Manager), encryption of data in transit and at rest, and certificate handling.
  • Shape data architecture on SQL Server and PostgreSQL: schema design, stored-procedure conventions, migrations, reporting, and multi-region / DR data.
  • Make sure solutions meet non-functional requirements: security, high availability, reliability, scalability, auditability, capacity and performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and enterprise solutions, run impact assessments, and recommend what to adopt.

Solution design and delivery

  • Lead requirements gathering and turn business and non-functional requirements into solution designs, specifications and written architecture decision records.
  • Work with project managers on scope and effort estimates, and with analysts on requirements and test plans.
  • Document the costs, risks and benefits of each solution and communicate them to stakeholders and executives.
  • Confirm that teams implement designs as intended, and lead architecture governance and design reviews.
  • Take part in technical change control: changes are risk-rated, test requirements are defined, and costs and impacts are quantified.

Standards and technical leadership

  • Write and publish architecture standards, guidelines and best practices, and maintain a central architecture repository.
  • Improve CI/CD, test strategy and observability so releases are repeatable.
  • Help the development team with debugging, performance monitoring and tuning.
  • Mentor senior engineers and work with product, support and client-facing teams on technical decisions.
  • Push for simpler, streamlined business processes where the benefit outweighs the risk.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
  • 5+ years in a solution architect or principle role.
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture and design principles.
  • Experience in cloud-intensive environments, with a sound understanding of cloud deployment and integration patterns (Azure or AWS).
  • Experience architecting multi-vendor environments on-premises, in the cloud and in hybrid models.
  • Working knowledge of application security best practices and tools for web, mobile and cloud applications.
  • Experience authoring architecture standards, guidelines and process documentation at system and enterprise level.
  • Ability to evaluate options on cost, risk and benefit, negotiate trade-offs between features and scalability, and drive decisions with multiple stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Legal-technology experience, especially iManage Work, NetDocuments or other document management systems.
  • Experience in SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • Container orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Real production exposure to high-availability issues, such as clustering.
  • Observability at scale with New Relic, Application Insights or NLog.
  • Data residency and compliance work for regulated clients.

Personal traits

  • Self-starter and creative problem-solver who can lead projects with minimal direction.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Pulls together technical and non-technical input and resolves ambiguity respectfully.
  • Clear communicator in writing, in conversation and in presentations.
  • Works well independently and with everyone from senior management to individual contributors; approachable and trusted by colleagues.


Business Unit:

RBRO

37.5

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Job Description Summary:

The Director of BESS Augmentation provides strategic and operational leadership for battery energy storage system (BESS) augmentation projects. This position directs Superintendents, works collaboratively with project managers, oversees portfolio-level planning and execution, and ensures safe, timely, profitable delivery of battery capacity additions, replacements, system upgrades, integration, testing, commissioning, and turnover for SOLV and third-party clients.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned


Position Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for BESS augmentation programs, Superintendents, and technical teams in partnership with project managers.
  • Set portfolio priorities, staffing plans, governance, performance expectations, and augmentation strategies.
  • Direct safe field execution, outage and resource planning, subcontractor coordination, quality, schedule, testing, commissioning, and turnover.
  • Partner with project managers on budgets, procurement, contracts, schedules, forecasts, risks, change control, and closeout.
  • Review portfolio safety, quality, schedule, cost, margin, technical risk, commissioning readiness, customer commitments, and corrective actions.
  • Develop leaders and technical personnel through coaching, training, succession planning, and performance management.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, OEMs, integrators, utilities, contractors, and clients to align execution and resolve escalated issues.
  • Standardize project controls, reporting, installation and commissioning practices, and lessons learned to improve consistency and profitability.
  • Lead BESS safety planning and compliance, including electrical safe work, lockout/tagout, energized work, emergency response, environmental requirements, and OEM procedures.
  • Support estimating, scope development, procurement, and vendor quotations for batteries, enclosures, power conversion, transformers, controls, HVAC, fire systems, cabling, and related upgrades.
  • Oversee installation and integration of BESS electrical, mechanical, controls, communications, thermal-management, and fire-protection systems.
  • Support operating sites with augmentation planning, capacity restoration, compatibility assessments, troubleshooting, and execution.
  • Lead cross-functional resolution of battery, OEM, firmware, controls, and balance-of-system issues through documented ownership and closure.
  • Review forecasts, profit and loss, estimating accuracy, contingency, and margin-improvement actions.
  • Maintain lifecycle oversight from opportunity qualification and feasibility through design, procurement, installation, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
  • Develop BESS augmentation, optimization, reliability, and lifecycle-service opportunities with Business Development, Asset Management, and project teams.
  • Train regional teams and improve safety, constructability, repeatability, schedule, cost, quality, and operational performance.
  • Travel at least 30% to support projects, sites, clients, and team development.
  • Maintain relevant professional and technical knowledge.
  • Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Safety and Compliance: Achieve zero preventable recordable incidents and 100% completion of required safety audits, training, corrective actions, and compliance reviews within assigned due dates.
  • Portfolio Financial Performance:Deliver the BESS Augmentation portfolio within approved budgets and forecasts, meet or exceed annual margin targets, and maintain forecast accuracy within ±5%.
  • Schedule and Delivery: Complete at least 90% of projects and major milestones on or ahead of the approved baseline schedule, with recovery plans documented for material variances.
  • Quality and Rework: Maintain a first-pass quality acceptance rate of at least 95% and keep rework costs below 2% of annual project revenue.
  • Client and Owner Engagement: Conduct at least one strategic job-site visit or business review per quarter for each priority client or owner account, with documented needs, commitments, and follow-up actions.
  • Client Satisfaction and Retention: Achieve an average client satisfaction rating of at least 4.5 out of 5 and support a client retention or repeat-business rate of at least 90%.
  • Risk and Corrective-Action Management: Escalate material safety, client, schedule, and financial risks within one business day and close at least 90% of corrective actions by their agreed due dates.
  • Workforce and Succession: Maintain documented development plans for 100% of direct reports, complete quarterly talent reviews, and identify at least one succession candidate for each critical leadership role.
  • Operational Improvement: Implement at least three measurable process improvements annually that improve safety, cycle time, quality, scalability, or profitability.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, business, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent BESS leadership experience may be considered.
  • Progressive leadership experience in utility-scale BESS, power generation, electrical construction, commissioning, operations and maintenance, or a related technical-services environment.
  • Experience leading managers, Superintendents, field teams, subcontractors, and multiple concurrent BESS augmentation projects.
  • Advanced knowledge of BESS governance, estimating, budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, procurement, contracts, outage planning, risk, change control, commissioning, and financial performance.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience partnering with clients, owners, Estimating, and project management to develop solutions, define executable scopes, and support sound investment and delivery decisions.
  • Ability to communicate strategy, priorities, performance, and risk effectively to executives, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Advanced knowledge of battery systems, power conversion, transformers, switchgear, protection and controls, communications, HVAC, and fire detection and suppression.
  • Ability to interpret BESS electrical, controls, communications, mechanical, fire-protection, and site-integration drawings and specifications.
  • Understanding of BESS scope, interfaces, acceptance criteria, warranties, turnover obligations, safety hazards, and emergency response.
  • Ability to communicate strategy, risk, safety, performance, and project status to executives, clients, OEMs, utilities, and project teams.
  • Ability to develop accountable teams, resolve escalated issues, train technical personnel, prioritize resources, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Advanced written, verbal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to conduct leadership visits at remote project locations and work safely in varying weather and field conditions.
  • Availability to provide executive escalation support for critical incidents, including occasional after-hours or weekend events
  • Ability to support accurate estimates and proposals with scope, quantities, assumptions, risks, and cost inputs and to manage OEM, supplier, contractor, testing, and commissioning interfaces.
  • Advanced computer, organizational, and written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, and ability to operate a company vehicle.
  • Ability to work independently and safely in field conditions and remain current on required safety, technical, OEM, commissioning, and emergency-response training.

jobs.description:
Product Manager — Virtualisation & Cloud Infrastructure

Location: Remote in Europe / EMEA

Department: Product Management

Employment type: Contractor friendly

Virtuozzo is a provider of infrastructure software for AI and the cloud, helping cloud service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and operate efficient, scalable infrastructure. We combine an optimized operating system with orchestration, management, automation, and protection to deliver mainframe-like efficiency, performance, reliability, versatility, and security—while reducing overall cost and complexity.

Our Virtuozzo Infrastructure System (V/IS) brings together compute, storage, and networking to support traditional applications, cloud-native workloads, and AI services. We help organisations modernise their infrastructure, make better use of their hardware, and bring new cloud- and GPU-powered services to market on their own infrastructure and under their own brand.

Our technology serves more than 100,000 companies in over 100 countries. With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue to contribute to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.

The Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager for V/IS to help shape the future of the Virtuozzo product suite, including virtualisation, cloud management platforms, and infrastructure solutions for CSP, MSP, and SME markets.

This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong product judgement, technical depth, market awareness, and customer empathy. You will work closely with engineering, sales, marketing, support, and customer-facing teams to define what we build, why we build it, how we position it, and how it creates measurable value for customers.

This is not a pure backlog-management role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage deeply with technical customers, understand infrastructure markets, make clear prioritisation decisions, and turn product direction into execution.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Drive product strategy for the Virtuozzo product suite, including virtualisation, cloud management platforms, and infrastructure solutions for CSP, MSP, and SME markets.
  • Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with company business objectives, customer needs, market opportunities, and Virtuozzo’s broader platform direction.
  • Engage with key customers and stakeholders to gather insights, validate product hypotheses, and refine strategies to address market demands.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and support teams to ensure successful execution of product launches, feature iterations, and market positioning.
  • Lead market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive threats, ensuring Virtuozzo is positioned to capitalise on new technologies and shifts in the market.
  • Define and implement pricing models and value propositions that drive customer adoption and revenue growth while maintaining a competitive edge in the market.
  • Work on cross-product initiatives to create a seamless experience across the Virtuozzo ecosystem, including integrations with third-party tools and emerging technologies.
  • You will also help connect product strategy to real customer outcomes: faster cloud service launches, lower infrastructure cost, better operational efficiency, improved monetisation for service providers, and a simpler experience across the Virtuozzo platform.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience in cloud infrastructure, virtualisation, cloud management platforms, infrastructure software, hosting, telco cloud, MSP/CSP platforms, or adjacent technical domains.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure technologies such as virtualisation, KVM, OpenStack, Kubernetes, software-defined storage, networking, orchestration, automation, or cloud management platforms.
  • Experience building product strategy and roadmaps for technical B2B products used by infrastructure teams, service providers, managed service providers, enterprises, or SaaS companies.
  • Ability to work closely with engineering teams and engage in technical discussions with architects, developers, solution architects, support engineers, and customer operations teams.
  • Strong customer-discovery skills, with the ability to translate technical and commercial pain points into clear product priorities.
  • Experience with market analysis, competitor research, pricing, packaging, value propositions, and product positioning.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product narratives, roadmap updates, business cases, and launch materials.
  • A structured, analytical approach to prioritization, with comfort using customer input, market data, usage data, commercial impact, and technical feasibility to make product decisions.
  • Confidence working across distributed, international teams.

Nice to Have

  • CSP, MSP, hosting, telco, or cloud service provider environments.
  • VMware alternatives, OpenStack-based platforms, KVM-based virtualisation, Kubernetes orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
  • Product ownership for cloud control panels, cloud management platforms, portals, billing integrations, self-service platforms, or infrastructure operations tooling.
  • Pricing and packaging for infrastructure software, subscription models, usage-based models, or service-provider commercial models.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, GPU infrastructure, edge infrastructure, hybrid cloud, or multi-cloud management.

What We Offer

  • Remote work from Europe / EMEA.
  • Flexible working hours and a distributed international team.
  • High ownership and visibility within the Product organisation.
  • The opportunity to influence product and R&D direction from day one.
  • A technical, engineering-driven culture with practical decision-making and minimal bureaucracy.
  • Work on meaningful infrastructure products used by cloud providers, MSPs, SaaS companies, and enterprises.
  • Private medical insurance support, depending on location and employment setup.
  • Additional benefits depending on country, location, and preferred employment method.

Multi-State Remote Registered Dietitian, CDCES (Contracted)

Location: Remote — United States (Priority States: TN, OH, MS, LA)

THE HIGHLIGHTS

  • Anticipated Start Date: Late Spring/Summer 2026 (TBD)
  • Role Type: Contracted, 1099
  • Payment Terms: Net 30
  • Licensure: Valid, unencumbered state RD license required. Priority states: TN, OH, MS, LA — strong preference for candidates currently licensed in one or more of these states.
  • Certification: CDR and CDCES required.
  • Schedule: 1099 flexibility; you set your own hours with at least 20 hours of weekly availability.
    • Current Demand: Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m. ET
    • Requirement: Provide availability for the next two months by the 15th of each month.
  • Compensation:$20.00 per 20-minute clinical encounter + $30.00/hour for non-clinical time; budget for an average of $40+/hr (see Compensation & Payment Terms below).
  • Remote Requirements: Must reside in the United States with consistent access to a clean, quiet workspace; solid internet connection; and proficient technical experience.

OUR MISSION

Perry Health is rethinking chronic care through a fully remote, continuous care model. We provide expert diabetes education and clinical management for Medicare patients, delivered by a comprehensive team of specialized Registered Nurses, Registered Dietitians, and Accountability Coaches.

Our model integrates high-level clinical expertise with real-time data from cellular-connected glucometers and advanced CGM management. By bridging the gap between physician visits with proactive, data-driven support, we deliver life-changing outcomes for our members.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Registered Dietitian (RD) and Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES) passionate about remote care delivery. In this role, you will offer diabetes education and management, medical nutrition therapy, and personalized nutritional guidance for our members. You will partner with a multidisciplinary care team to ensure members receive expert clinical attention and education to lead healthier lives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide call-based care and clinical nutrition management to patients in our Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) program.
  • Assess member health regimens and interpret blood glucose and CGM readings as they relate to nutrition.
  • Craft individualized, compassionate meal plans based on member health needs and access.
  • Support nutrition-related escalations and provide data-driven education.
  • Collaborate with the broader care team — including RNs and Accountability Coaches — to reinforce clinical goals and SMART goal progression.
  • Adhere to Perry Health policies, procedures, and standard operating procedures to ensure ongoing clinical quality and compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: BS in Nutrition.
  • License: Valid, unencumbered state RD license. Priority states: TN, OH, MS, LA — strong preference for candidates currently licensed in one or more of these states.
  • Certification: CDR and CDCES required.
  • Experience: 3+ years managing patients with diabetes preferred.
  • Knowledge: Familiarity with continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) and behavior change theory is a plus.
  • Skills: Motivated learner, willing to acquire proficiency with the necessary technology (computers, software applications, phone systems); experience or training in Motivational Interviewing to support sustainable behavior change is a plus.
  • Traits: Creative thinking, an eye for detail, ability to work independently, a positive attitude, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced atmosphere while collaborating with diverse groups at all levels of the organization.
  • Language: Spanish-speaking preferred.

COMPENSATION & PAYMENT TERMS

Contractors are paid on a monthly basis following Net 30 payment terms.

  • Clinical Pay:$20.00 per 20-minute clinical encounter. An encounter is defined as a successful call with a member, primarily spent in live conversation, with chart review time also counting toward this total.
  • Non-Clinical Pay:$30.00/hour flat rate for required meetings and training.

Examples:

  • Initial consultations are scheduled in 60-minute intervals. Completing one initial consultation that meets the engagement-time requirement pays $60.
  • Follow-up visits are scheduled in 30-minute intervals. Completing two follow-ups within an hour that each meet the engagement-time requirement pays a total of $40 for that hour.

OUR VALUES

Our patients are our purpose: We understand that the decisions we make have an impact on our patients' health. We are a healthcare company above all else. The choices we make are always in the best interest of our patients.

Bring your best self: The authenticity of our team drives our innovation. We show up for each other and our patients every day. Your teammates will count on you for motivation and support, and you should expect the same in return. Conversely, recognize when you are not at your best so you can seek support and take time to recharge.

Own your ideas and your results: Each member of the team contributes to the growth of Perry. Identify problems, seek solutions that maximize impact. Ownership is key; seek out support from team members, and take accountability for the results of your efforts.

Move fast, but with purpose: Consistent, rapid growth is expected. Set goals, work with purpose, assess, reassess, and pivot when necessary. Perfection should not impede progress. Ego should not prevent reevaluation. Each day will provide opportunities for learning and growth and will move us closer to our goals.

Good ideas come from anywhere: Ideas, good and bad, come from every level of the organization. Employees at all levels are empowered to share their ideas and feedback. The whole of Perry is greater than the sum of its parts. All ideas are considered, and when a decision is made we will move forward together.

Perry Health is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all team members. We are building an environment where every Perry Health team member can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do the best work of their careers. We value diversity and recruit, hire, and promote individuals solely based on talent, qualifications, competence, and merit. We evaluate candidates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics as required by law and as a matter of our company values.

jobs.excerpt: At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold.
jobs.description:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead and evolve Koalafi’s Originations product: the end-to-end apply & checkout experiences that serve as the front door to financing for every customer. This is a high-impact role at the center of Koalafi’s strategy to accelerate growth by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive for consumers to finance their purchases across both online and in-store channels.

This role is ideal for a product manager who thrives working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and deep cross-functional collaboration. You’ll set the direction for Originations by aligning diverse partners, from Risk and Compliance to Marketing and Sales, around a cohesive strategy that accelerates growth while maintaining a unified vision.

What You’ll Do

Define and drive the Originations roadmap

  • Lead product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Originations product as an engine for growth
  • Develop the product strategy for apply & checkout flows that are reusable across diverse merchant and consumer contexts – such as a consumer’s mobile phone to a store owner’s point-of-sale system or e-commerce checkout integration

Grow and optimize the Originations funnel

  • Drive continuous funnel optimization by identifying conversion opportunities using quantitative data and qualitative insights to ship rapid improvements while balancing profitability and compliance
  • Grow Koalafi’s distribution across channels by partnering with cross-functional teams to design and ship frictionless experiences that work for both merchants and consumers

Shape the product for rapid insight generation and experimentation

  • Partner with analytics and engineering to instrument the funnel, generate actionable insights, and run A/B tests to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes
  • Mentor other PMs and establish best practices for experimentation and funnel analysis across the broader organization

Champion the customer experience

  • Champion the customer, bringing curiosity and empathy to every decision to ensure the application experience meets real customer needs
  • Conduct user research and map consumer and merchant journeys to uncover usability gaps and unmet needs

Lead delivery as the embedded product manager for the Originations team

  • Partner continuously with engineering and design to define the what and the why, translating business opportunities and customer insights into user centric solutions, while empowering the team to determine the how
  • Maintain a prioritized backlog with crisp epics and stories, clear acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes
  • Partner with analysts and product marketers to define success metrics, ensure releases are instrumented, review post-launch outcomes, and align go-to-market strategy with top-of-funnel campaigns

About You

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning application flows, onboarding funnels, checkout experiences, or other high-volume conversion-critical surfaces
  • Growth-minded and highly analytical, with deep experience in funnel optimization, experimentation, and hypothesis-driven development
  • Proficient with analytics and experimentation tools
  • Strong customer empathy and discovery skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in balancing short-term business needs with long-term product health and scalability
  • Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams toward a common goal
  • Excellent communicator who brings clarity and builds alignment across diverse stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and able to create clarity, structure, and momentum over time

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, lending, embedded finance, or consumer financial services—particularly in originations or application flow domains
  • Familiarity with the tradeoffs between conversion optimization and credit risk management in lending contexts
  • Experience with both e-commerce and in-store / point-of-sale product experiences
  • Familiarity with multi-merchant or platform business models where the application experience must adapt to diverse merchant context

Location: Richmond, VA; Arlington, VA; or Remote (U.S.). Associates near one of our office locations may work in-office, hybrid, or remotely. Remote opportunities are available to candidates throughout the United States.

Salary Range: $160,000-$200,000 per year (depending on experience and location)
Additional Compensation: This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.

The final salary offer will depend on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and geographic location. The actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

Applications will be accepted until position is filled.

Why choose Koalafi: A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.

Benefits:

At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 20 PTO days + 11 paid holidays
  • 401(k) retirement with company matching
  • Student Loan & Tuition Reimbursement
  • Commuter assistance
  • Parental leave (maternal + paternal)
  • Inclusion and Associate Engagement Programs

Who we are & what we value:

  • We focus on what’s most important
  • We set clear expectations and deliver
  • We embrace challenges to reach our full potential
  • We ask, “How can this be better?”
  • We move fast together

jobs.excerpt: Type: Full-time, salaried employment Location: Remote in the UK only.
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, salaried employment
Location: Remote in the UK only.
Salary Range: £60,000 to £70,000 + stock options


Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

About the Role

As a Senior Data Scientist on our Analytics team, you will own end-to-end problems that combine applied statistics, experimentation, and machine learning to drive measurable improvements in how our retail AI products perform in the real world. You will work on ambiguous, open-ended questions, define the right approach, and deliver insights and models that influence the roadmap of Product, Engineering, and Operations.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will set the technical direction for your projects, partner with cross-functional stakeholders, and act as a force multiplier for analytics quality across the company.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a rigorous thinker who treats data as evidence, not decoration, and is comfortable telling a clear story about uncertainty
  • You have strong technical chops in SQL and Python, and you reach for the right tool, statistical, experimental, or ML, based on the problem in front of you
  • You can design experiments, reason about causality, and identify when a correlation is enough and when it is not
  • You are comfortable owning ambiguous, open-ended problems and breaking them down into a credible plan
  • You communicate findings crisply to technical and non-technical audiences, in writing, in dashboards, and in person
  • You raise the bar for the team through code review, methodology review, and mentorship of less senior analysts and scientists

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own analytical problems end to end from problem framing and metric definition through data acquisition, modeling, validation, and stakeholder rollout
  • Build predictive and inferential models such as forecasts, propensity and uplift models, and survival or duration analyses, where they meaningfully improve a product or operational decision
  • Develop statistical methods and reusable analyses for measuring performance, including detection accuracy, intervention impact, and downstream operational outcomes
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to define key metrics, implement new features, and translate business questions into well-scoped analytical work
  • Audit system outputs and provide structured feedback that improves product accuracy and reliability
  • Communicate findings through dashboards, written analyses, and stakeholder presentations that lead to concrete decisions
  • Help define best practices around data quality, experimentation, modeling, and reproducibility, and contribute to the team’s data contracts and SOPs

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Quantitative Analyst, or similar role, with a track record of shipping analyses and models that changed product or business decisions
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex CTEs, window functions, and query optimization
  • Strong proficiency in Python for data work, including pandas, NumPy, and experience with statsmodels or other relevant tools
  • Solid grounding in applied statistics: hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, and uncertainty quantification
  • Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests or other controlled experiments in a product setting
  • Experience building at least one class of predictive model end to end, for example forecasting, classification, or propensity modeling
  • Experience with data visualization and BI tools, and the ability to turn an analysis into a clear narrative
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners without authority
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive ambiguous projects to completion

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
  • Experience with Sigma, Looker, or similar BI tools
  • Experience with database engineering/architecture
  • Background in retail, logistics, marketplaces, or other operationally complex environments
  • Experience mentoring analysts or junior data scientists

Why Focal Systems

Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.

Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.

Outstanding Partners - We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.

What we offerWe care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:

  • Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Pension
  • Sick Leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Learning and Development Budget

jobs.excerpt: The Role:Apryse is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Senior Technical Writer to join our team and help update and create content to make clear, concise, and comprehensive technical documentation for our SDK products.
jobs.description:
The Role:

Apryse is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Senior Technical Writer to join our team and help update and create content to make clear, concise, and comprehensive technical documentation for our SDK products. As a Senior Technical Writer, you will be responsible for creating and updating high-quality documentation aimed at developers who leverage Apryse’s SDKs to build critical document processing workflows in their solutions. You will work closely with our development and product teams to understand technical features and review and update draft content, including guides, concept content, and code samples. You’ll also create release notes.

Responsibilities

  • Review, update, and maintain clear, concise, and comprehensive documentation for software development tools and SDKs products.
  • Collaborate with product managers and developers to review and update best-in-class technical guides that align with product roadmaps and developer needs.
  • Partner with engineers to establish and enforce a unified documentation style, ensuring a consistent tone and structure.
  • Create and deliver targeted release notes for effective and compelling communication of product updates.
  • Gather feedback from stakeholders and the developer community to refine documentation for clarity, usability, and technical accuracy.
  • Champion Developer Experience best practices, staying current on new technologies to keep docs relevant and comprehensive.
  • Perform content updates based on audit results.
  • Test SDK documentation and make updates based on findings.

Desired Skills

  • Strong understanding of software development concepts, APIs, and SDKs, with the ability to read and understand code and translate technical concepts into clear developer documentation.
  • Experience working across multiple operating systems and platforms, including understanding platform, architecture, runtime, and native dependency requirements.
  • Familiarity with package managers and build tools, such as npm, Maven, Gradle, NuGet, pip, or CMake.
  • Proficiency with Git and GitHub and experience navigating source code, repositories, branches, pull requests, releases, and sample applications.
  • Working knowledge of command-line tools and shell environments for installing, configuring, building, running, and troubleshooting SDK applications.
  • Understanding of API specifications and documentation technologies, such as OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON Schema, Javadoc, or language-specific API reference tools.
  • Ability to test and validate documentation and code samples by building and running SDK applications and verifying expected results.
  • Working knowledge of debugging and troubleshooting, with the ability to investigate common errors, logs, configuration issues, and dependency problems.
  • Familiarity with Docker and containerized development and a general understanding of CI/CD and server deployment workflows.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, architects, product managers, and developer experience teams to understand SDK behavior and produce accurate, developer-focused documentation.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted documentation and automation, including using AI tools to research, draft, review, and maintain technical content and streamline documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of AI-ready documentation, including structured and machine-readable content, semantic search, RAG, and approaches for making documentation discoverable and usable by AI tools and agents.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of relevant experience developing documentation with a developer audience, including SDK and API documentation.
  • Experience managing large and complex documentation sets and developing well-structured and effective information architecture.
  • Ability to understand complex technical topics and translate them into easy-to-understand documentation.
  • Proven experience working independently and as part of cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment, engaging seamlessly with product managers, product marketing, and engineers.

Compensation Philosophy

The compensation for this position is commensurate upon experience, and the range listed reflects total compensation or on target earnings. The top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive experience and a profile that strongly aligns with the senior expectations of this role.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  • A comprehensive extended benefits package including health, dental and vision for you and your family, with company paid offerings.
  • An uncapped commissions structure.
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) is offered to support the ability to rest and recharge.
  • A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential.
  • Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment.
  • Annual recurring WFH allowance for you to purchase items you need for your home office.
  • Ongoing support for learning development so you can master your craft.
  • Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac).
  • Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other.
Company Description

As the industry-leading provider of document software development (SDK) technology powering everything from traditional desktop software to innovative web and mobile applications, at Apryse we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that empower our clients to achieve their goals. jobs.description:
Senior Sales Closer — AI-Powered PR & Media Placement
Base: $120K–$150K | OTE: $165K–$195K | Top Performers: $250K+ (Uncapped)
Full-Time | Individual Contributor

WHO WE ARE

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

OVERVIEW

We hand you a full calendar of qualified prospects every day. You close.

No prospecting. No cold calling. No pipeline generation. No RFP writing. No conference schmoozing. We have a proprietary AI-powered outbound engine that analyzes 300,000+ daily media stories, tracks 250,000+ journalist relationships, and generates a steady stream of qualified decision-makers who want to talk. Your only job is to get on Zoom, run the conversation, and close.

Our top-performing closers earn $250K+ annually. Here’s the math: 6 deals/month at an average of $8,500 MRR ($102K ACV) with commission accelerators and retention bonuses. The commission is uncapped. The leads are provided. The product sells. You just have to be the person who can close it.

If you’re currently spending 30–50% of your time generating your own pipeline, imagine what you could do with that time back. That’s what this role offers.

WHAT WE DO

Interdependence is the fastest-growing AI-powered PR and earned media placement firm in the country. We combine proprietary technology with world-class communication professionals to get our clients covered in the media outlets that matter — Forbes, Bloomberg, Wall Street Journal, CNN, industry-leading trade publications, and top-tier podcasts.

What makes us different: we guarantee results. While traditional PR agencies charge $10K/month retainers, we back our placements with performance guarantees. Our technology identifies the right journalists, the right stories, and the right timing — and our team executes. It’s why we’re growing while the traditional agency model is dying.

We sell to VPs of Marketing, CMOs, and CEOs at companies with 50–200+ employees across virtually every industry. Our average engagement is $8–10K/month, with deals ranging from $7K to $35K/month. We are scaling and need closers who want to be part of that run.

THE ROLE

You will run 4–5 qualified sales presentations per day over Zoom with decision-makers who have already expressed interest. The sales cycle is 2 calls: Call 1 is discovery and qualification. Call 2 is a customized proposal and close. The typical cycle is 30–60 days.

Your monthly target is 4–6 closed deals. Our team writes the proposal, and you schedule the close. You are supported by a sales coach, a proposal team, and a leadership team that has built and scaled this motion across multiple brands.

This is an individual contributor closing role. You are not managing a team. You are not building a pipeline. You are not writing decks or attending conferences. You are closing. Every day, all day. If that sounds like the best job in the world to you, keep reading.

WHAT YOU’LL SELL

Interdependence’s core offering is AI-powered PR and earned media placement at $6K–$25K/month. But you won’t be limited to one product line. We operate multiple brands, and top performers sell across the portfolio:

AI-Powered PR & Earned Media Placement — the core product. Technology-driven earned media that outperforms every traditional agency. Performance-guaranteed.

Generative Engine Optimization — next-generation search visibility for the AI era. This is where sophisticated deals live.

Reputation Management — high-end reputation repair for executives, brands, and organizations.

Events — large-scale branded events at $250K–$500K+.

You start with the core PR product and expand as you ramp. The best closers sell across multiple brands and earn commission on all of it.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You’ve closed deals at our price point. Previous average deal of $5K–$20K/month ($60K–$180K ACV). You know what it takes to get a CEO to commit $8-10K/month because you’ve done it.

You close 3–8 deals per month, personally. Your deals, your name on the board. You know your close rate, deal size, and monthly count without looking it up.

You sell to marketing decision-makers. VPs of Marketing, CMOs, or CEOs at 50–200+ person companies. You speak their language.

You’ve sold services, not just software. Agency retainers, consulting, managed services and you understand the consultative motion that comes with recurring spend.

You thrive on volume. 5 deals at $8-10K beats one whale at $40-50K. A packed Zoom calendar excites you.

You qualify hard. You’ve walked away from closeable deals because the client was a bad fit. We pay retention bonuses because we want closers who care about what happens after the signature.

PR knowledge is not required. We teach the domain in 30 days. What we can’t teach is how to close at $8K/month. Bring the skill. We handle the rest.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

Enterprise seller stepping down — if your average deal was $500K+ with 6–12 month cycles, this is a different motion.

You want to manage a team — this is IC. If you’re here as a stepping stone to VP, we’re not the right fit.

Relationship-first seller — if you need 6–9 months before asking for the business, our 2-call close will feel uncomfortable.

Previous deals under $3K/month — the $8K conversation requires executive presence that smaller deals don’t demand.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short note with three things:

  1. Your average deal size (MRR or ACV) and how many you closed per month at your most recent role.
  2. Your target total compensation and how you’d expect base vs. variable to split.
  3. One sentence on why you want to close instead of manage.

No cover letter essays. Just the numbers and the reason. If the numbers are right, we’ll be on a Zoom within 48 hours. We move fast, we don’t ghost, and we’ll tell you directly whether it’s a fit.

jobs.excerpt: The Sr.  Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning serves as a senior product and design technology leader, responsible for defining and executing the long-term vision for Sophia Learning’s product ecosystem.
jobs.description:
The Sr. Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning serves as a senior product and design technology leader, responsible for defining and executing the long-term vision for Sophia Learning’s product ecosystem. This is a role for someone who has both managed products and designed them hands-on, owning product outcomes while personally doing the research and design work. This role drives the strategy that makes Sophia Learning’s platform user-centric, scalable, intelligent, and future-ready - centralizing customer data insights, enabling predictive analytics and experimentation, and applying artificial intelligence to enhance every aspect of the learner and partner experience.

Operating at the intersection of product strategy, user experience design, and AI innovation, this leader partners with senior executives, business partners, data scientists, and engineering leaders to deeply understand user behavior and identify opportunities to move Sophia towards our future vision for learning, including implementing an agentic-enabled design system and driving the strategic application of AI across all Sophia Learning products.

The Sr. Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning operates as a senior leader in the product organization, influencing company-wide priorities, mentoring product peers, and aligning investments to Sophia Learning’s mission of expanding opportunity and access through education. Beyond design execution, this role owns the voice of the customer and carries accountability for experience direction: building a continuous discovery practice that shapes which problems Sophia should solve and securing executive alignment through research evidence and trade-off analysis rather than consensus.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Define and lead the multi-year product strategy for the user experience of Sophia’s online learning platform, ensuring alignment with business goals and executive priorities.
  • Establish and lead a continuous discovery and user research practice (interviews, usability testing, surveys, journey mapping) that keeps Sophia close to its learners and institutional partners, synthesizing research, behavioral data, and market signals into problem statements, personas, and prioritized opportunities.
  • Guide the organization’s AI product vision and roadmap, collaborating with engineering, data science, and product leaders to align AI initiatives across multiple product areas.
  • Lead initiatives to embed machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI models into core Sophia Learning applications, driving automation and intelligent user experiences.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership, translating research insights and technical opportunities into business value and influencing portfolio-level decisions.
  • Establish design best practices and design review mechanisms that ensure consistent quality across the product.
  • Own end-to-end experiences across learner, partner, and administrative workflows, translating user needs and business goals into flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs and partnering with Engineering to ensure design intent reaches production with a high bar for quality and accessibility (e.g., WCAG 2.1 AA).
  • Oversee the design and delivery of a scalable, governed design system that centralizes design assets, establishing design standards, documentation, and accessibility models that make the system AI-ready for agentic development.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data/Analytics, and AI teams to implement UX success metrics and an experimentation framework that supports predictive analytics, personalization, and automation.
  • Mentor and coach other Product Managers, elevating design thinking, product strategy, and customer-centric thinking across the team, including research methods and rapid prototyping with the design system and agentic development tools.
  • Represent Sophia Learning as an industry thought leader, contributing to the company’s credibility in AI for online learning, ethical AI, and data-driven learning experiences.

Job Skills:

  • Deep expertise in product design, user research, AI-driven product strategy, and large-scale platform systems.
  • Proven ability to lead research and translate customer insight into product direction, influencing what gets built, not only how it looks.
  • Equally comfortable defining requirements, prioritizing a backlog, and owning delivery as personally producing wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and prototypes.
  • Strong understanding of modern design and prototyping tools, component-based design systems, accessibility standards, and component lifecycle management, including structuring design systems for agentic development and AI coding tools.
  • Proven ability to bridge technical depth and executive influence, communicating complex technical concepts with clarity and confidence, and turning research findings into decisions.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional AI initiatives that span design, data engineering, product, and data science.
  • Skilled in defining AI governance frameworks and human-centered AI design principles, ensuring responsible, compliant use of data and models.
  • Exceptional leadership and mentoring skills; able to develop product talent and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical and design excellence.
  • Thought leadership in AI design strategy, personalization, and data ethics, with a focus on driving measurable impact for customers.

Work Experience:

  • 6+ years of product design and/or product management experience in SaaS, data platform, or AI-driven product environments, including hands-on design work (user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI) and ownership of product outcomes for complex, cross-functional product areas. EdTech experience preferred.
  • Proven track record leading product design initiatives, including customer-facing AI initiatives, from concept through implementation preferred.
  • Working familiarity with cloud data ecosystems (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and modern data and AI tools, sufficient to partner credibly with data science and engineering teams on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Hands-on depth is welcome but not required. Experience with behavioral analytics and experimentation tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated success collaborating with executive stakeholders and technical leaders to deliver transformative business outcomes required.
  • Experience establishing or scaling a research or continuous discovery practice, including research that changed a roadmap decision preferred.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Cognitive Science, Learning Science, or a related field, (Master’s preferred) or equivalent work experience.

Certificates, licenses and registrations:

Location and travel. This role is remote within the United States and requires approximately 70% travel to customer sites for technical support, training, and deployment.

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

Requirements

The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:We’re evolving our engineering culture so every developer learns to build with modern, agentic workflows, eliminating the repetitive friction so we can solve harder, more interesting problems together. You’ll be the person building the tools, establishing the practices, and coaching our team into the next era of software engineering.

As a Senior Software Engineer reporting to the Engineering Manager, your purpose will be to help make the team AI native: half your time building the agentic workflows, tools and guardrails we ship with, half shipping product with them yourself.

  • Design how a ticket moves from idea to merged code, with agents doing almost all of the implementation
  • Build our coding and review agents, MCP integrations, CI hooks and shared skills library
  • Set up review gates and evaluations so agent output meets the same quality and security bar as human work
  • Own the web side of our product in Vue and represent the team in the Web Developers Guild
  • Coach engineers and share what works with other teams to help everyone adopt and master new AI-driven ways of working

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…

  1. Hands-on experience building AI developer tooling others use: agent skills or rules, MCP servers, custom agents or AI steps in CI
  2. Senior-level experience shipping production software, with solid web development in JavaScript or TypeScript
  3. Daily use of coding agents on production work, and a clear view of where they fail and how to catch it
  4. Sound architecture judgement and the ability to change how other engineers work through coaching, curiosity, and practical enablement
  5. At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.

It will also help you to have…

  1. Production experience with Vue
  2. Python backend, iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) experience
  3. A track record of leading a change in engineering practice across more than one team

How to stand out: show us something you built, such as skills or MCP servers you wrote, or an agentic workflow you introduced and what changed.

Benefits

  • We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first.
  • Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
