jobs.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Policy team works to understand and shape the regulatory and political environment in which Stripe operates — advising on product and business strategy, developing Stripe's policy positions, and engaging with policymakers and regulators around the world. The Policy Development & Strategy team sits at the center of this work, connecting Policy to Stripe's product and business teams and ensuring the company can pursue a proactive, coordinated policy agenda.

Millions of businesses use Stripe as a core platform to build and grow their own businesses, and increasingly that means building with AI. As AI becomes central to how businesses are built and run, this raises new questions: how infrastructure for AI should operate, what responsibilities sit at the infrastructure layer, and how to keep that infrastructure open, secure, and trusted.

What you’ll do

We are looking for a public policy professional to define Stripe’s approach to these questions and carry it into the world. In this role, you will develop Stripe’s positions on the public policy issues raised by AI infrastructure and help set the principles behind how Stripe’s AI platforms are governed, including trust, safety, and supportability. You will engage policymakers, regulators, industry groups, civil society, and other partners on these issues, in partnership with Stripe’s Government Relations team.

The right person will be equally comfortable working through a hard policy question with Product and Legal teams, briefing senior leaders, and representing Stripe's position with regulators or industry coalitions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop Stripe's policy strategy for AI infrastructure. Identify existing and emerging public policy issues and develop substantive positions and priorities that advance Stripe’s interests and reflect our values.
  • Shape platform policy principles. Work with the cross-functional teams that own day-to-day enforcement to set the principles and frameworks behind platform governance, acceptable use, model listing, and escalation, while preserving the benefits of neutral and open infrastructure.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment. Bring Product, Legal, Comms, Risk, Operations, and Government Relations to shared positions and priorities, and advance work from open question to decision to external execution.
  • Advise the business on difficult policy choices. Identify emerging risks and opportunities, translate external policy developments into product and business-model implications, and make recommendations on launches, supportability questions, public commitments, and other high-stakes decisions.
  • Develop Stripe's external policy positions. Turn internal policy work into external policy positions on AI infrastructure regulation in the US and globally: US AI policy at the federal and state level, national-security and export-control regimes, the EU AI Act, and emerging rules and standards for AI intermediaries and providers.
  • Engage externally on the substance. Engage policymakers, regulators, national security agencies, industry groups, standards bodies, academics, civil society, and other stakeholders to understand and anticipate policy developments; help build relationships and coalitions; and work with the Government Relations team to proactively shape policy debates.
  • Lead proactive public-policy initiatives and partnerships. Identify opportunities for Stripe to convene stakeholders, support research, develop industry frameworks, or partner with external organizations on difficult AI-governance and trust-and-safety questions.
  • Develop narratives and executive materials. Produce data-driven policy briefs, consultation responses, talking points, presentations, and executive communications that use Stripe’s data to turn technically and legally complex questions into clear positions for internal and external audiences.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in public policy, platform policy, trust and safety, technology policy, government, or a related field.
  • Strong policy judgment and a track record of developing positions on complex, contested issues where the legal or regulatory answer is not obvious.
  • Meaningful familiarity with trust and safety, platform governance, or online-service policy, including how policy choices translate into product and operational decisions.
  • Strong public-policy instincts and experience engaging policymakers, regulators, industry groups, or other external stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with AI policy and governance, and the range to engage credibly on fast-moving technical and regulatory questions.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional work across Product, Legal, Operations, Comms, and business teams.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to produce concise policy analysis and represent a position credibly with senior internal and external audiences.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building: this role will often require creating a position, framework, or external strategy where none exists.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience at a technology or AI company, government agency, think tank, or civil-society organization working on AI, platform governance, trust and safety, or technology policy
  • Familiarity with national-security, export-control, or cybersecurity policy; familiarity with payments or internet infrastructure
  • JD, MPP, or equivalent advanced degree.

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Full-Stack Engineers serve as a frontline engineering owner for complex production and customer-impacting issues while building and improving our cloud-based platform end to end. This role combines hands-on support - triaging incidents, reproducing problems, analyzing telemetry and data, communicating status, and driving issues through resolution - with full-stack delivery across web applications, APIs, services, integrations, and databases.

This is an engineering role with meaningful production support responsibility, not a traditional help-desk position. The engineer is expected to translate incidents and recurring customer pain into durable code fixes, better observability, automation, and platform improvements.

Essential Job Responsibilities and Key Performance Outcomes

1. Production Support and Incident Ownership

  • Own escalated, high-impact production and customer issues from intake through resolution, including triage, severity assessment, reproduction, containment, mitigation, root-cause analysis, and follow-up.

  • Investigate issues across the full application stack using logs, traces, metrics, application code, API behavior, browser and service diagnostics, and database queries.

  • Translate ambiguous customer symptoms into testable hypotheses, clear technical findings, and actionable next steps; provide timely updates to internal stakeholders and, when needed, customers.

  • Use sound judgment when operating in production, following runbooks, least-privilege practices, change controls, and escalation procedures to minimize operational risk.

  • Produce high-quality root-cause analyses that explain what happened, why it happened, the impact, and the prevention plan; contribute to measurable improvements in time-to-mitigation and time-to-resolution.

2. Full-Stack Platform Engineering

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain platform capabilities across modern web interfaces, backend APIs, microservices, integrations, and data-access layers.

  • Build maintainable frontend experiences using JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern framework such as Angular or React, connecting them to secure, well-designed APIs and services.

  • Develop and debug backend services using C# and .NET, applying sound design patterns and engineering practices for performance, scalability, resilience, and maintainability.

  • Create, optimize, and maintain data structures, SQL queries, and data flows that support reliable application behavior and high-performance processing.

  • Integrate external services and APIs to extend platform functionality and interoperability.

3. Reliability and Continuous Improvement

  • Implement safe, durable fixes for production defects, including defensive code, improved error handling, stronger validation, enhanced logging, and automated recovery or monitoring where appropriate.

  • Proactively monitor platform health, identify emerging risks, and improve observability through useful dashboards, alerts, logs, traces, and metrics.

jobs.excerpt: AVP Data Engineering - GE05AEWe’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies.
jobs.description:
AVP Data Engineering - GE05AE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

The AVP Data Engineering – Business Insurance Ontology & Knowledge Graph is an executive-facing leadership role accountable for defining, building, and driving enterprise adoption of the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, and knowledge graph. This leader establishes the governed business meaning, context, and relationships that power trusted analytics, AI, agentic experiences, and decision automation across Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty.

Operating at the intersection of commercial P&C insurance, business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, the role translates complex insurance domain knowledge—submissions, quotes, accounts, policies, coverages, exposures, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance—into production-ready semantic assets consumable by people, data products, LLMs, and agents.


The AVP serves as the senior technical and domain authority for semantic and AI-ready data in Business Insurance, leads and leverage team of ontologists, graph modelers, semantic and AI data engineers, and business data analysts, and partners directly with the heads of Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty to align the ontology roadmap to growth, underwriting profitability, operational efficiency, and innovation outcomes.


Must be eligible to work in the US without company sponsorship.


Primary Job Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as the primary data and semantic advisor to the heads of Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty, translating ontology and knowledge graph capabilities into business outcomes, investment cases, and decisions.
  • Present strategy, roadmap, execution progress, value realized, risks, and decision asks to executive leadership, steering committees, and ELT forums in clear, plain business language.
  • Build executive sponsorship and drive adoption of a shared Business Insurance vocabulary across underwriting, distribution, product, claims, actuarial, finance, and operations.
  • Influence enterprise technology, data, platform, and AI strategy in partnership with Technology, Enterprise Architecture, Data & AI COE, and Applied AI teams.
  • Negotiate priorities, resolve semantic and ownership conflicts across lines of business, and broker alignment on enterprise definitions.
  • Act as an external and internal thought leader on ontology, knowledge graphs, agentic analytics, and AI-native data engineering in insurance.

Ontology Strategy, Build & Adoption

  • Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, context graph, and knowledge graph.
  • Lead the design and execution of an enterprise-scale semantic layer that standardizes business meaning and enables trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases.
  • Define and operationalize ontologies modeling core commercial insurance concepts and relationships: customers, business profiles, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, exposures, risks and locations, claims, producers, and portfolio performance.
  • Establish canonical vocabularies, metric definitions, business rules, and taxonomies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured data sources and across all three markets.
  • Define and enforce standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, versioning, and ontology reuse across delivery teams.
  • Drive adoption by embedding semantic models into data products, analytics, AI pipelines, APIs, and activation layers; measure and report adoption and business value.
  • Move capabilities from strategy to pilot to scaled enterprise production, prioritizing high-value use cases such as submission triage, risk appetite, clearance, pricing and underwriting insights, portfolio management, and cross-sell.

AI & Data Engineering

  • Enable semantic-first AI and agentic analytics, ensuring LLMs and agents consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships.
  • Lead implementation of AI data pipelines integrating structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data (e.g., submissions, loss runs, schedules, broker correspondence) to support AI and agentic solutions.
  • Operationalize ontologies through knowledge graphs, metadata services, data APIs, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and production data platforms in partnership with AI Data Architects and Engineers.
  • Design and oversee scalable real-time and batch data pipelines for efficient ingestion, processing, and delivery.
  • Drive production-scale execution of semantic and graph platforms with strong standards for performance, reliability, security, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure explainability by making AI and analytical outputs traceable to governed semantic definitions, relationships, rules, and source data.
  • Champion AI-augmented productivity across the data lifecycle, including AI-generated pipelines, automated data quality, DataOps, and AI-assisted ontology engineering.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies in agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and data engineering; lead proofs of value and pilots to accelerate speed to market.

Governance, Team & Financial Leadership

  • Align ontologies and graph models with enterprise data governance, stewardship, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and security standards; establish semantic ownership and change control with business data owners.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of ontologists, graph modelers, semantic and AI data engineers, business data analysts, and release train engineers, including onshore and offshore talent.
  • Manage the portfolio budget, vendor partners, and financials; deliver measurable return on investment.
  • Operate within Scaled Agile and portfolio/value stream frameworks, partnering closely with product owners and cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Evangelize agentic data engineering and semantic practices through communities of practice, reference patterns, playbooks, and enablement materials.

Commercial P&C Domain Knowledge (Required)

  • Deep understanding of the commercial P&C value chain: distribution and producer management, submission intake, clearance, risk appetite, underwriting, rating and pricing, quote and bind, policy administration, endorsements, renewals, billing, claims, and reinsurance.
  • Working knowledge of commercial lines and products such as Workers' Compensation, General Liability, Commercial Property, Commercial Auto, Business Owner's Policy, Umbrella/Excess, Management and Professional Liability, and specialty lines.
  • Understanding of how Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty differ in distribution model, underwriting approach, account complexity, and data needs.
  • Familiarity with core insurance concepts and measures: exposures and rating bases (payroll, sales, TIV, vehicles), class codes (NAICS/SIC), insured locations, account rounding, hit/quote/bind ratios, written and earned premium, loss ratio, combined ratio, retention, and rate change.
  • Familiarity with industry data standards and reference models such as ACORD, ISO, and NCCI.

Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Exceptional executive presence with proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts simply and persuasively to C-suite, line-of-business heads, and board-level audiences.
  • Strong executive influence, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; track record of building cross-functional coalitions and driving enterprise-wide adoption without direct authority.
  • Proven ability to frame investment cases, value metrics, and decisions for senior leadership.
  • Ability to lead in a lean, agile, fast-paced environment using Scaled Agile principles.

Semantic, Ontology & Knowledge Graph

  • Deep expertise in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale.
  • Hands-on mastery of RDF, OWL 2, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards; familiarity with labeled property graphs and query languages such as Cypher or GQL.
  • Experience designing and operating enterprise knowledge graphs on platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Spanner Graph.
  • Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLMs, RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, vector stores, and agentic frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of context-aware data engineering, canonical modeling, semantic interoperability, and AI consumption patterns, including embeddings, grounding, reasoning, and explainability.

Data & AI Engineering

  • Mastery of data engineering and architecture, including lakehouses, data integration, data domains, data products, data APIs, real-time streaming, and conversational BI.
  • Experience implementing scalable AI-driven data systems supporting agentic solutions (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3, EC2, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A).
  • Technical expertise in LLMs, prompt engineering, LLM optimization, RAG architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Vertex AI, Postgres, OpenSearch, Pinecone).
  • Hands-on experience with multi-cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake.
  • Strong grounding in data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, privacy, and security.

Education, Experience, Certifications and Licenses

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years in data engineering, data architecture, and large-scale data ecosystems, including 8+ years of hands-on semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph work.
  • 7+ years in senior leadership roles managing complex data and AI portfolios, with direct engagement with executive and line-of-business leadership.
  • 5+ years in commercial Property & Casualty insurance; experience across Small Business, Middle Market, or Specialty strongly preferred.
  • Industry designations such as CPCU, AINS, or AU are a plus.

Compensation

The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:

$182,000 - $273,000

jobs.excerpt: Sobre la oportunidadBuscamos un/a Applied AI Engineer para integrarse al equipo tecnológico de una fintech que desarrolla soluciones para transferencias internacionales y remesas, con operación principalmente entre Estados Unidos, México y Centroamérica.

jobs.description:
Sobre la oportunidad

Buscamos un/a Applied AI Engineer para integrarse al equipo tecnológico de una fintech que desarrolla soluciones para transferencias internacionales y remesas, con operación principalmente entre Estados Unidos, México y Centroamérica.

La posición está enfocada en diseñar, desarrollar y llevar a producción soluciones de inteligencia artificial basadas en Large Language Models (LLMs), sistemas agénticos y recuperación de información (RAG).

Buscamos a alguien que haya trabajado directamente en la construcción de estas soluciones, que pueda tomar decisiones técnicas fundamentadas y que entienda cómo garantizar su calidad, confiabilidad y funcionamiento en entornos reales.

No es una posición centrada exclusivamente en Machine Learning tradicional ni en experimentación con modelos. El enfoque principal es la ingeniería de soluciones de IA aplicadas a problemas de negocio.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones basadas en LLMs utilizadas en procesos reales de negocio.
  • Construir sistemas agénticos capaces de interactuar con herramientas, APIs y servicios externos, incorporando controles sobre sus acciones.
  • Evaluar cuándo conviene utilizar agentes, workflows determinísticos o una combinación de ambos.
  • Diseñar e implementar soluciones RAG, incluyendo estrategias de chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking y gestión del contexto.
  • Implementar mecanismos de evaluación para medir la calidad de las respuestas, la recuperación de información y el comportamiento de los agentes.
  • Identificar y resolver problemas relacionados con alucinaciones, errores de ejecución, latencia, costos y confiabilidad.
  • Definir mecanismos de validación, manejo de errores y monitoreo para soluciones desplegadas en producción.
  • Colaborar con equipos de producto e ingeniería para comprender requerimientos de negocio, evaluar alternativas y convertirlos en soluciones técnicas viables.
  • Participar directamente en decisiones de arquitectura, implementación y mejora continua de las soluciones desarrolladas.

Requirements

Requisitos indispensables

Experiencia en LLMs y sistemas agénticos

  • Experiencia práctica construyendo y operando aplicaciones basadas en LLMs en producción, más allá de prototipos o pruebas de concepto.
  • Participación directa en decisiones de arquitectura e implementación de soluciones con agentes.
  • Experiencia implementando tool calling e integraciones con APIs o servicios externos.
  • Conocimiento práctico del manejo de contexto, estado y memoria en aplicaciones con LLMs.
  • Capacidad para justificar cuándo utilizar un agente y cuándo resolver un problema mediante lógica determinística.

RAG y recuperación de información

  • Experiencia implementando pipelines RAG para aplicaciones reales.
  • Conocimiento de estrategias de chunking, embeddings, búsqueda semántica y recuperación de documentos.
  • Experiencia evaluando y mejorando la relevancia de la información recuperada.
  • Capacidad para identificar problemas de retrieval y reducir respuestas incorrectas o sin sustento.

Evaluación y operación

  • Experiencia implementando evaluaciones de calidad para aplicaciones con LLMs, incluyendo pruebas sobre respuestas y comportamiento de agentes.
  • Conocimiento práctico de mecanismos para detectar y mitigar alucinaciones, errores y respuestas inconsistentes.
  • Experiencia identificando problemas de latencia, consumo de tokens y costos de inferencia.
  • Capacidad para diagnosticar fallas y mejorar la confiabilidad de soluciones en producción.

Ingeniería de software

  • Experiencia sólida desarrollando soluciones con Python.
  • Experiencia integrando APIs, servicios backend y modelos de lenguaje.
  • Buenas prácticas de desarrollo, pruebas, manejo de errores y mantenimiento de aplicaciones.
  • Autonomía para investigar problemas, proponer alternativas y ejecutar soluciones de principio a fin.

Conocimientos deseables

  • Experiencia con frameworks de orquestación de agentes como LangGraph, Pydantic AI o similares.
  • Experiencia implementando integraciones mediante Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Conocimiento de bases de datos vectoriales y herramientas de búsqueda semántica.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de observabilidad y evaluación de aplicaciones LLM.
  • Conocimientos de Machine Learning y Data Science.
  • Experiencia en fintech, servicios financieros, pagos, fraude o procesos regulados.
  • Familiaridad con controles de seguridad y protección de información sensible en aplicaciones de IA.

Lo que buscamos en la persona

  • Ownership técnico: capacidad para explicar qué construyó, qué decisiones tomó y qué resultados obtuvo.
  • Criterio de arquitectura: elegir soluciones por su utilidad y restricciones, no por la popularidad de una tecnología.
  • Orientación a producción: considerar calidad, errores, monitoreo, costos y mantenimiento desde el diseño.
  • Pensamiento crítico: cuestionar y aclarar requerimientos antes de proponer una solución.
  • Comunicación: explicar decisiones técnicas y sus implicaciones a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.
  • Autonomía: resolver problemas con iniciativa y asumir responsabilidad sobre los resultados.

¿Qué tipo de experiencia nos interesa especialmente?

Nos interesa conocer proyectos donde hayas participado directamente en el desarrollo de una solución con LLMs o agentes que haya sido utilizada por usuarios reales.

Durante el proceso profundizaremos en el problema de negocio, la arquitectura implementada, las decisiones que tomaste personalmente, los mecanismos de evaluación y los retos que surgieron durante su operación.

Valoramos más la profundidad y responsabilidad demostrable en proyectos reales que la cantidad de herramientas o frameworks mencionados en el CV.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.

📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.

🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.

🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).

🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).

🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.

📢 Clases de inglés.

🏆 Oportunidades dentro de nuestras diferentes líneas de negocio.

jobs.description:
About Osano

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

The Role

Osano is looking for a Campaign Marketing Specialist to own the execution of integrated marketing campaigns that drive pipeline, generate demand, and build brand awareness.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for an experienced marketer who can take an established campaign strategy and independently bring it to life across multiple channels. You'll work closely with demand generation, content, product marketing, sales, and other cross-functional partners to manage campaigns from planning through launch, ensuring programs are executed effectively, on time, and with measurable results.

We're a lean, collaborative team, so we're looking for someone who can hit the ground running, take ownership, and execute multichannel campaigns with minimal direction. You'll need to be comfortable juggling multiple priorities, making decisions, solving problems, and keeping campaigns moving without constant oversight.

The ideal candidate brings proven experience executing integrated, cross-channel campaigns in a B2B environment, understands how different marketing channels work together, and knows what it takes to turn campaign plans into successful programs. While you won't be responsible for setting the overarching marketing strategy, you'll have significant ownership over how campaigns are executed and optimized.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end execution of integrated marketing campaigns across channels such as email, paid media, organic, content, webinars, and account-based marketing (ABM).
  • Translate campaign strategies and briefs into actionable execution plans, timelines, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
  • Independently manage multiple campaigns simultaneously, proactively identifying priorities, resolving blockers, and keeping programs on track.
  • Build, launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns within marketing automation and CRM platforms.
  • Manage audience segmentation, campaign setup, scheduling, tracking, and deployment across multiple marketing channels.
  • Partner with demand generation, content, product marketing, design, and sales to coordinate campaign assets and ensure consistent messaging across channels.
  • Take ownership of campaign quality assurance, including links, forms, lists, tracking, formatting, creative, and overall customer experience.
  • Maintain and manage the integrated campaign calendar, ensuring alignment across channels, stakeholders, and initiatives.
  • Monitor campaign performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend adjustments to improve engagement, conversions, and pipeline contribution.
  • Analyze campaign data and performance metrics to support reporting, optimization, and future campaign planning.
  • Troubleshoot campaign execution challenges independently and proactively communicate risks, recommendations, and results.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign processes, workflows, and automation to increase efficiency and scalability.
  • Support occasional event and webinar initiatives, including promotion, coordination, lead capture, and post-event follow-up.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of integrated campaign execution and management.
  • Proven experience independently executing multichannel marketing campaigns from planning and setup through launch, monitoring, and optimization.
  • B2B marketing experience required; experience within a B2B software or SaaS organization is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing and how email, paid media, organic, content, webinars, and ABM work together to drive demand and pipeline.
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and managing campaigns using marketing automation and CRM platforms (Hubspot exp is a must)
  • Ability to take an established campaign strategy and drive execution with minimal oversight, demonstrating sound judgment, initiative, and accountability.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Experience monitoring campaign performance, interpreting key marketing metrics, and making data-informed recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience managing campaign QA, audience segmentation, tracking, and deployment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
  • A proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, lean marketing team.
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and execute the work needed to deliver successful campaigns.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within a B2B SaaS or software company.
  • Experience supporting event marketing initiatives, including webinars, conferences, trade shows, or field events.
  • Experience executing account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns.
  • Familiarity with marketing project management and campaign planning tools.
  • Experience optimizing campaign workflows, automation, and operational processes.
  • Basic design sense and experience reviewing campaign creative for accuracy and brand consistency.
  • Familiarity with the data privacy, compliance, or cybersecurity space.

Why Us

  • A well-defined career path that’s not just “climbing the ladder” - learn different competencies, skills, and concepts as you progress and get recognized for it.
  • Supportive leadership and peers - from sales engineering and product marketing to sales development and demand generation - you’re never in this alone.
  • You’ll be stepping into a space that’s on fire – the privacy and regulatory landscape is only growing with a ton of opportunity in front of us.
  • You’ll become a privacy expert, including the opportunity to receive your Certified Information Privacy credential.
  • You’ll be representing a product that makes prospects say, “This is so awesome” when you demo it.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation + ownership interest for an early stake in our success!
  • Unlimited paid time off with a requirement to take at least two weeks off per year.
  • We're continuously a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents + believe that family, however you define it, comes first.
  • Osano sponsors individual premiums for base plans at 100% and dependent premiums at 50% for Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance via Aetna.
  • A fully, permanently remote company so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Receive a MacBook + $600 to craft your home workspace
  • Annual company trip designed to foster connection, creativity, and fun together!
  • Mental health benefits with free memberships to mindfulness + talk therapy services

A Bit More About Osano

Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work.

As we grow, we're looking for individuals who lean into modern technologies and smarter systems to drive efficiency, clarity, and speed; both in our product and in how we operate. If you're excited by the idea of helping build a high-growth, privacy-first company that embraces thoughtful automation, emerging tech, and intentional collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Osano is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Overview

Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high-performance scientific instruments and high-value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular, and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nanoanalysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics and proteomics research and clinical microbiology.

Today, worldwide more than 11,000 employees are working on this permanent challenge at over 90 locations on all continents. Bruker continues to build upon its extensive range of products and solutions, its broad base of installed systems and a strong reputation among its customers. Being one of the world's leading analytical instrumentation companies, Bruker is strongly committed to further fully meeting its customers’ needs as well as continuing to develop state-of-the-art technologies and innovative solutions for today's analytical questions.

The Bruker NANO group is seeking a Staff SW Engineer for Windows Instrumentation and Automation. The Senior Software Engineer will provide programming design and development for Bruker’s world leading nano-scale Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) product lines. You will work with other software developers, engineers, and scientists supporting and advancing the state-of-the art nanoscale systems technology by developing software from application design to hardware control. This position requires initiative, innovation, and responsibility working within a cooperative team environment to support existing and realize new customer products.

Location and Work Model

Santa Barbara, California, or fully remote. Remote employees must be able to collaborate effectively with a Santa Barbara-based team with no more than a three-hour time difference. Remote employees may be asked to travel to Santa Barbara up to two times per year.

Position Summary

Join the team building software for the world's most capable automated atomic force microscopes used in leading semiconductor fabs. Our systems generate rich scientific data at nanometer scales, and our software transforms that data into accurate, actionable measurements while coordinating sophisticated precision hardware.

We are seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to lead the design, implementation, validation, and productization of algorithms for scientific data analysis. The role emphasizes signal and image processing, numerical analysis, and applied machine learning while remaining grounded in production Windows software, modern C++, C#/.NET/WPF, and instrument integration. You will own important technical decisions, guide cross-functional problem solving, and write production code that ships with our instruments.

This is a scientific algorithms, Windows desktop, and instrumentation software position. It is not a web, mobile, data-platform, or cloud application development role. Candidates whose experience is primarily web application development or cloud data engineering will not meet the core requirements.

Agentic software development is part of how our team engineers software, not an occasional productivity aid. We use GitHub Copilot Business with leading AI models throughout algorithm exploration, design, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review. The successful candidate will bring meaningful production experience with AI coding agents and will be expected to use and advance these workflows responsibly.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, validate, optimize, and deploy algorithms that turn AFM, image, sensor, and metrology data into robust measurements and insights.- Develop production algorithm and application software using modern C++/STL, C#, .NET, WPF, and Python where appropriate.- Apply signal processing, image processing, numerical methods, statistical analysis, pattern recognition, and machine learning to challenging real-world measurement problems.- Translate research concepts and prototypes into maintainable, testable, high-performance product software with clear requirements and measurable performance.- Build validation strategies using representative datasets, quantitative metrics, uncertainty analysis, and regression tests; clearly communicate algorithm limits and tradeoffs.- Integrate algorithms into multithreaded Windows applications and instrument workflows spanning data acquisition, hardware control, processing, persistence, visualization, and automation.- Own architecture for new analysis capabilities and guide their integration into a mature product codebase through sound interfaces, layering, refactoring, and incremental delivery.- Lead technical investigations and collaborate with applications scientists, systems, hardware, test, and software engineers throughout the product development cycle.- Remain deeply hands-on while providing technical direction and raising algorithm and software engineering quality across a small cross-functional team.- Use VS Code and AI coding agents as core engineering tools across the software development lifecycle while applying rigorous technical and scientific judgment to all generated work.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing production software, scientific algorithms, or data-analysis systems.- 3+ years of hands-on Windows application development using both C#/.NET/WPF and modern C++/STL.- Strong foundation in at least two of the following: signal processing, image processing, numerical methods, statistical analysis, pattern recognition, computer vision, or machine learning.- Demonstrated ability to implement algorithms in C++, C#, or Python and to move them from exploration into tested, maintainable production software.- Experience defining quantitative validation methods and evaluating algorithm accuracy, robustness, performance, and failure modes using real-world data.- Strong object-oriented design, API design, debugging, data-structure, and performance-optimization skills.- Experience with multithreaded or asynchronous software and computationally intensive data processing.- Demonstrated architecture ownership and technical leadership across algorithm, application, or product boundaries.- Meaningful, regular use of GitHub Copilot or comparable AI coding agents on production software. Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific examples spanning multiple development activities and how they ensure technical correctness and maintainability.- Ability to collaborate clearly with engineers and scientists, communicate complex technical ideas and risks, and lead technical work without direct authority.

Education

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field is strongly preferred.- A BS in a related field combined with significant relevant industry, instrumentation, algorithm-development, or research experience will be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with scientific instrumentation, semiconductor metrology, atomic force microscopy, optical spectroscopy, robotics, machine vision, motion control, nano-positioning, or automated test equipment.- Experience developing algorithms for noisy sensor data, microscopy images, surface measurements, anomaly detection, feature extraction, classification, segmentation, reconstruction, or calibration.- Experience applying machine learning to physical measurements and working with limited, imbalanced, or imperfectly labeled scientific datasets.- Knowledge of control systems, estimation, system identification, experimental design, or measurement uncertainty.- Experience with C++/CLI, managed/native interoperability, MFC, or integrating Python-based research code with production C++ or .NET applications.- Experience using architectural layering across hardware interfaces, acquisition, analysis, persistence, and desktop presentation layers.- Experience with Scrum or another Agile development approach and a record of improving practical engineering processes.- Experience making effective use of both VS Code and Visual Studio in a Windows development environment.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  • When working onsite, ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 30 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.- Ability and willingness to work periodically in a Class 1000 cleanroom using full gowning protocol and laboratory-appropriate attire. These requirements also apply to remote employees during onsite visits.

At Bruker, base salary is part of our total compensation. The estimated base salary range for this full-time position is between $107,100 and $190,000 and provides an opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base salary for the role will depend on a several job-related factors, including, but not limited to education, training, experience, the geographic location of the successful candidate, skills, competencies, job-related knowledge and travel requirements for this position. Full-time employees may also be eligible for a performance-related incentive in addition to a full range of benefits including 401(k) with company match, an employee stock purchase plan, medical and dental plans, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance, employee assistance program and paid time off including vacation, sick time and holidays, and more.

jobs.title: VP, Deputy General Counsel (Real Estate & Development)
jobs.excerpt: At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
jobs.description:
At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

The Opportunity

Montera is seeking a VP, Deputy General Counsel (Real Estate & Development) to lead the legal work for land acquisition, entitlement, and construction across Montera's data center portfolio and to help build the legal department as the company scales. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, this position is one of three planned functional roles, each ultimately responsible for a distinct area of the business (Job Level M7 — VP or SVP).

The role owns acquisition, site control, entitlements, construction and EPC contracts, condominium structures, and ground-lease financeability. It is responsible for ensuring that risk Montera accepts in a customer lease passes through to the related construction, land, and financing documents. The role also supports financing and board matters and helps establish the templates, playbooks, outside-counsel panel, and systems the legal function requires. It requires deep real estate, development, and construction experience together with broad generalist judgment developed in close partnership with a business. It partners with Development, Design & Construction, Delivery, Procurement, Finance, and Commercial, and requires regular travel to sites, jurisdictions, lenders, and counterparties.

What You’ll Do

  • Exercise delegated authority from the Chief Legal Officer across real estate, development, and construction matters, and represent the Legal function directly with the business, counterparties, lenders, and local authorities.
  • Own land acquisition and site control — purchase and option agreements, ground leases, title, survey, easements and access rights, and diligence and option periods structured to preserve time to secure power and entitlements.
  • Direct zoning, annexation, entitlement, and permitting strategy in partnership with land-use counsel — permitting contingencies, conditions of approval, environmental conditions, and water rights.
  • Lead negotiation of design, construction, and EPC contracts — delay liquidated damages, contractor liability caps, performance guarantees, warranties, insurance, collateral assignment, and lender step-in rights.
  • Flow down delivery dates, delay credits, and technical requirements from data center leases into the construction and procurement contracts, so that schedule and liability risk pass through to the responsible counterparties.
  • Support data center lease negotiation and post-signature compliance in partnership with the CLO and the Energy DGC (delivery obligations, force majeure, delay credits, tenant termination rights), and structure condominium, parcelization, and platting arrangements on multi-tenant campuses (shared-infrastructure cost allocation, association governance, and alignment with each tenant's lease).
  • Support project financing and lender diligence — ground-lease financeability, leasehold-mortgagee protections, SNDAs, estoppels, and lender acceptability of condominium structures — and prepare Board materials and resolutions, supporting sponsor governance and consent processes across real estate and construction matters.
  • Build the legal department in partnership with the CLO — templates and playbooks, matter intake, contract lifecycle management, the outside-counsel panel (including land-use and construction firms, run to budget), and the obligations and change-of-control registers; define, recruit, and mentor the roles added as the function scales; provide training to the business; and establish the standards for responsive, commercially practical legal support.

Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • J.D. from an accredited law school; admitted to practice and in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar, and able to register as in-house counsel where required in the state of residence.
  • 15–20 years of relevant legal experience at a law firm, a developer, owner or operator, or in-house. Candidates with 10+ years and exceptional depth will be considered.
  • Deep real estate and development experience, with end-to-end ownership of land acquisitions, ground leases, and entitlement matters as the responsible attorney.
  • Substantial construction and EPC contracting experience on large, capital-intensive projects, including risk allocation, delay remedies, and lender requirements.
  • Working knowledge of project and real estate finance, lender diligence, and leasehold financing protections.
  • Demonstrated negotiation ability across a broad range of agreement types, with a track record of taking on unfamiliar subject matter and reaching a defensible answer quickly.
  • Sound judgment on when to bring in outside counsel and when to decide, with the discipline to run firms to scope and budget.
  • Exceptional drafting, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, and comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-moving, founder-led environment.
    •

Preferred

  • Data center, industrial, or other mission-critical development experience.
  • Condominium, parcelization, or multi-tenant campus structuring experience.
  • Experience with hyperscale leasing from either side of the table.
  • Experience with land-use and entitlement processes in Texas or Arizona.
  • Experience building legal-department infrastructure, including templates, playbooks, and outside-counsel panel management.
  • A mix of law-firm training and in-house operating experience.
    •

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Travel Requirements: this role requires travel approximately 20–30% of the time for meetings, conferences, site visits, customer or partner engagements, and internal team activities. Travel may include domestic and, as needed, international destinations. Periodic visits to Montera's main office or other designated locations may also be required for onboarding, training, planning sessions, or team meetings.

Benefits

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

Compensation:

At Montera, we believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

The reasonable compensation range for this role is $325,000 – $350,000, plus an annual performance bonus.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, which includes holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Parental Leave: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off after 6 months of employment.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Learning & Development Reimbursement: Up to $3,500 reimbursed annually for approved courses, certifications, conferences and professional development opportunities.
  • Extra Support: Remote work stipend to help you stay connected.

At Montera, you’ll have the autonomy to do great work and the benefits to thrive personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Systems (Python)
jobs.excerpt: About NorthbeamNorthbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards.
jobs.description:
About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the Role

Northbeam is fundamentally a data product - the whole company. We don’t sell shoes, ads, games, or database technologies. We sell data: quality integrations with a variety of platforms, fresh and reliable data pulls, correct aggregations, and algorithmic insights on top of that data, all packaged up in a user-facing application.

What this means is that out data systems team is foundational and load-bearing. As a data-tilted software engineer working at Northbeam, you will work with a cross-functional team of product managers, product engineers, and business leaders to translate our customers’ feedback into scalable data pipelines and products.

The work involves creating, maintaining, and improving a labyrinth of integrations and transformations in a complex network of touchpoints to keep everything running smoothly. The system is powered by data that spans numerous ad platforms, a variety of order management systems (such as Shopify and Amazon), as well as our own real-time events that we collect as our customers navigate their online stores.

Curiosity, experience, and a desire to build data pipelines and applications at scale will be the key to success in this role.

Your Impact

This is a startup. The one thing that’s constant is change. To start with, you can expect to:

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance data pipelines to ingest and transform data from a variety of sources, ensuring reliability, observability, and maintainability.
  • Build and maintain APIs that enable flexible, secure, and tenant-aware data integrations with external systems.
  • Work with event-driven and batch processing architectures, ensuring data freshness and consistency at scale.
  • Drive clean API design and integration patterns that support both real-time and batch ingestion while handling diverse authentication mechanisms (OAuth, API keys, etc.).
  • Implement observability, monitoring, and alerting to track data freshness, failures, and performance issues, ensuring transparency and reliability.
  • Optimize data flows and transformations, balancing cost, efficiency, and rapid development cycles in a cloud-native environment.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to create an integration platform that is flexible, extensible, and easy to onboard new sources.

You will work with great people who have done this many times before. You will teach them some new tricks, and maybe learn some old ones.

If this sounds like your kind of chaos, we’d love to hear from you.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or integration engineering, with a focus on ETL, APIs, and data pipeline orchestration.
  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Experience with API-based ETL, handling REST, GraphQL, Webhooks
  • Experience implementing authentication flows
  • Proficiency in SQL and BigQuery
  • Experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., Airflow) to manage and monitor complex data workflows.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) to deploy and scale workloads.
  • Ability to drive rapid development while ensuring maintainability, balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term platform stability.

Bonus Skills & Experience

  • Detailed understanding of authentication mechanisms (OAuth 2.0, API keys, secrets management) and secure multi-tenant architectures.
  • Experience working with ERP systems, CRMs, CDPs, or complex other enterprise data tools and their APIs.
  • Exposure to event-driven architectures and real-time data processing tools
  • Knowledge of data governance, compliance (GDPR, SOC2), and security best practices for handling sensitive data.
  • Experience working in a multi-tenant SaaS or large-scale data-intensive environment.
Base Salary Range
$170,000—$200,000 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for an ML Systems Engineer to build and maintain the infrastructure that allows machine learning models and AI-powered services to operate reliably across Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health brings together patient experiences, merchant operations, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools. As machine learning becomes more integrated into these applications, we need dependable systems for preparing data, deploying models, managing inference, monitoring performance, and maintaining production reliability.

You'll help develop the engineering infrastructure that connects machine learning development with real-world application use. Your work will support the complete operational lifecycle of machine learning systems, from model packaging and deployment to monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance.

This is a hands-on engineering role that combines backend software development, cloud infrastructure, machine learning operations, and distributed systems. You'll work with APIs, data pipelines, deployment environments, model-serving services, and monitoring tools to make machine learning capabilities accessible to other engineering teams.

Your work may include building model-serving infrastructure, implementing automated deployment pipelines, developing batch and real-time inference services, managing model artifacts, and creating systems that monitor performance and operational health.

You'll collaborate with machine learning engineers, applied scientists, backend engineers, and infrastructure specialists to understand model requirements and translate them into reliable production systems. You'll help establish reusable deployment patterns, improve developer workflows, and reduce the complexity of operating machine learning applications.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll also need to consider data privacy, access controls, tenant isolation, and appropriate handling of sensitive information throughout the machine learning lifecycle.

This position emphasizes strong software engineering fundamentals and practical infrastructure ownership. You'll contribute to technical design, build production services, investigate operational problems, and continuously improve system performance.

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of machine learning and infrastructure, understands the challenges of running models in production, and wants to build systems that other engineers can depend on.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain production infrastructure for machine learning systems across Bask Health.
  • Develop model-serving services that expose machine learning predictions through reliable APIs.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure for batch and real-time model inference.
  • Implement automated workflows for model packaging, deployment, and version management.
  • Develop reusable deployment patterns for machine learning applications.
  • Build systems for managing model artifacts, configurations, and runtime dependencies.
  • Implement continuous integration and deployment pipelines for ML services.
  • Develop infrastructure that supports reproducible model releases and controlled rollbacks.
  • Build monitoring systems for model-serving latency, throughput, errors, and availability.
  • Implement logging and tracing for production machine learning services.
  • Support model performance monitoring and detection of unexpected changes in input data.
  • Develop data processing and feature preparation pipelines that support production inference.
  • Integrate machine learning services with existing backend applications and databases.
  • Build asynchronous processing systems for large or long-running inference tasks.
  • Optimize inference performance, resource usage, and infrastructure costs.
  • Develop automated tests for model-serving APIs and infrastructure components.
  • Implement safeguards for service failures, timeouts, retries, and fallback behavior.
  • Work with machine learning engineers to define deployment and operational requirements.
  • Collaborate with applied scientists to transition validated models into production.
  • Develop tools that simplify model deployment and troubleshooting for engineering teams.
  • Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, and access controls for ML services.
  • Ensure production systems respect tenant boundaries and approved data-handling requirements.
  • Investigate infrastructure incidents and resolve production reliability issues.
  • Improve system scalability and fault tolerance as application demand grows.
  • Support experiment environments and testing infrastructure for machine learning development.
  • Document infrastructure architecture, deployment procedures, and operational standards.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and architecture discussions.
  • Own assigned ML infrastructure projects from design through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Nice to Have
