jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

An AI Solution Engineering leader who is ready to lead teams that build reliable, production AI products for customer service. You lead engineering teams, including Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who integrate foundation models, RAG pipelines, agents, data services, and application components into products that customers and service employees use every day.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop practitioners into leaders and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service. Your teams will be embed directly with clients to discover, prototype, and deploy AI solutions into production. You set the standard for how your team work, and scale their impact across engagements.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee AI product engineering programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight across leads and their teams while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as resolution, average handle time, customer satisfaction, and adoption.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Direct how your FDEs embed with clients: running discovery to find the highest-value use cases, prototyping fast to prove value, and owning solutions end to end through production rollout, adoption, runbooks, and a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
  • Lead delivery of production AI applications for service: conversational AI agents across voice and digital channels, human agent-assist copilots, knowledge assistants, interaction summarization and quality automation, and analytics agents that let leaders ask questions of their service data in plain language.
  • Hold your FDEs to production-grade standards: tested Python and TypeScript services, eval suites that catch regressions, observability, and clear cost, latency, and safety tradeoffs, so solutions run reliably after handoff.
  • Set engineering standards for how AI components work together, including RAG design, prompt and context engineering, evals and guardrails, model selection, and when fine-tuning is worth the investment.
  • Originate use cases with clients, prioritizing by measurable value and shaping engagements that ladder to a real product, not a proof of concept.
  • Turn conversation designs, customer experience journeys, and prototypes into production code, co-creating from early concepts and feeding back what data and model behavior reveal so the experience keeps improving.
  • Ensure what ships is secure, monitored, and responsible, partnering with specialists in MLOps, AI security, and responsible AI.

Business Development:

  • Grow a pipeline of work by building strong client relationships, proactively connecting Song's service AI capabilities to client priorities, and crafting proposals that win work our teams are proud to ship.
  • Use FDE-led discovery and rapid prototypes to prove value before full engagement, and partner with sales teams on business cases, ROI models, executive narratives, and RFP responses.
  • Develop thought leadership on the service AI products that matter most to clients, such as agentic customer service and analytics agents, advancing Song Service as a credible and compelling voice in the industry.
  • Strengthen relationships with AI and service platform partners to sharpen joint solutions and go-to-market.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow FDEs and the engineers around them, helping them navigate challenges and grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Scale the FDE capability within Service AI & Data: define how FDEs engage with clients, and build career paths from FDE to workstream and program leadership.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across use case discovery & prioritization, story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.
  • Codify delivery patterns, eval suites, and reusable components, and feed field learnings back into our offerings to make delivery repeatable.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in technology, data, or AI roles across consulting or industry, with a track record across varied industries and business problems.
  • 5+ years leading technology, data, or AI programs end-to-end, with experience managing complexity, ambiguity, shifting scope, and senior stakeholders. Experience should include:
    • A hands-on background moving AI products into production (RAG, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails).
    • Working fluency with the FDE technical stack, including LLM APIs across frontier and open-weight models (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral), agentic frameworks and MCP, RAG pipelines and vector databases, Python and TypeScript, REST and GraphQL integration, and model and prompt evals, so you can inspire and challenge your teams' technical designs.
  • Delivery experience on at least one enterprise agent platform in production, such as Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure, Google Gemini, or Databricks Mosaic.
  • 5+ years directly managing and developing technical practitioners, with demonstrated ability to grow them into workstream and program leaders.
  • 5+ years of experience leading transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience operations, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how AI moves them.

See your work in a new light.

At LUX Infusion, we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by lux—meaning light - we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.

As a clinician-led, U.S.-based organization, we put people first - helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Referral Services who wants their work to mean something—someone who brings care, accountability, and purpose to how referrals become treatments and how systems become services.

Why This Role Matters

The Associate Director of Referral Services plays a critical role in delivering a patient‑first infusion experience by ensuring referrals move efficiently, accurately, and compassionately from intake to care delivery.

The Associate Director of Referral Services will be responsible for the oversight and management of the front end referral process including, Benefit Verification and PA processes for LUX Infusion Neurology, Immunology, Transplant and Specialty Infusion areas. The Associate Director will understand the specific BV and PA roles and support the day-to-day department activities. This position will work closely and collaboratively with other internal department leads, including Intake Coordination CRT, Nursing Services and Pharmacy Services.

In this role, you’ll contribute to work that:

  • Ensures patients experience timely, coordinated access to infusion therapy
  • Supports clinicians and referral partners through clarity, responsiveness, and reliability
  • Strengthens the foundation of care delivery through strong reimbursement, documentation, and intake workflows

Every referral represents a real person navigating a complex healthcare moment—and your leadership helps that journey begin with confidence and trust.

What You’ll Do

  • Set standard metrics and goals for Referral Management team members for pull through of referrals, documentation management, BV, PA processing

  • Establish training protocols for new employees and evaluate performance against metrics/goals; and determine corrective action or training plans to support performance improvement when needed
  • Establishes communication processes and procedures for Referral Management team members to engage necessary internal and external stakeholders to gather missing or inaccurate information

  • Daily & Weekly (or as needed) – Review department alignment with stated SLAs for the department, identify trends among reporting periods, and take action with team or peers as needed
  • Support staffing and resource adjustments as found necessary to support referral volumes and overall growth goals for the organization
  • Maintains necessary and thoughtful communications to the intake and Patient Services specialist team members delivering information supplied by leadership with impact to people, process, and technology updates within a given location.
  • Serves as a point of escalation for issue management and resolution support related to services provided by Intake & Referral Specialists

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Triages work and assigns duties to staff

  • Overnight travel on occasion by car and plane
  • Careful attention to detail
  • Performs related duties as requested

What You’ll Bring

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5-7 years of experience in managing patient referral and prescription activities in infusion or specialty therapies
  • 3-5 years of general infusion or specialty therapy reimbursement or payer experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in supporting prescriber, healthcare setting, patient, and field facing communications related to referral or prescription services in infusion or specialty therapies
  • 1-3 years of successful management/leadership of department employees
  • Strong customer service skills internal and external customers, including meeting quality standards for services and evaluation of customer satisfaction.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent, Bachelors' Degree preferred
  • Advanced computer and internet skills (e.g. Microsoft Office)
  • Must know and understand financial information and reporting aspects
  • Willing to travel up to 5% of the time for business purposes (when necessary to attend meetings, conferences, seminars, etc.)

QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED:

  • 1-3 years people management experience overseeing team members responsible for pharmacy intake or referral process activities
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of infusion therapies, the steps needed to qualify a patient for such therapy, and the ability to lead team members through these steps
  • General knowledge and understanding of payer contracts for infused therapies and operational requirements to support contracts for pharmacy or prescription services

KNOWLEDEGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong knowledge of specialty prescription and referral documentation workflow, provider communication needs, and necessary steps to vet a referral to outcome
  • Strong working knowledge of medical / pharmacy terminology
  • General knowledge of intake requirements for all insurance payors including Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare D, Commercial and pharmacy plans
  • Ability to actively communicate, inspire and motivate all levels of staff
  • Ability to think and act strategically and proactively
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and prepare reports and correspondence related to the work
  • Ability to organize and coordinate the work of others
  • Ability to set priorities and assign work to other professionals
  • Ability to identify areas for opportunity and process improvement and enact change
  • Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills
  • Excellent group presentation skills

Communication & Technical Skills

  • Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions and intake/referral issues
  • Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively
  • Computer skills

You don’t need to check every box—we care just as much about how you lead, support, and show up as what’s on your resume.

Why LUX Infusion

At LUX Infusion, we believe infusion care deserves more light—more warmth, more clarity, and more connection.

Here, you’ll find:

  • Purpose‑driven leadership work with real patient impact
  • A patient‑first, clinician‑led culture
  • Collaborative, supportive teammates who value high standards and empathy
  • The opportunity to grow with an organization building something meaningful

Come help us elevate infusion care—and see what’s possible when leadership, care, and purpose come together.

Pay Range/Rate

jobs.excerpt: Flexcompute is the physics company.  We tackle multi-scale, multi-physics problems with simulators that combine numerical methods and AI models.
jobs.description:
Flexcompute is the physics company. We tackle multi-scale, multi-physics problems with simulators that combine numerical methods and AI models. We are GPU-native and support agentic workflows for the fastest path to physics insight. We scale first-principles physics into foundational physics models to eliminate the latency to physical insights. Our platforms help teams design and optimize products from electric aircraft and wind turbines to photonic chips and quantum hardware. Built by engineers from Stanford University and MIT and backed by top VC firms, we are growing fast across aerospace, automotive, semiconductors, photonics, and beyond.

About the Role

We're looking for an Agentic Photonic Design Engineer to join the PhotonForge team. This is a software development role at the intersection of photonic design automation, EDA integration, and agentic AI. You'll extend our end-to-end platform for photonic integrated circuit (PIC) design, working in Python and navigating a C++ codebase to ship production integrations and AI-native workflows.

PhotonForge unifies component simulation, circuit simulation, compact modeling, layout generation, PDK integration, and foundry handoff into a single platform backed by Flexcompute's GPU-accelerated Tidy3D multi-physics solvers. You'll build EDA tool integrations, develop physics-driven application workflows, and design agentic tools that make photonic design faster and more accessible.

This is a remote role based in Taiwan.

What You’ll Do

Build Interfaces & Connectors to EDA Tools

• Develop and maintain integrations between PhotonForge and industry-standard EDA tools for layout, DRC, LVS, and schematic-driven design, such as Cadence Virtuoso (through our Cadence connector), KLayout and Siemens Calibre.

• Enable seamless round-trip workflows between EDA environments, PhotonForge, and Tidy3D simulation.

• Build Python-based APIs and automation scripts that connect PhotonForge to existing toolchains (GDSII and OASIS layouts, Touchstone S-parameters, SPICE netlists, and Verilog-A models for SPICE simulators); read, debug, and extend C++ components where integrations touch the core platform.

Design Agentic & AI-Native Workflows

• Build agentic tools and automation that help engineers set up layout, simulation, and verification with less manual friction.

• Prototype and ship AI-powered features inside PhotonForge and adjacent developer experiences (e.g., scripted flows, assistants, workflow agents).

Drive Physics & Application Workflows

• Work with end users on real-world design challenges in quantum photonics, RF photonics, co-packaged optics, or silicon photonics.

• Develop application workflows and reference designs across component simulation, circuit simulation, compact modeling, and layout.

• Leverage Flexcompute’s GPU-accelerated Tidy3D multi-physics solvers (tackling optical, RF, charge, and thermal physics) to build fabrication-aware simulation pipelines.

Requirements

• Software developer first. You write production-quality Python and are comfortable reading, debugging, and contributing to C++ codebases (our platform includes performance-critical native components).

• Hands-on EDA and PIC flow experience. You've worked with industry-standard EDA platforms (such as Cadence Virtuoso, Siemens Calibre or KLayout) and photonic design tools and understand real tapeout-oriented workflows: GDSII and OASIS, DRC, LVS, PDKs, schematic-driven design, and compact models (such as Verilog-A).

• Strong physics or engineering foundation. Degree (MS or PhD preferred) in electrical engineering, applied physics, photonics, or a related field. Working knowledge of Maxwell's equations, waveguide theory, and semiconductor device physics.

• AI-native builder. You actively use AI tools in your own work and are motivated to build agentic automation into engineering products, not just consume off-the-shelf chat interfaces.

• A builder at heart. You'd rather ship a working prototype than write a specification, and you thrive with ownership over problems that span EDA integration, software, and product.

Nice to Have

• Experience training or fine-tuning ML/AI models (reinforcement learning, surrogate modeling, physics-inspired neural networks, vision-language models, and similar approaches)

• Domain expertise in quantum photonics, RF/microwave photonics, co-packaged optics, or optical interconnects for AI datacenters

• Experience building connectors or plugins for EDA platforms

• Background in compact model generation, S-parameter extraction, or circuit-level photonic simulation

• Experience with agentic AI frameworks, LLM-based automation tools, or AI product development
• Contributions to open-source photonics or EDA tooling

What We Offer
• A front-row seat at the intersection of AI and photonics, two of the fastest-moving fields in tech
• The chance to shape how an entire generation of engineers learns to work with AI-driven

simulation

• A collaborative, technically deep team that values curiosity and initiative

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Full remote flexibility.
  • Friendly, thoughtful, and intelligent coworkers.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planner
jobs.excerpt: The Demand Planner at Zwiesel Fortessa America is a key role responsible for the precise and proactive execution of global supply planning activities, within the company’s open-to-buy financial parameters.
jobs.description:
The Demand Planner at Zwiesel Fortessa America is a key role responsible for the precise and proactive execution of global supply planning activities, within the company’s open-to-buy financial parameters. Serving as a primary operational liaison with overseas manufacturers, this role embodies Zwiesel Fortessa’s professionalism, reliability, and collaborative spirit. The Planner interacts cross-functionally and internationally to ensure accurate fulfillment of supply objectives while upholding exceptional standards of detail, communication, and data integrity. The individual will work closely with Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to understand future volume requirements and production constraints, leveraging these analyses to effectively release replenishment orders. This position supports Zwiesel Fortessa America’s mission to deliver industry-leading service and supply performance for customers worldwide. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Own and Execute Supply & Inventory Planning 

  • Manage global production schedules, order cycles, inventory levels, and supplier lead times with critical attention to detail—always within ZFA  open-to-buy financial guidelines. 

  • Maintain accurate, detail-oriented supply plans aligned with demand forecasts, product launches, and leadership objectives. 

  • Closely monitor supply metrics (order fill rate, lead times, supplier performance) and take proactive action when targets are at risk to ensure financial and operational success. 

  • Partner across Product, Sales, Finance and Operations team to analyze future volume requirements and production constraints; leverage these insights to time and release replenishment orders for inventory optimization and uninterrupted supply. 

  • Communicate and collaborate to resolve conflicts between demand projections and supply capabilities, aligning efforts with company goals. 

  • Own identification of supply chain risks, including delays, capacity issues, or supplier performance shortfalls, and escalate promptly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with actionable solution-based recommendations. 

Manage Supplier Relationships and Cross-Functional Communication 

  • Serve as a Zwiesel Fortessa’s primary point of contact for overseas manufacturers, building and sustaining productive partnerships that meet quality, delivery, and service standards. 

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of Zwiesel Fortessa’s product and vendor specifications, keeping up to date on the goods and services to be purchased to ensure orders are accurate and requirements are met. 

  • Demonstrate adaptable communication skills to navigate diverse cultural and business environments, engaging with Product, Vendor Compliance, Finance, and Operations teams and global time zones. 

  • Conduct regular supplier reviews, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions alongside internal and external partners. 

Drive Data Integrity, Problem Solving, and Continuous Improvement 

  • Rigorously analyze supply chain and forecast data to identify risks, bottlenecks, and process gaps; develop actionable solutions to enhance reliability, cost-effectiveness, and support financial planning. 

  • Ensure precise and timely documentation of all supply planning activities, transactions, and vendor communications, maintaining the highest standards of systems’ data integrity and regulatory compliance. 

  • Prepare and present KPIs and insights for leadership to support financially responsible, data-driven decisions. 

  • Lead and implement process enhancements using industry’s best practices and technology to drive efficiency, agility, cost control, and continuous improvement across the supply planning function. 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree required; preferred in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Logistics, or related field. 

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in supply planning, inventory management, or operational analysis, ideally in consumer goods or manufacturing environments. 

  • Demonstrated success executing purchase orders, managing vendor relationships, and optimizing inventory positions in a global supply setting. 

  • Strong organizational and supply planning skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. 

  • Clear, concise communicator—capable of effective written and verbal collaboration across departments, cultures, and time zones. 

  • Demonstrates cultural awareness and collaborates effectively in a diverse, global workforce. 

Technical & Tool Proficiency 

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; advanced expertise in Excel and experience with data analysis tools. 

  • Skilled with ERP and supply chain management systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite); experience with business intelligence (BI) or reporting systems preferred. 

  • Comfortable navigating demand planning, inventory management, or supply planning software. 

  • Familiarity with collaborative tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Teams, Asana) for cross-functional project tracking and updates. 

Other Requirements 

  • Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to meet with suppliers or attend business meetings. 

  • Ability to work beyond standard hours during critical purchasing or planning cycles; reasonable accommodations apply. 

  • Ability to lift and handle product or packaging samples (up to 40lbs) as needed for supply planning reviews and quality checks, with or without reasonable accommodation. 

Key Competencies & Behaviors 

  • Proactive, detail-oriented problem solver with strong follow-through and analytical rigor. 

  • Collaborative team player able to communicate and adapt style across levels, functions, cultures, and backgrounds. 

  • Commercially minded; understands the connection between purchasing, inventory, cash flow, and operational results, and balances cost, service, and profit goals. 

  • Embraces and champions organizational change to improve supply chain agility and business outcomes. 

  • Adaptable, self-motivated, and focused in a dynamic, globally connected environment. 

  • Consistently demonstrates professionalism, reliability, and data integrity in every interaction. 

The anticipated salary range for this position is $60,000-75,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, as well as the candidate's experience, education, skills, and current market conditions. In addition to competitive base pay, eligible employees may receive quarterly bonus opportunities based on individual and company performance.

Zwiesel Fortessa Americas LLC also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, life, and disability insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, company-paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO).

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Zwiesel Fortessa Americas LLC previously known as Fortessa Tableware Solutions, LLC, a leading global tableware company part of the Zwiesel Fortessa Group, has been an integrated designer, developer, and marketer of high-quality tableware for more than 30 years. We design and source the dinnerware, flatware, glassware and serveware selected by the top foodservice professionals worldwide and preferred for home entertaining.

Our products are found in over 80% of Forbes four- and five-star hotels in North America; it’s clear that we do business with those who expect (and deliver) the best!

We are recognized for innovative design, industry leading manufacturing standards, and an uncompromising commitment to customer service. We are passionate about our values, our people, and our products. We value work/life balance, creativity, collaboration, and making a difference in the community.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer success means understanding the businesses behind our customer accounts. We value people who take initiative, build strong relationships, understand how online businesses operate, and help customers get meaningful value from our software as their needs evolve.

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager, Growth Accounts to manage relationships with growing businesses using Bask Health's telehealth platform.

This is a hands-on post-sale customer success role focused on helping merchants adopt the platform, achieve their business goals, remain engaged, and identify appropriate opportunities for continued growth.

You'll manage a portfolio of customer accounts and take responsibility for their ongoing success after the initial sale.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll work closely with merchants who are developing their operations, increasing their platform usage, and navigating the challenges of growing an online business.

You'll bring a practical understanding of e-commerce, merchant-facing software, and the challenges businesses face when launching and scaling direct-to-consumer operations.

You'll build relationships with founders, business owners, and other customer stakeholders.

You'll take time to understand each customer's business model, goals, priorities, and current use of the platform.

You'll help customers identify practical ways to use Bask Health's supported capabilities effectively.

You'll guide customers through onboarding and help them understand the steps involved in getting started.

You'll work with internal teams to address onboarding challenges and help customers make progress toward activation.

You'll maintain ongoing communication with customers after onboarding is complete.

You'll help customers understand relevant platform features and workflows.

You'll provide guidance on supported merchant-facing capabilities and direct customers to specialized teams when necessary.

You'll work with customers at different stages of growth, from recently launched businesses to merchants with more established operations.

You'll help customers identify obstacles that may be limiting their adoption of the platform.

You'll develop appropriate follow-up plans to address adoption challenges.

You'll monitor customer engagement and recognize signs of declining platform usage.

You'll proactively reach out to customers when additional guidance or attention may be helpful.

You'll maintain clear account plans that document customer goals, progress, risks, and next steps.

You'll take ownership of assigned customer relationships and follow through on commitments.

You'll help customers understand how different supported platform capabilities relate to their business operations.

Bask Health's platform includes merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop a strong understanding of the merchant-facing aspects of these workflows.

You'll help customers navigate platform configuration and usage questions within the responsibilities of the customer success team.

You'll recognize when a technical issue requires assistance from customer success engineering or technical support.

You'll coordinate with the appropriate team to investigate customer-impacting platform problems.

You'll provide clear information about reported issues and the customer's business impact.

You'll follow through on escalations and help ensure customers understand the next steps.

You'll identify customers who may benefit from expanding their use of existing platform capabilities.

You'll recognize appropriate opportunities for additional supported services, features, or account growth.

You'll help maintain a positive customer relationship during difficult or complex situations.

You'll participate in customer business reviews and account planning conversations.

You'll discuss customer goals, adoption progress, operational challenges, and appropriate next steps.

You'll maintain accurate records of customer interactions, account status, and follow-up commitments.

You'll use approved customer success and CRM tools to organize your portfolio.

You'll track onboarding progress, customer engagement, account risks, and relevant growth opportunities.

You'll help monitor customer success metrics such as activation, adoption, retention, and account health.

You'll contribute to reporting on the performance and needs of assigned growth accounts.

You'll manage multiple customer relationships while maintaining consistent communication and follow-through.

You'll prioritize work based on customer needs, account risks, and established team expectations.

You'll help create repeatable processes for supporting growing merchant accounts.

You'll contribute to customer success playbooks, onboarding resources, and internal documentation.

You'll share practical insights that help the team improve how it supports entrepreneurs and growing businesses.

You'll coordinate with customer support teams when issues require additional investigation or specialized assistance.

You'll work with customer success leadership to identify opportunities for improving retention and customer engagement.

jobs.description:
Associate Director, AP Music Theory, Curriculum and Assessment

College Board – AP&I

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near College Board offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All College Board employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams composed of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The World Languages and Arts department, which includes Spanish Language, Italian Language, French Language, German Language, Chinese Language, Japanese Language, Latin, Music Theory, Spanish Literature, and Art and Design, is currently composed of approximately 27 people supporting 12 courses in the AP portfolio.

About the Opportunity

As the Associate Director, AP Music Theory, you are responsible for supporting the creation, sourcing, and review of musical scores, audio excerpts, and test questions for use on the AP Music Theory Exam and formative assessments. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with the AP Music Theory Course Experts who lead all operational assessment development activities. The Associate Director may also provide assessment development support in other subject areas. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment development and review. This includes judiciously using AI-assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You may also train subject matter experts on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Music Theory.

In this role, you will:

Assessment Development and Scoring (80-90%) 

  • Set musical scores in Sibelius to specifications for use in AP Music Theory Exam materials. Add annotations in Adobe Illustrator and export SVGs for delivery to internal graphics team
  • Edit audio to specifications using Adobe Audition and convert audio files using Adobe Media Encoder. Place audio files in digital test questions using item authoring and banking system
  • Proof musical scores and audio
  • Review and edit alt text for musical scores
  • Source audio and musical score stimuli material for multiple-choice questions
  • Compose original stimuli for multiple-choice or free-response questions
  • Assist in submitting requests to use third-party stimuli to internal permissions team and in tracking permissions status for stimuli
  • Support AP Music Theory Course Experts in the review process (internal and/or external) for all stimulus materials, and adapt future stimulus identification and selection process based on internal and external acceptance criteria (e.g., permissions, Development Committee review, etc.)
  • Support AP Music Theory Course Experts in reviewing assessment content (formative, summative, scoring materials), recommending revisions based on established item review criteria
  • Leverage generative AI to improve quality and efficiency of assessment processes and outputs.
  • As needed, collaborate with AP Music Theory Course Experts to facilitate multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during workweek, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Test Development Committee
  • In collaboration with AP Music Theory Course Experts, support the successful scoring of student responses for AP Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce post-Reading publications materials for teacher and student use

Assessment Quality and Process (10-20%)

  • Contribute to developing best practices in assessment and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
  • Support assessment workstreams within the World Languages and Arts department
  • Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development
  • Monitor and improve stimulus quality, reliability, and fairness

About You

You have:

  • A master's degree in music theory or a directly related discipline and knowledge of current trends in the discipline
  • Expertise in music theory with experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment preferred
  • Experience developing music theory and aural skills assessments in the form of teaching, assessment writing, and/or digital publications editing 
  • Facility with music software, especially music notation software and audio editing software
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $60,000 - $100,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:


Job Description

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer leads the design, development, and deployment of complex features in the web user experience for the Evolent Platform. This role builds high-performance React and Next.js (TypeScript) features and works closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.

This individual drives the technical direction of features, contributes to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning, and mentors junior engineers to foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Development

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of complex front-end features in React and Next.js, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Build Server and Client Components that follow the team’s rendering and caching standards, including read-your-writes behavior for decision forms.
  • Implement backend-for-frontend (BFF) endpoints and integrate with .NET (C#) and Python (FastAPI) services, and Entra ID / OpenID Connect authentication.
  • Build data-heavy screens, including large grids, PDF and document viewers, rich-text editors, and workflow wizards, using component libraries such as KendoReact or MUI.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Drive the technical direction of features, contributing to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning.

Agentic User Experience

  • Build streaming user interfaces (SSE) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative UI using the Vercel AI SDK, assistant-ui, and CopilotKit over the AG-UI protocol.
  • Implement human-in-the-loop flows that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations, including Pydantic AI tool-approval interrupts.
  • Implement robust handling for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including retries, timeouts, resumable streams, and clear status messaging.
  • Contribute to the AG-UI event contract and shared-state design with the agent team.

Engineering Excellence

  • Conduct thorough coding reviews, provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to best coding practices.
  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Build accessible components that meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 and resolve accessibility defects.
  • Write component and end-to-end tests using Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Identify and implement improvements to CI/CD pipelines, supply-chain controls, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working to ensure high availability and reliability of the user experience.

AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
  • Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns to benefit the team.

Governance and Compliance

  • Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Handle patient data safely under HIPAA, keeping PHI out of browser storage, client logs, and telemetry.
  • Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
  • Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with Next.js, including Server and Client Components, server-side rendering, and streaming.
  • Experience building streaming or real-time user interfaces using Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.
  • Experience building data-heavy enterprise screens using component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI.
  • Experience integrating front ends with REST APIs and backend services, including the backend-for-frontend pattern.
  • Experience implementing authentication with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect.
  • Strong knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508, with experience building accessible applications.
  • Experience with Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and Git-based workflows, including pull requests.
  • Strong, daily use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team of technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, present to stakeholders, and write detailed documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with agentic UI frameworks and protocols such as AG-UI, CopilotKit, assistant-ui, or the Vercel AI SDK.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop experiences for AI agents, including approval and override workflows.
  • Familiarity with Python and Pydantic AI.
  • Experience with FHIR R4; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus.
  • Experience consuming events from Azure Service Bus or similar message brokers.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and OpenTelemetry.

• Experience with C# and .NET.

  • Experience integrating AI services, models, or agents into production applications.
  • Healthcare domain experience, including handling PHI under HIPAA.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

Technical Requirements:

We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.

jobs.excerpt: The Sr.  Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning serves as a senior product and design technology leader, responsible for defining and executing the long-term vision for Sophia Learning’s product ecosystem.
jobs.description:
The Sr. Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning serves as a senior product and design technology leader, responsible for defining and executing the long-term vision for Sophia Learning’s product ecosystem. This is a role for someone who has both managed products and designed them hands-on, owning product outcomes while personally doing the research and design work. This role drives the strategy that makes Sophia Learning’s platform user-centric, scalable, intelligent, and future-ready - centralizing customer data insights, enabling predictive analytics and experimentation, and applying artificial intelligence to enhance every aspect of the learner and partner experience.

Operating at the intersection of product strategy, user experience design, and AI innovation, this leader partners with senior executives, business partners, data scientists, and engineering leaders to deeply understand user behavior and identify opportunities to move Sophia towards our future vision for learning, including implementing an agentic-enabled design system and driving the strategic application of AI across all Sophia Learning products.

The Sr. Product Manager, Product Design & User Research, Sophia Learning operates as a senior leader in the product organization, influencing company-wide priorities, mentoring product peers, and aligning investments to Sophia Learning’s mission of expanding opportunity and access through education. Beyond design execution, this role owns the voice of the customer and carries accountability for experience direction: building a continuous discovery practice that shapes which problems Sophia should solve and securing executive alignment through research evidence and trade-off analysis rather than consensus.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Define and lead the multi-year product strategy for the user experience of Sophia’s online learning platform, ensuring alignment with business goals and executive priorities.
  • Establish and lead a continuous discovery and user research practice (interviews, usability testing, surveys, journey mapping) that keeps Sophia close to its learners and institutional partners, synthesizing research, behavioral data, and market signals into problem statements, personas, and prioritized opportunities.
  • Guide the organization’s AI product vision and roadmap, collaborating with engineering, data science, and product leaders to align AI initiatives across multiple product areas.
  • Lead initiatives to embed machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI models into core Sophia Learning applications, driving automation and intelligent user experiences.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership, translating research insights and technical opportunities into business value and influencing portfolio-level decisions.
  • Establish design best practices and design review mechanisms that ensure consistent quality across the product.
  • Own end-to-end experiences across learner, partner, and administrative workflows, translating user needs and business goals into flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs and partnering with Engineering to ensure design intent reaches production with a high bar for quality and accessibility (e.g., WCAG 2.1 AA).
  • Oversee the design and delivery of a scalable, governed design system that centralizes design assets, establishing design standards, documentation, and accessibility models that make the system AI-ready for agentic development.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data/Analytics, and AI teams to implement UX success metrics and an experimentation framework that supports predictive analytics, personalization, and automation.
  • Mentor and coach other Product Managers, elevating design thinking, product strategy, and customer-centric thinking across the team, including research methods and rapid prototyping with the design system and agentic development tools.
  • Represent Sophia Learning as an industry thought leader, contributing to the company’s credibility in AI for online learning, ethical AI, and data-driven learning experiences.

Job Skills:

  • Deep expertise in product design, user research, AI-driven product strategy, and large-scale platform systems.
  • Proven ability to lead research and translate customer insight into product direction, influencing what gets built, not only how it looks.
  • Equally comfortable defining requirements, prioritizing a backlog, and owning delivery as personally producing wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and prototypes.
  • Strong understanding of modern design and prototyping tools, component-based design systems, accessibility standards, and component lifecycle management, including structuring design systems for agentic development and AI coding tools.
  • Proven ability to bridge technical depth and executive influence, communicating complex technical concepts with clarity and confidence, and turning research findings into decisions.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional AI initiatives that span design, data engineering, product, and data science.
  • Skilled in defining AI governance frameworks and human-centered AI design principles, ensuring responsible, compliant use of data and models.
  • Exceptional leadership and mentoring skills; able to develop product talent and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical and design excellence.
  • Thought leadership in AI design strategy, personalization, and data ethics, with a focus on driving measurable impact for customers.

Work Experience:

  • 6+ years of product design and/or product management experience in SaaS, data platform, or AI-driven product environments, including hands-on design work (user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI) and ownership of product outcomes for complex, cross-functional product areas. jobs.title: Manager, Release & Change Engineering
jobs.excerpt: Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.
jobs.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position


The Manager, Release & Change Engineering is a hands-on technical leadership role that unifies Release Management and Change Management into a single engineering function. This role does not exist to process paperwork or maintain legacy processes. It exists to modernize how software and infrastructure releases / changes move safely and quickly from development to production. The successful candidate will be deeply fluent in CI/CD and deployment tooling, lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) with technical authority, and drive the shift from manual, meeting-based approvals to automated, risk-based controls embedded in the delivery pipeline.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Release Engineering

  • Own the end-to-end software release process, including deployment sequencing and release-day decision authority.
  • Serve as Release Manager for complex and high-risk releases, with direct accountability for go/no-go decisions.
  • Lead production readiness reviews, validating deployment plans, rollback procedures, and environment gating before release.
  • Run post-release retrospectives, track actions to closure, and convert findings into pipeline or process controls.

Change Governance and CAB

  • Lead enterprise change management processes and governance activities.
  • Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB) with authority to challenge, table, or reject changes on technical grounds.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of standard, emergency, expedited, and planned changes.
  • Enforce control integrity: separation of duties between implementers and approvers, rollback readiness as a mandatory CAB gate, and accurate change-to-incident attribution, including batched deployments.
  • Govern change freezes, change communications, and compliance with established processes.

Technical Risk and Failure Analysis

  • Assess deployment and change-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Analyze failed changes to distinguish human error, process gaps, and technical failure modes, and drive corrective actions to closure with engineering owners.
  • Partner with Incident Management on RCAs where change is a contributing factor, closing the loop between change risk and incident impact.
  • Own the continuous improvement program for change and release engineering — using change failure data to inform CAB review criteria, Standard Change eligibility decisions, and deployment process improvements — partnering with platform teams to optimize testing, CI, and related tooling.

Transformation & Automation

  • Lead a multi-year roadmap that moves change governance from manual, meeting-based review to risk-based, automated controls.
  • Build change controls into the CI/CD pipeline, including pipeline-generated change records, automated risk scoring, evidence-based approvals, and deployment gates.
  • Partner with Engineering teams – DevOps, etc. to strengthen deployment pipelines, test gating, and safer deployment patterns.
  • Expand Standard Change and tiered pre-approval coverage, using change data to reduce CAB dependency for low-risk, high-frequency changes.

Metrics & Reporting

  • Own release and change KPIs, including DORA-aligned change failure rate, lead time changes, deployment frequency, and failed-deployment recovery time, alongside CAB cycle time and Standard Change utilization.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into operational performance and trends.
  • Present change and release health to engineering and SMO leadership with clear attribution and actionable recommendations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Operate as a technical peer to DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, and development leadership, engaging in architecture discussions, deployment risk assessments, and operational readiness reviews.
  • Hold change authority during emergency changes, high-risk releases, and major incidents, including on-call and after-hours coverage.
  • Collaborate with the NOC Manager and Incident Management Manager on cross-training, coverage, and alignment on change-incident interplay.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team that operates and continuously engineers release and change processes; set priorities, build the team's automation and engineering capability, and manage performance.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Release Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or a related software delivery function, with direct responsibility for production deployments in complex, multi-team environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, or similar), and release orchestration.
  • Experience leading Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, release governance forums, or similar technical risk-management processes involving production changes.
  • Strong understanding of ITSM/ITIL change management principles, change types, risk classification, and operational controls, with experience applying them in a production environment.
  • Ability to assess deployment plans, rollback procedures, technical dependencies, and change risk to ensure successful production outcomes.
  • Working proficiency with scripting and automation tools such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or pipeline-as-code frameworks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including release communications, stakeholder updates, incident coordination, and executive reporting.
  • Self-directed problem solver who uses data to identify opportunities, drive process improvements, and influence outcomes across technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience automating change and release workflows using Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms, including APIs and CI/CD integrations.
  • Proven track record improving release processes through automation, risk-based controls, and reduction of manual operational overhead.
  • Experience supporting releases in cloud-based environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, or hybrid infrastructure).
  • Experience driving large-scale release modernization or transformation initiatives across multiple engineering teams.
  • Ability to influence engineering teams, architects, and senior leaders in complex enterprise environments.

The base salary range for this position is $131,000 - $150,000. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for performance bonus, RSU’s, and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026 Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

We follow a Flexible Vacation Policy, intended for rest, relaxation, and personal time. All time off must be approved by your manager prior to use. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Why join Teladoc Health?

  • Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.

  • Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.

jobs.description:
About REDspace

At REDspace (REDspace.com) we’re a team of passionate innovators building cutting-edge software that powers some of the world’s leading brands. From video delivery and streaming to Adtech, cloud engineering, learning platforms, and custom web development, we help businesses solve complex problems and bring big ideas to life. Our clients include industry giants like Apple, Paramount, IBM, and Sony Pictures Television.

We’re proud of the culture we’ve built; collaborative, curious, and people-focused. We support each other, celebrate wins, and never stop learning. If that sounds like your kind of team, we’d love to hear from you.

Senior Software Developer - Ad Tech

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer to own the architecture of the systems inside our advertising organization and to help set our technical direction, not just execute it. You’ll influence the foundational decisions about how our ad systems are built and how they scale, step into complex implementations to stabilize and simplify them, and turn early client relationships into trusted partnerships through technical work that holds up.

Our teams build the systems behind more than 10 billion ad requests a day for high-traffic media & entertainment and news publishers – this is a demanding, hands-on role. You should have enough range across the advertising domain to architect across it, the depth to be the person other developers come to when performance and reliability are on the line, and the ability to move fluidly between a deep technical conversation with developers and a strategic one with product, bringing everyone along.

Scope of Impact & Autonomy:

  • Your solutions are designed to have a positive impact on the entire advertising organization and the broader developer group, not just a single project.
  • You own architecture decisions that are difficult or expensive to reverse, and you’re trusted to make them.
  • You advise Directors and leadership on technical strategy, privacy and data-handling frameworks, and where we invest.

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Own the architecture. Design, build, and evolve the systems behind our ad stack. High-throughput, low-latency services where performance and reliability are the job, not an afterthought.
  • Set technical direction. Influence the foundational decisions about how our ad systems are built and how they scale. Help set the direction, not just deliver against it.
  • Untangle the hard problems. Lead the resolution of the messiest issues; real-time bidding bottlenecks, data synchronization drops, broken platform integrations and provide the breakthrough on work that has stalled for weeks.
  • Partner with product. Work directly with advertising product owners to shape what gets built. Explain tradeoffs clearly, push back when something doesn’t add up, and propose alternatives – steering product thinking rather than just taking requirements and shipping them.
  • Set the standard. Mentor developers, define what developer excellence looks like in practice, and hold the bar on code review and documentation.
  • Advise leadership. Partner with our leadership team on long-term technical strategy and on the privacy and data-handling frameworks that govern how we work.

Technical Expectations:

  • Deep, hands-on experience across the advertising domain — OpenRTB and Pre-bid, server-side and header bidding, bidstream enrichment (identity, audience, content, and supply-chain signals), ad decisioning, SSP/DSP partners, and video/CTV delivery including server-side ad insertion. You may not have touched every one of these, but you should have enough range to architect across the domain.
  • Strong programming and architecture fundamentals that carry across stacks. Our projects span languages and platforms. We care less about any single technology than about your ability to apply solid fundamentals to whatever a project needs. The domain knowledge is the hard requirement; the language is not.
  • Has built data pipelines and real-time systems at scale, and is fluent in the latency and throughput tradeoffs that come with billions of requests a day, including keeping enrichment and capture off the critical bid path.
  • Can step into an unfamiliar architecture, find the systemic weaknesses, and simplify it.
  • Anticipates major technical and regulatory shifts and factors them into architectural choices up front.

Client Satisfaction & Business Value:

  • The client views you as an extension of their own leadership team, trusting your deep understanding of advertising mechanics, and invites you into the "inner circle" of their strategic planning sessions, not just their backlog.
  • Positions REDspace as a premier thought leader in the Ad Tech industry, where your presence on an account becomes a critical selling point for securing multi-million dollar media and technology contracts.
  • Dramatically increases software business value by mediating between complex programmatic monetization goals and core engineering to balance technical perfection with commercial business constraints.

Benefits

Your well-being:

  • Fully company-funded health, vision, dental, EFAP, and life insurance coverage with access to virtual doctor visits via Maple.
  • Pension plan contribution matching.
  • A flexible Health Spending Account and/or Lifestyle Spending Account.

Your career:

  • A competitive compensation package, commensurate with experience.
  • Weekly sharing sessions for projects and technology.
  • Free access to a wide variety of training material, including access to Udemy Business.
  • Team-oriented education strategy, which includes a professional development allowance.
  • Consistent, frequent check-ins with leadership.

Compensation:

  • The expected salary range for this position is $130,000-$175,000 CAD. (Final placement within the range is at the discretion of the hiring manager, based on relevant experience).

Vacancy Status:

  • This is a posting for an existing vacancy on our Web Development Team.

AI & Automated Screening Disclosure:

  • We use Workable to help manage our hiring process. This includes automated screening questions to confirm basic eligibility and AI-enabled tools to assist our team in reviewing applications. All final hiring decisions are made by a human recruiter.

Our commitment to diversity

At REDspace, we believe that diverse backgrounds, talents, skills, experiences, and perspectives strengthen our business and enrich the communities in which we work and live. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where knowledge sharing and collaboration thrive, empowering our employees to achieve their best.

We are committed to growing and nurturing a workplace that values and respects every individual. Our hiring practices are based solely on merit and skill, ensuring that all employment-related and hiring decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or indigenous origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, or Veteran status.

Join us in our mission to create a dynamic and inclusive community where everyone can contribute and succeed.

Need accommodations?

We’re committed to providing an inclusive hiring process. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know. We’ll work with you to ensure an accessible and respectful experience.

A Little Bit About Our Team:

The Record to Report (RTR) Accounting Team serves as the central operational backbone for financial integrity, revenue recognition, cash management, and financial reporting across Warner Music Group.

Operating within our Shared Services / Global Business Services framework, the Recorded Music RTR team provides specialized accounting expertise, revenue assurance, and critical month-end closing support across WMG’s renowned domestic and international record labels. We work with the GBS Revenue Team translating complex data into accurate financial reporting under US GAAP.

Your Role:

As the leadRevenue Accountant for Recorded Music, you will serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for our recorded music revenue accounting life cycle. This role bridges technical accounting, data analytics, and financial systems design. You will take ownership of the end-to-end accounting for high-volume, multi-source revenue streams, drive compliance with ASC 606, spearhead systems automation, and unlock actionable financial insights through advanced data mining. In addition to technical execution, you will provide training and education to other members of the Recorded Music RTR team.


Here you'll get to:

  • Lead the technical accounting, accrual modeling, and reconciliation for all Recorded Music revenue streams, including Digital Streaming Partners (Spotify, Apple, YouTube, Amazon), Digital Downloads, DMCA statutory royalties, Physical manufacturing and distribution (vinyl, CD, merch), Synchronization (film, TV, gaming, advertising), Master Licensing, and foreign affiliate distributions.
  • Architect and maintain robust ASC 606 recognition schedules, monthly flash revenue accruals, deferred revenue tracking, and automated reversals based on consumption ingestion files vs. actual cash settlements.
  • Query, clean, and analyze Revenue Operational Reporting datasets across disparate DSPs using Analysis for Office and Gemini AI Tools. Reconcile Multi-System Reporting from Source to Financial Ledger.
  • Bridge consumption metadata (streams, downloads, play counts, tier rates) with transactional general ledger activity to detect anomalies, underreported royalties, missing catalog codes, and system mismatches.
  • Conduct granular month-over-month (MoM) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) variance analyses; present variance drivers to label finance leaders.
  • Serve as the RTR business lead for financial systems optimization across SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), BlackLine, and proprietary music revenue sub-ledgers.
  • Design, test, and implement automated reporting simplify manual journal entries and compress the monthly close cycle.
  • Direct the monthly and quarterly close deliverables for recorded music revenue, reviewing high-volume journal entries, complex accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Review work products prepared by staff accountants and offshore shared service partners (e.g., Shopify D2C sales tie-outs, DSP settlement matching, clearing account reconciliations), providing structured guidance and establishing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Actively investigate and resolve persistent balances in revenue clearing, suspense, and partner withholding accounts.
  • Maintain and enhance internal control matrices under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404), ensuring proper segregation of duties, automated validation checks, and data lineage documentation.
  • Serve as primary revenue audit liaison for internal and external auditors (e.g., Big 4), providing PBC audit schedules, roll-forwards, sample testing support, and technical accounting memos.
  • Partner proactively with Label Finance VPs/Directors, Commercial Revenue Operations, Business & Legal Affairs, IT/Data Engineering, and Corporate Royalty teams to align accounting treatments with evolving contract structures and deal terms.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related analytical field required.
  • Active CPA license (or international equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Master’s Degree (MAcc, MBA) or coursework in Financial Data Analytics / Information Systems is a significant plus.
  • 10 to 15+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience in Corporate Accounting, Shared Services, or Big 4 Public Accounting.
  • Extensive specialization (7+ years) in high-volume revenue accounting, billing assurance, or royalty accounting within the music, digital entertainment, streaming media, or intellectual property/licensing sectors.
  • Proven track record leading technical ASC 606 revenue recognition implementations or oversight for complex multi-element arrangements.
  • Demonstrable experience directing and reviewing work performed by distributed, hybrid, or offshore delivery centers.
  • Deep experience working with enterprise ERPs (specifically SAP FI/CO, S/4HANA) and automated balance sheet reconciliation tools (such as BlackLine or Cadency).
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel proficiency (SAP Analysis for Office, Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/macros, advanced nested logic).
  • Experience with eCommerce and digital billing platforms (e.g., Shopify, DSP vendor reporting portals) is highly desirable.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Ability to untangle intricate data anomalies and synthesize findings into clear executive summaries.
  • Proactive drive to evaluate status-quo manual workflows and design scalable, automated alternatives.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to collaborate across label executives, data engineers, and external auditors.
  • Proven capacity to manage high-pressure close deadlines and competing stakeholder requests with composure and precision.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.
