jobs.excerpt: Job Summary: You will build the AI runtime, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation that make the platform's AI features work in production - with cost, latency, and safety treated as first-class engineering constraints.
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

You will build the AI runtime, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation that make the platform's AI features work in production - with cost, latency, and safety treated as first-class engineering constraints. We build on proven commercial models and win on integration, domain knowledge, and evaluation discipline.

You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

The opportunity: ship AI that customers depend on daily in mission-critical workflows - not demos.

Job Description:

Why This Role Is Different

  • Applied, not research. We use proven commercial models and win on integration, retrieval, orchestration and safety validation. Fine-tuning is an optional track, not the goal.
  • Domain-first, not tech-first. Domain knowledge, delivered through retrieval and evaluation, is the moat, not model weights. You will invest early in your customers' domain.
  • Production-first. We ship AI that customers depend on daily. Demos don't count; reliability, cost and safety do.
  • Platform and product. You will build reusable AI capability while enabling products to ship features fast.
  • A founding role. As a found
  • ing AI hire, you will set the patterns and evaluation discipline the team adopts, and help hire the team.
  • Value-based. You will validate with product teams and customers and prioritise by value, building what moves outcomes rather than what is novel.

What You'll Do

AI Runtime and Orchestration

  • Build and operate the runtime, tool calling and orchestration for production agent workflows.
  • Design model selection and tiering, with cost and latency as first-class constraints.
  • Implement and tune retrieval (RAG) and grounding where it measurably improves quality.

Evaluation, Safety and Quality

  • Stand up evaluation harnesses and golden sets, and use them to make ship or no-ship calls and to catch regressions and drift.
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks for model and agent quality.
  • Build guardrails and safety controls, treating retrieved content and tool outputs as untrusted.

Production Ownership

  • Own the production behaviour of what you ship, including latency, cost, reliability and failure modes.
  • Partner with product to decide when an agent is, and is not, the right tool.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.
  • Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
  • Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.
  • Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

  • Help build the team by setting evaluation and safety patterns others adopt, raising the bar in interviews and mentoring.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.
  • Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

  • Production AI: You have shipped software backed by LLMs or ML to real production users, beyond demos and notebooks.
  • Evaluation over vibes: You reason about evaluation, not just prompting.
  • Cost and latency: You treat cost and latency as design constraints from the start.
  • Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners and customers, and bring people along.
  • Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value, and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points

Any of these strengthen an application; none are required.

  • Agents in production: Agent or RAG systems in production, and the failure modes that come with them.
  • Routing and cost wins: Model routing or measurable cost reduction.
  • Calibrated evaluation: Evaluation harnesses driving decisions; LLM-as-judge calibrated against humans.
  • Optimisation track: Fine-tuning or distillation.
  • Judgement: Knowing when not to use an agent.
  • Languages: Strength in Python or C#/.NET.
  • Semantic data: Experience grounding AI in structured, well-modelled business data.
  • Architecture: System and platform design, and trade-off judgement such as one-way versus two-way doors.
  • Enterprise scale: Experience building or operating enterprise-scale software, and its reliability, security and integration demands.
  • AI-assisted engineering: You use AI coding assistants productively and supervise their output with judgement.

New to some of this? If you bring the essentials above and are excited by the problem, we'd still like to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: Job Summary: You will build the foundations the whole team stands on - cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability - and establish the reliability practice that lets us ship safely.
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

You will build the foundations the whole team stands on - cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability - and establish the reliability practice that lets us ship safely. Our customers run 24/7 mission-critical operations, so reliability is a feature, not an afterthought.

You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

Job Description:

Why This Role Is Different

  • Production-first. Reliability is the product for customers who rely on us 24/7. You will ship safe, repeatable delivery, not experiments.
  • Platform and product. You will build the foundations that the whole team and portfolio stand on. One solid platform multiplies everyone's velocity.
  • Domain-first, not tech-first. You will learn the domain well enough to know what "reliable" means to customers running mission-critical operations.
  • A founding role. As an early hire, you will establish the delivery and on-call culture and help raise the bar as we grow.
  • Pragmatic build or buy. You will make pragmatic build or buy decisions on infrastructure and tooling, without gold-plating.

What You'll Do

Foundations and Delivery

  • Build and own cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code and the Kubernetes foundations the team builds on.
  • Own CI/CD as a product: fast, safe, repeatable delivery.
  • Automate away toil, and codify operational knowledge into tooling and runbooks.

Reliability and Observability

  • Establish observability (metrics, logs and traces), SLOs and alerting, so the platform is measurable and debuggable.
  • Set up and mature on-call and incident response, and drive reliability improvements from postmortems.

Deployment and Cost

  • Support deployment into both cloud and customer-managed environments, and manage version and configuration drift.
  • Optimise cost and capacity, including for AI workloads.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.
  • Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
  • Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.
  • Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

  • Help build the team by establishing on-call and reliability culture, and mentor as we grow.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.
  • Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

  • Production infrastructure: You have built and run production cloud infrastructure and owned its reliability.
  • Operations as engineering: You treat operations as engineering, not ticket-driven ops.
  • On-call maturity: You have carried real on-call for what you built.
  • Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners and customers, and bring people along.
  • Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value, and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points

Any of these strengthen an application; none are required.

  • Kubernetes and IaC: Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Azure depth: Landing zones, networking and identity on Azure.
  • Customer-managed environments: Shipping software into environments the vendor does not fully control.
  • Regulated delivery: Delivery into regulated or restricted environments.
  • Compute cost: Cost optimisation for GPUs or other expensive compute.
  • Languages: Comfortable in Python, C#/.NET or Go for tooling and automation.
  • Architecture: System and platform design, and trade-off judgement such as one-way versus two-way doors.
  • Enterprise scale: Experience building or operating enterprise-scale software, and its reliability, security and integration demands.
  • AI-assisted engineering: You use AI coding assistants productively and supervise their output with judgement.

New to some of this? If you bring the essentials above and are excited by the problem, we'd still like to hear from you.

Worker Type:

Regular

3

jobs.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The Marketing Operations Manager runs Marketo as the core marketing automation platform, optimizes the marketing technology stack, data governance and campaign execution across the organization, and owns CaPDB, Versaterm's competitive and market intelligence data in Salesforce. This role ensures that marketing systems, workflows and reporting are efficient, scalable and aligned with the company's go-to-market strategy. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing and Analytics to strengthen data integrity and turn account intelligence into targeted campaigns and pipeline.

In addition, this role provides day-to-day guidance and support to junior team members, helping to prioritize work, share best practices and foster team development.

What You Do

CaPDB Data Ownership and Market Intelligence (new)

  • Own CaPDB end to end as the named data owner: data standards, quality, refresh cadence and documentation.
  • Define and publish what "complete" means for a strategic account, including confirmed CAD and RMS product (not just vendor family), contract start and end dates, satisfaction, key contacts and last verified date.
  • Build and maintain the weekly Salesforce completeness report by tier, account owner and field, and review it with Sales leadership.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Salesforce Admin on field cleanup, picklists, vendor mapping, duplicate accounts and data loads.
  • Plan and run data enrichment programs, including vendor and outsourced calling partners, Gong and rep-sourced intel, and automated purchase and contract data sources. Set scope, scripts and quality checks, and review output on a regular schedule.
  • Maintain the renewal and competitive view of the account base so Growth Marketing can time Marketo campaigns to contract end dates.
  • Work with Sales leadership and account owners on a clear split of who confirms and updates which fields, and report ownership gaps.
  • Support Product Marketing and Growth Marketing with segmented lists for competitor, renewal and product-gap campaigns.

Funnel Operations and Optimization

  • Design and implement lead scoring, routing and lifecycle stage definitions in Marketo and Salesforce in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
  • Maintain and enforce SLA compliance across MQL, SAL and SQL handoffs.
  • Identify bottlenecks and conversion gaps across the funnel and propose data-driven solutions.
  • Provide guidance to team members on funnel management best practices and support execution consistency.

Marketing Systems Ownership

  • Act as the Marketo power user and platform owner: manage programs, channels, templates, smart lists, tokens and scoring, and keep the Marketo-Salesforce sync reliable.
  • Sync CaPDB account, competitor, product and renewal fields from Salesforce into Marketo so we can segment audiences and trigger campaigns by competitor, product gap and contract end date.
  • Collaborate with the GTM Systems team on system enhancements and architecture scalability.
  • Evaluate new tools and platforms to support account-based marketing, campaign automation and customer engagement.
  • Offer support and informal coaching to team members on system usage and troubleshooting.

Data Governance, Attribution and Reporting

  • Ensure marketing data quality, campaign attribution and lead-source tracking are accurate and reliable.
  • Partner with Analytics to build dashboards that measure pipeline contribution, channel ROI and marketing effectiveness, including CaPDB coverage and pipeline influenced by account intelligence.
  • Support data audits, segmentation strategies and compliance reporting.
  • Review team outputs for accuracy and consistency, providing feedback as needed.

Campaign Execution Enablement

  • Define best practices, templates and workflows to standardize campaign operations.
  • Conduct QA testing for all outbound marketing programs, including Marketo email, nurture and renewal campaigns.
  • Provide training and support to campaign managers and content marketers.
  • Act as a go-to resource for team members, helping to unblock issues and ensure smooth execution.

Program and Change Management

  • Lead cross-functional projects (for example tech rollouts, compliance updates and operational audits).
  • Develop documentation and training resources for new processes or tools, including the CaPDB playbook.
  • Monitor KPIs and iterate on strategies to drive continuous improvement.
  • Help coordinate project work across the team, ensuring clear ownership and timely delivery of key tasks.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation or revenue operations roles within a B2B SaaS or technology environment, with some prior experience providing mentorship, guidance or informal leadership.
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM, including custom objects, reports, dashboards, data loads and field and picklist management, and with Marketo, including programs, smart lists, scoring, tokens and the Marketo-Salesforce sync.
  • Proven experience owning data quality: defining standards, measuring completeness, cleaning and deduplicating records, and getting other teams to maintain data.
  • Experience managing outside vendors or outsourced data programs, including scoping, quality checks and performance review.
  • Strong understanding of lead management processes, funnel metrics and campaign attribution models.
  • Experience with data management, reporting and visualization tools (for example Tableau, Power BI or Salesforce dashboards).
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects and cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, including Sales leadership and Revenue Operations.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a focus on process improvement and operational excellence.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into actionable insights.
  • Experience in account-based marketing (ABM) and revenue attribution frameworks is an asset.
  • Experience with competitive intelligence, public sector or public safety technology markets, or contract and renewal data is an asset.
  • Experience providing informal mentorship, guidance or onboarding support to junior team members or peers.
  • Comfortable offering feedback, sharing best practices and helping to coordinate work across team members when needed.

Note: Due to the nature of our work with public safety agencies, this position requires compliance with the FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Candidates must successfully pass a comprehensive, fingerprint-based background check. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on CJIS security requirements, please visit the FBI's CJIS Security Policy Resource Center.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Associate Director, Occupier Sustainability RFP & Sales

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Job Description Summary

The Associate Director (AD) is an experienced sales and proposal professional with 10+ years of experience in sales for energy management, facilities management, sustainability consulting, real estate services or professional services business development. This person will work in close partnership with Occupier Sustainability leadership and will be the primary driver of RFP and proposal support and sustainability sales across our Americas Occupier business, which includes sustainability work primarily within large facilities management contracts. This role manages the RFP process end-to-end, turns input from subject matter experts into a cohesive, compelling pitch, and sells our portfolio of sustainability services to existing and prospective Occupier accounts. The AD will identify and convert cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts, support sales pitches, and build repeatable tools and processes that improve win rates and accelerate growth for the sustainability business.


Job Description


RFP and Proposal Management

  • Manage the RFP, RFI and RFQ process end-to-end for Occupier sustainability pursuits (primarily for integrated facilities management): qualify opportunities, develop the response plan and timeline, assign owners and drive to on-time, compliant submissions
  • Write, edit and refine proposal content, including executive summaries, technical approach, scope of services, pricing narrative, credentials and team bios, so that each response is clear, persuasive and tailored to the client
  • Synthesize input from sustainability, energy, engineering, facilities management, project management and transactions experts into a cohesive, differentiated pitch with clear win themes
  • Develop and maintain a library of proposal content, including case studies, credentials, references and templates, and keep it accurate, current and on brand
  • Prepare pursuit teams for finalist presentations and orals, including pitch decks, Q&A preparation and rehearsals
  • Track pursuit outcomes, run win/loss debriefs and apply lessons learned to improve future responses

Sales and Account Growth

  • Sell the full range of our sustainability consulting services across the Occupier network, such as decarbonization and net-zero roadmaps, energy and utility management, greenhouse gas inventories and sustainability reporting, and building certifications
  • Partner with Occupier account leaders and facilities management, and project management teams to identify whitespace and convert cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts
  • Understand client contract structures, sustainability goals and reporting requirements, and translate them into tailored service proposals and compelling value propositions
  • Support discovery conversations, sales pitches and scoping discussions with client sustainability, real estate and procurement stakeholders, in coordination with Occupier Sustainability leadership and other subject matter experts
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified opportunities in the CRM, and provide accurate pursuit forecasts and status updates to leadership
  • Strategically reinforce the company’s market presence through targeted industry networking, conferences and presentations

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Occupier Sustainability leadership to set pursuit priorities, shape win strategies and align on pricing and positioning
  • Coordinate with subject matter experts, marketing, legal, pricing and finance to secure inputs and approvals on proposals and contracts
  • Build relationships across the business (account management, project management, FM, procurement etc.) to keep sustainability top of mind in client conversations

Special Projects

  • Conduct market research, continually refine our understanding of the competitive landscape and identify opportunities and risks for the Occupier sustainability business
  • Develop sales and pursuit tools, such as service one-pagers, pitch templates, pricing guides and playbooks, so the broader network can sell sustainability services effectively
  • Develop pursuit and sales performance KPIs and reporting for executive leadership, such as pipeline, win rate, response turnaround and revenue
  • Review and refresh processes and strategies as necessary to optimize resources, win rates and client outcomes

Required Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience; Business Administration, Engineering or sustainability-related major preferred
  • Expertise in energy management and sustainability
  • Requires 10+ years of professional experience
  • Desired: experience and knowledge of energy and facilities management within commercial real estate

Key Competencies

  • Interpersonal skills
  • Oral and written communication skills
  • Conflict management
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Managing through Change
  • Business Acumen
  • Financial Acumen
  • Relationship Management
  • Partnership Development
  • Change Management
  • Ability to influence stakeholders
  • Decisiveness, accountability, ownership
  • Action-oriented

Requirements

  • Travel 25-30% time for client sales.



Cushman & Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications.
The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role.
The compensation for the position is: $ 119,000.00 - $140,000.00Cushman & Wakefield is an Equal Opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position at Cushman & Wakefield, please call the ADA line at 1-888-365-5406 or email . jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, customer success is about helping businesses achieve meaningful results while building relationships that last. We value leaders who can think strategically, understand the details of customer operations, develop strong teams, and turn good ideas into processes that make a measurable difference.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Customer Success & Strategy to lead Bask Health's customer success organization, develop its long-term strategy, and build scalable processes that improve customer outcomes, retention, and operational performance.

This role combines senior customer success leadership, organizational strategy, account management, and cross-functional execution.

You'll be responsible for defining how our customer success function operates, how we support different types of customers, and how we measure the value our team delivers.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll bring a strong understanding of e-commerce businesses, merchant-facing software, and the challenges entrepreneurs face when launching and scaling online operations.

You'll develop a customer success strategy that aligns customer needs, team capabilities, and Bask Health's broader business objectives.

You'll translate company priorities into clear customer success goals, operating plans, and measurable initiatives.

You'll evaluate our existing customer success processes and identify opportunities to improve consistency, accountability, and efficiency.

You'll help determine how the customer success organization should evolve as the platform and customer base grow.

You'll establish clear responsibilities across customer success, account management, onboarding, and related customer-facing functions.

You'll develop customer segmentation strategies that reflect differences in customer needs, account complexity, and business value.

You'll help determine the appropriate level of support and engagement for strategic accounts, growing merchants, and smaller businesses.

You'll establish processes for customer onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, renewals, retention, and expansion.

You'll help the team understand how customer success activities contribute to measurable customer outcomes.

You'll establish clear expectations for proactive account management, customer communication, and follow-through.

You'll lead, coach, and develop customer success team members within the approved organizational structure.

You'll help managers and individual contributors strengthen their strategic thinking, account management skills, and ability to solve complex customer problems.

You'll establish performance expectations that emphasize customer outcomes, accountability, and consistent execution.

You'll develop management practices that support coaching, performance reviews, and professional development.

You'll work with leadership to evaluate team capacity, staffing needs, and organizational priorities.

You'll participate in hiring and developing customer success talent as needed.

You'll define meaningful performance metrics and reporting practices for the customer success organization.

You'll monitor customer retention, churn, renewals, product adoption, account health, and expansion performance.

You'll establish processes for analyzing customer success trends and identifying areas that require attention.

You'll develop customer health frameworks that help the team recognize risks and opportunities early.

You'll create strategies for improving customer engagement and reducing preventable churn.

You'll oversee important customer escalations and ensure issues affecting strategic relationships receive appropriate attention.

You'll build relationships with key customer stakeholders, including founders, executives, and business owners.

You'll participate in executive-level customer conversations when leadership involvement can strengthen relationships or help resolve complex situations.

You'll guide the team in conducting meaningful customer business reviews focused on goals, progress, challenges, and opportunities.

You'll work closely with sales leadership to improve customer handoffs, renewal preparation, and appropriate account expansion opportunities.

You'll establish clear collaboration between customer success and sales so account responsibilities are understood.

You'll help ensure commercial conversations are grounded in customer needs and supported platform capabilities.

You'll collaborate with product leadership to communicate recurring customer challenges, adoption barriers, and opportunities for improvement.

You'll use customer feedback and operational data to help inform product priorities.

You'll work with engineering and customer success engineering teams to address technical problems affecting customer adoption and retention.

You'll coordinate with technical support teams to improve escalation processes and issue resolution.

You'll identify recurring onboarding and implementation problems that prevent customers from achieving value.

You'll support improvements to customer education, onboarding resources, and implementation handoffs.

You'll ensure the customer success team understands how Bask Health's capabilities support different merchant business models.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll help the team connect these capabilities to practical customer needs without promising unsupported functionality.

You'll establish clear processes for recognizing when customer requests require technical, clinical, pharmacy, or compliance expertise.

You'll coordinate with authorized teams when issues involve regulated healthcare activities.

You'll ensure customer-facing processes follow appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling requirements.

You'll develop scalable customer success playbooks, operating procedures, and internal documentation.

You'll evaluate customer success platforms, reporting tools, and workflows to identify opportunities for improvement.

You'll establish consistent practices for documenting customer goals, account risks, customer commitments, and next steps.

You'll develop operational planning processes that help the team prioritize work effectively.

You'll establish a regular cadence for reviewing customer success performance, strategic initiatives, and operational challenges.

You'll work with leadership to set realistic priorities and allocate resources to the most important customer success initiatives.

You'll identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary manual work and improve team efficiency.

You'll evaluate how customer success processes should change as the customer base becomes larger or more complex.

You'll develop strategies that support consistency without making customer relationships overly rigid or impersonal.

You'll work directly with company leadership to communicate customer success performance, strategic priorities, and emerging risks.

You'll provide recommendations on team structure, customer coverage, retention initiatives, and long-term customer success investments.

You'll help leadership understand how customer success performance affects customer satisfaction, retention, and recurring revenue.

You'll balance customer advocacy with commercial priorities and operational realities.

You'll take responsibility for turning customer success strategy into practical improvements that the team can execute.

We're looking for a leader with substantial post-sale customer success experience, proven team management ability, and meaningful recent e-commerce experience.

You should understand how merchant-facing SaaS businesses operate and how customer success organizations contribute to customer outcomes and company growth.

You'll need to be comfortable developing strategies, building processes, coaching teams, managing strategic accounts, and making data-informed decisions.

Success in this role means building a customer success organization with a clear strategy, strong leadership, consistent processes, measurable performance, and the ability to support Bask Health's long-term growth.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Bask Health's customer success strategy and organizational direction.
  • Translate company objectives into customer success goals and operating plans.
  • Oversee post-sale customer success operations and account management.
  • Develop scalable processes for onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.
  • Establish clear customer success team responsibilities and operating standards.
  • Lead and coach customer success team members within the approved organization.
  • Develop organizational planning and customer success staffing recommendations.
  • Establish customer segmentation and account coverage strategies.
  • Define customer success performance metrics and reporting practices.
  • Monitor retention, churn, renewals, adoption, and account health.
  • Develop customer health monitoring and risk identification frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes and reduce preventable churn.
  • Establish a consistent cadence for customer success performance reviews.
  • Oversee strategic customer relationships and executive-level engagements.
  • Guide customer success managers in conducting customer business reviews.
  • Collaborate with sales on renewals and appropriate account expansion opportunities.
  • Establish clear collaboration and handoffs between customer success and sales.
  • Work with product leadership on customer feedback and adoption challenges.
  • Coordinate with engineering and technical support on customer-impacting issues.
  • Improve onboarding and implementation processes that affect customer success.
  • Develop customer success playbooks, training resources, and operating procedures.
  • Establish consistent documentation practices for account goals, risks, and commitments.
  • Evaluate customer success tools, workflows, and reporting systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual work.
  • Oversee important customer escalations affecting strategic accounts.
  • Coach team members on account management, strategic thinking, and customer communication.
  • Support organizational planning, hiring, and professional development.
  • Establish effective collaboration between customer success and other departments.
  • Promote accountability for customer outcomes and operational execution.
  • Ensure appropriate privacy, security, and information-handling practices.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, and compliance matters to authorized teams.
  • Provide leadership with clear updates on customer success strategy, performance, and risks.
  • Recommend long-term improvements to the customer success organization.
  • Take ownership of the customer success function's strategy, effectiveness, and execution.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in customer success, account management, client services, or a closely related post-sale customer-facing function.
  • At least 4 years of experience directly managing and developing customer success or account management teams.
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer success strategy, operations, and team performance.
  • Recent, substantive experience working with e-commerce businesses, online merchants, or merchant-facing commerce software.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce business models, direct-to-consumer operations, and merchant needs.
  • Experience developing and executing customer success strategies.
  • Proven ability to lead customer onboarding, adoption, renewal, retention, and expansion initiatives.
  • Experience building scalable customer success processes and operating models.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and evaluate customer-facing employees.
  • Experience establishing customer success performance metrics and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of customer retention, churn, account health, and renewal performance.
  • Experience developing customer segmentation and account coverage strategies.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into practical customer success initiatives.
  • Experience improving customer success team structure, workflows, or operational efficiency.
  • Strong commercial judgment and understanding of recurring-revenue SaaS businesses.
  • Experience managing relationships with founders, executives, and senior customer stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead strategic account reviews and executive-level customer discussions.
  • Experience handling complex customer escalations and retention risks.
  • Experience collaborating with sales, product, engineering, and company leadership.
  • Ability to translate customer feedback into operational and product recommendations.
  • Experience building customer success playbooks, training programs, and internal procedures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to present customer success strategy and operational performance to leadership.
  • Strong analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Experience managing multiple strategic priorities and competing demands.
  • Strong organizational and operational planning skills.
  • Ability to lead teams in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Strong ownership mentality and accountability for customer and team outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading customer success strategy at an e-commerce SaaS company.
  • Experience managing customer success teams serving Shopify merchants.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, Klaviyo, Recharge, Gorgias, Yotpo, or similar commerce platforms.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer brands and online entrepreneurs.
  • Personal experience building or operating an e-commerce business.
  • Experience leading customer success for both SMB and strategic accounts.
  • Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
  • Experience designing customer success organizational structures and operating models.
  • Experience developing customer success annual or quarterly planning processes.
  • Experience creating customer success dashboards and executive reporting.
  • Experience developing customer health scoring and churn prediction processes.
  • Experience improving gross revenue retention and net revenue retention.
  • Experience collaborating with sales on customer expansion strategies.

Solution Architect

Who We Need

ADA is looking for an experienced Solution Architect who can operate as a trusted technical authority across the business. This is a company-level role: rather than being fully embedded in one project or customer, the Solution Architect will consult across multiple projects, clients and strategic initiatives while remaining close enough to delivery to guide implementation and quality.

At this stage of your career, you are expected to have demonstrated that you:

  • Can be fully trusted with technical decision-making and architectural direction.
  • Can balance technical requirements, delivery constraints and a project’s business objectives.
  • Contribute to improving ADA’s technical landscape, engineering practices and reusable capability.
  • Actively build your own professional brand and the Decision Inc. brand internally and within the broader technology community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Consulting: Provide architecture leadership across multiple engagements; translate business needs into scalable, secure and maintainable solutions; assess existing systems; define target architectures and make pragmatic technology decisions.
  • Implementation: Remain hands-on enough to validate architecture through delivery, support critical implementation decisions and guide teams through complex technical challenges.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers, provide technical escalation support and raise engineering capability across teams.
  • Standards & Quality: Act as a custodian of delivery quality by defining and governing architecture standards, technical documentation, design decisions and engineering quality gates.
  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs and recommend technologies based on business requirements rather than technology preference.
  • Produce and maintain solution architecture documentation, technical diagrams and architecture decisions.
  • Presales: Shape solution approaches during proposals and client engagements, validate feasibility, identify technical risks and support estimation and solution positioning.
  • Community & Brand: Contribute to thought leadership, technical communities, internal forums and external industry engagement to strengthen the Decision Inc. technical brand.
  • Training & Capability Development: Help define technical learning priorities, contribute to training content and support the development of architects, Technical Leads and engineers.
  • Research & Development: Allocate time to emerging technologies, architectural patterns and practical experimentation that can improve client solutions and internal capability.

Technical Scope

  • The role is technology-agnostic and requires broad architectural depth across modern custom development and digital solutions. Key areas include:
  • Custom development: Java, .NET/C#, React, Angular and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Architecture: enterprise applications, microservices, modular and event-driven architectures, APIs, integration patterns, distributed systems and security-by-design.
  • Cloud & infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, containers, networking, identity, scalability, resilience, monitoring and observability; AWS exposure is advantageous.
  • Data & integration: SQL, relational databases, data modelling, REST APIs, synchronous/asynchronous integration and application data architecture.
  • DevOps & engineering quality: CI/CD, source control, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, deployment strategies and technical quality gates.
  • Emerging technologies: AI-enabled applications, AI service integration, low-code platforms and application modernisation.

How you work

  • Make technology choices based on business problems, not platform preference.
  • Evaluate trade-offs across cost, speed, scalability, security, maintainability and operational complexity.
  • Communicate architecture clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Provide direction without becoming a bottleneck, enabling teams to make sound decisions independently.

Experience and Capability

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Typically 7–10+ years’ experience across software engineering, technical leadership and solution architecture.
  • Strong foundation in custom application development and modern enterprise architecture.
  • Experience designing solutions across frontend, backend, integration, data, cloud and infrastructure concerns.
  • Strong Azure architecture experience; AWS exposure advantageous.
  • Experience providing technical governance, reviewing designs and guiding multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong consulting and stakeholder engagement capability, including the ability to operate across several clients and initiatives.
  • Experience supporting presales, technical assessments, estimation or solution shaping is advantageous.

What success looks like

  • Projects make sound, consistent technical decisions with fewer late-stage architecture issues.
  • Technical Leads and engineering teams become stronger and more self-sufficient through effective mentorship.
  • Reusable standards, patterns and lessons are shared across ADA rather than remaining within individual projects.
  • Presales solutions are technically credible, commercially pragmatic and aligned to client outcomes.
  • Decision Inc. strengthens its reputation for high-quality engineering, architecture and modern digital solution delivery.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; and copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work. All of this frontline work is powered by a trusted knowledge base that provides the right information, processes, and systems for every interaction. We also build the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

A Knowledge Engineering leader who is ready to turn our clients' customer service knowledge into a strategic asset. You lead the complete knowledge engineering scope on our most strategic and complex service programs, building a single, trusted source of truth for service knowledge that grounds AI agents, supports service agents, and gives customers consistent answers across every channel. You set strategy and architecture end to end, from ontologies and knowledge graphs to the governance that keeps knowledge accurate as products, policies, and customer needs change.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop knowledge engineers into leaders, define what staying at the forefront means for the discipline, and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee knowledge engineering across multiple programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as answer accuracy, first-contact resolution, handle time, and knowledge reuse.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Own the strategy and architecture for a single source of truth for service knowledge, consolidating knowledge bases, documents, product and policy data, and case history into a governed knowledge graph and semantic layer.
  • Set the standards for how service ontologies and taxonomies are designed, evaluated, and maintained across programs.
  • Make knowledge the trusted foundation for AI, defining how it grounds virtual agents, agent-assist copilots, and analytics agents, in partnership with AI Solution Engineering and Enterprise AI Architecture leaders.
  • Establish knowledge governance and operating models with clients, including ownership, review cycles, content lifecycle, access rules, and feedback loops that turn knowledge gaps found in service interactions into new content.
  • Shape knowledge around how customers and service agents actually look for answers, translating customer experience journeys and conversation designs into knowledge structures that support them.

Business Development:

  • Lead Accenture sales and pre-sales efforts, shaping service knowledge and data transformation programs that turn one project into a lasting partnership.
  • Make and defend the business case for the semantic layer and knowledge graph solution at the executive level, connecting knowledge quality to service outcomes and cost-to-serve.
  • Develop trusted-advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders, including service, customer experience, and knowledge management leaders.
  • Drive thought leadership on knowledge as the foundation for AI in customer service, positioning Song as a credible and compelling voice in the industry.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow teams of knowledge engineers, helping them grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Lead the creation of reusable assets that advance the discipline beyond any single engagement, such as service ontologies, knowledge models, curation pipelines, and accelerators.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.

Here's what you'll need:

  • Minimum 6 years of experience with knowledge graph and semantic technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL), as part of 10+ years in data, AI, search, or information architecture.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, and knowledge graph curation.
  • Minimum 4 years designing and developing knowledge graph solutions and graph-based ML models (functional and technical).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementations for AI applications (especially LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases.
  • Minimum of 5 years experience leading knowledge, data, or AI transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how knowledge quality moves them.
  • Minimum 6 years of managerial experience leading people, with the ability to explain the value of the semantic layer and knowledge graphs to senior business and technology stakeholders, and a proven track record in sales and/or pre-sales, delivering data transformation programs, and developing teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (12 years working experience).

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with service knowledge management platforms such as Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow Knowledge Management, eGain, or Zendesk.
  • Experience establishing Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) or similar knowledge management practices at enterprise scale.
  • Experience with GraphRAG or other knowledge-grounded retrieval for AI agents.
  • Practical experience with NLP and/or search techniques, prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch and tools for building ETL pipelines, such as Apache NiFi or Airflow.
  • Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems.
  • External client-facing consulting experience.
  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

You contribute to external thought leadership, such as publishing POVs, speaking at events, or representing the practice in the broader AI community.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Applied AI Engineer to help develop, test, and improve AI-powered software features across Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools. As we continue building AI-powered capabilities, we're looking for an early-career engineer who wants to apply modern AI technologies to real product challenges.

You'll work alongside experienced software engineers, applied AI engineers, and product teams to develop intelligent features that improve how merchants, patients, and internal teams interact with our platform.

This is a hands-on engineering position where you'll contribute to production software while developing your technical skills. You'll gain experience working with large language models, backend APIs, application integrations, automated testing, and AI development tools.

Your work may include implementing AI-assisted application features, integrating model APIs, improving prompts, building supporting backend services, and testing model outputs for accuracy and reliability.

You'll also help investigate technical issues, write documentation, and improve existing AI features based on feedback from engineers and product stakeholders.

We're looking for someone who understands the fundamentals of software development, has experimented with modern AI technologies, and is comfortable learning new tools and frameworks.

You don't need to have years of professional AI engineering experience. Strong personal projects, internships, coursework, open-source contributions, or other demonstrated technical work can help show your ability to succeed in this role.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn to build AI features with appropriate attention to privacy, permissions, reliability, and human oversight. You'll work within established engineering safeguards and will not be responsible for independently designing clinical decision-making systems.

This role offers the opportunity to gain practical experience building AI-powered products, contribute meaningful engineering work, and grow alongside a team developing modern software for healthcare businesses.

What You'll Do

  • Assist with developing AI-powered features across Bask Health's platform.
  • Work with experienced engineers to integrate large language models into software applications.
  • Implement application features using TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or comparable languages.
  • Build and maintain backend API integrations for AI-powered functionality.
  • Assist with connecting applications to approved AI model providers.
  • Develop and improve prompts for supported AI features.
  • Implement structured model outputs and basic response validation.
  • Help build AI-assisted tools for merchant-facing and internal workflows.
  • Contribute to patient-facing AI features within approved product and safety boundaries.
  • Assist with developing AI-powered search, summarization, and information retrieval features.
  • Write automated tests for AI integrations and application functionality.
  • Help evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, consistency, and relevance.
  • Investigate unexpected model outputs and report reproducible issues.
  • Assist with testing AI features using realistic application scenarios.
  • Help improve error handling and fallback behavior in AI-powered applications.
  • Work with backend engineers to connect AI functionality to existing services.
  • Contribute to frontend integrations for AI-powered user experiences.
  • Assist with maintaining application data flows and API connections.
  • Help document AI features, implementation details, and technical limitations.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior engineers.
  • Learn and follow Bask Health's engineering standards and development practices.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while reviewing generated code carefully.
  • Assist with troubleshooting development and production issues.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to understand feature requirements.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve existing AI-powered workflows.
  • Participate in engineering planning, technical discussions, and team collaboration.
  • Learn about secure software development and responsible handling of sensitive information.
  • Take ownership of appropriately scoped engineering tasks and deliver reliable, well-tested code.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience through internships, coursework, personal projects, or open-source contributions.
  • Foundational programming skills in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable languages.
  • Understanding of basic software engineering principles and application development.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs or comparable application integration methods.
  • Basic understanding of large language models and generative AI applications.
  • Experience experimenting with AI model APIs, AI development tools, or AI-powered applications.
  • Familiarity with backend development concepts.
  • Understanding of basic data structures and programming logic.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control workflows.
  • Ability to read, understand, and modify existing application code.
  • Understanding of debugging and troubleshooting fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with automated testing concepts.
  • Basic understanding of databases and structured application data.
  • Willingness to learn new programming languages, frameworks, and AI technologies.
  • Ability to follow technical documentation and implementation instructions.
  • Understanding of basic authentication and application security concepts.
  • Ability to write clear, maintainable code with guidance.
  • Familiarity with JSON and structured API responses.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate technical questions and challenges clearly.
  • Willingness to ask questions and incorporate engineering feedback.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with other engineers and product teams.
  • Interest in developing production software rather than only experimenting with AI models.
  • Strong curiosity about applied AI and modern software development.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and communicate progress consistently.

Nice to Have

  • Internship or project experience involving AI-powered applications.
  • Experience using OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model APIs.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and structured model outputs.
  • Experience building a chatbot, AI assistant, or other LLM-powered application.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Basic understanding of embeddings and vector databases.
  • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Familiarity with React or Next.js.
  • Experience with Python-based AI development libraries.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable AI application frameworks.
  • Experience developing backend APIs or serverless functions.
  • Familiarity with SQL or relational databases.
  • Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience writing automated tests using Jest, Vitest, Pytest, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation and testing concepts.
  • Experience participating in hackathons or building independent technical projects.
  • Open-source contributions or a GitHub portfolio demonstrating software development skills.
  • Interest in healthcare technology, telehealth, or e-commerce platforms.
  • Basic understanding of data privacy and responsible AI development.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We’re searching for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to help build our new Integrations pod. Our Portal connects with the HR, payroll, driver safety, and expense management systems our customers already use. These integrations keep driver information current and support some of our most important customer workflows.

When an integration fails, the impact can be difficult to spot: a new hire never appears, a former employee stays active, or information falls out of sync. You’ll build connections customers can trust and make sure we catch problems before they do.

Reporting to the Manager of the team, you’ll own integrations end to end, from a partner’s API to the screens customers use to connect and configure them. As one of the pod’s first engineers, you’ll help establish its technical standards, delivery practices, and approach to keeping integrations healthy in production.

What You’ll Do

  • Own integrations from design through launch and ongoing production health, partnering with Product, QA, and the other Portal engineering teams.
  • Work with Product and partners to clarify requirements, resolve gaps in API documentation, agree on scope, and deliver against committed dates.
  • Build backend services, data models, APIs, background jobs, and customer-facing interfaces for connecting and configuring integrations.
  • Design data mapping, synchronization, retries, and reconciliation within established platform patterns, documenting key decisions in architecture decision records.
  • Build syncs, webhooks, and scheduled jobs that handle rate limits, duplicate events, partial failures, and partner outages without creating unnecessary manual cleanup.
  • Create shared building blocks and clear adapter interfaces for authentication, data mapping, synchronization, and error handling, making each new integration easier to deliver.
  • Build monitoring, alerts, and runbooks that help the team detect failures early and recover reliably.
  • Help customers connect, configure, and check the health of their integrations independently.
  • Protect partner credentials and personal information through secure token handling, encryption, least-privilege access, safe logging, and reliable separation of customer data.
  • Use AI coding agents to accelerate development and testing while carefully reviewing their output. Help shape how the pod uses AI for integration work.
  • Strengthen the pod’s standards for design reviews, code reviews, testing, documentation, and production support.
  • Hold launches that don’t meet agreed standards for data correctness, security, and monitoring, working with the Lead Mobile Engineer and Product on go/no-go decisions.

In your first 30 days, you’ll learn how our existing integrations work and ship changes to at least one in production. Within three months, you’ll have designed, scoped, and delivered your first new integration by its agreed deadline. Within six months, several integrations you’ve contributed to will be live and meeting their quality goals, and you’ll be a go-to expert for the other Portal teams.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years building production software, including at least 3 years building and running third-party integrations. Your track record matters more than your title.
  • Strong full-stack experience across backend services and product interfaces, with ownership spanning data models, APIs, background jobs, and customer-facing screens.
  • Experience designing, shipping, and operating integrations that customers depend on, including syncs, webhooks, and scheduled jobs.
  • A practical understanding of retries, duplicates, partial failures, rate limits, and partner outages. You can explain an integration failure you handled and what you changed afterward.
  • Experience designing reusable integration architecture, including adapter interfaces and shared capabilities for authentication, mapping, synchronization, and error handling. You know when an abstraction helps.
  • A track record of delivering large features or products against firm deadlines by breaking down work, sequencing delivery, raising risks early, and making deliberate scope decisions.
  • The ability to turn a goal and incomplete information into clear requirements, working directly with Product and partners to close gaps and move delivery forward.
  • Experience using AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code to deliver faster, with sound judgment about context, verification, and the mistakes AI-assisted development can introduce.
  • Production experience protecting credentials and personal information, including OAuth, token handling, encryption at rest, least-privilege access, safe logging, and separation of customer data.
  • The ability to improve the work of other engineers through thoughtful design and code reviews.

Our current stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL with Prisma, BullMQ, Redis, Vitest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Datadog, and Flagsmith feature flags.

Compensation

In line with Ontario’s Pay Transparency legislation, the salary range for this role is $150,000 – $175,000 CAD annually, based on experience, skills, and alignment with the role requirements. This is a vacant position, and we are hiring with intention and seeking someone who will bring new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience without a degree.

    • Juniper

At Leidos, you'll work on a mission that directly supports the U.S. Army's ability to communicate and operate around the world.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. NVIDIA GH200 superchip provides performance and productivity required for strong scaling for HPC and generative AI workload. Scale out is inherent to design of this massive superchip. We are looking for expert engineers to come and help design rack level solutions for next generation scaling AI supercomputing platforms.

We are looking for a strong technical architect to own end to end manageability architecture for these products in data centers. You will work with various component leads internally and externally, drive customer use cases, align architecture with customer requirements and release best products to market.

Join us at the forefront of technological advancement.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Drive server management for large clusters and data centers deploying GPUs and Grace solution from Nvidia.

  • Work with data center architects and cloud customers to narrow down on requirements for implementation to ensure speed of light product development.

  • Work with internal teams to make sure requirements are designed and implemented in right way with each firmware and software module

  • Collaborate with other leads to design & build data center health management workflow.

  • Drive reliability and optimization in firmware architecture from a data center view point.

  • Work closely with cluster bring up team and resolve issues at Speed of Light

  • Own firmware delivered to data centers in terms of quality, reliability and telemetry performance.

What we need to see:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience working on server firmware (BMC) and platform software development

  • BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education or equivalent experience

  • Hands on experience with data center health management workflow. Proven record of delivering server firmware for large data centers..

  • Strong knowledge of data center management, server architecture and server manageability in data centers and strong and demonstrable skill in C/C++ and Python

  • Experience programming and debugging skills for server platforms.

  • Experience in SCM (e.g. Git, Perforce) and project management tools like Jira.

  • You should possess excellent written and oral communication skills, good work ethics, high sense of team-work, love to produce quality work and commitment to finish your tasks every single day.

  • You are a self-starter who loves to find creative solutions to complicated problems and hands on with coding.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Hands on experience with data center health management

  • Hands on with x86 or ARM system architecture.

  • Proven technical leaders to drive large complex problem with 50+ engineers working

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
272,000 USD – 431,250 USD for Level 6; and 320,000 USD – 488,750 USD for Level 7.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.
